title: Creative Lead
description:
**About Ogilvy**

Ogilvy has been creating impact for brands through iconic, culture-changing, value-driving ideas since the company was founded by David Ogilvy more than 75 years ago. It builds on that rich legacy through Borderless Creativity—innovating at the intersection of intelligence, imagination and influence, with experts across advertising, sports & entertainment, PR & social, consulting, and health collaborating seamlessly across more than 120 offices spanning 90 countries. Ogilvy was named Network of the Year at the 2026 Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity and ranks as the #1 global agency network for creative excellence and effectiveness by WARC for the fourth consecutive year, signifying its ability to deliver creative solutions that drive unreasonable impact for clients and communities. Ogilvy is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. For more information, visit Ogilvy.com, and follow us on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and Facebook.

  

**About WPP**

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

**Imagine yourself at Ogilvy.**

Imagine you can help brands grow and increase their positive impact on society in a creative and meaningful way. And at the same time, you also grow. At Ogilvy, that’s our mission. We achieve this by bringing in people who are creative, strategic, bold, disruptive, curious, detail-oriented, proactive, enthusiastic, analytical, multidisciplinary, open-minded, and all the other good qualities you can think of.

Can you imagine being one of those people? **Then, join our team!**

We’re looking for a **Creative Lead** to join our team and drive the global social and creator strategy for one of the world’s leading FMCG brands.

This is a **strategic and hands-on role**, perfect for a creative who has evolved from an **art direction background**into leading multi-platform campaigns with a strong focus on **social, collabs and creator-driven storytelling**.

You’ll lead creative development from insight to execution — crafting concepts that transcend formats, inspire teams and perform across markets.

**Responsabilities:**

* Lead the **creative vision and execution** for all social-first and creator-led content across global markets.

* Translate global brand platforms into culturally relevant, platform-native ideas and **creator collaborations**.

* Partner with Strategy, Account and Production to ensure creative excellence and brand consistency.

* Ideate and oversee **collaborations with influencers, creators and cultural partners**, ensuring authenticity and impact.

* Mentor and guide a small creative team (art & copy), raising the bar in concepting, design and storytelling.

* Collaborate with global hubs to align creative approaches across regions and partners.

* Stay ahead of trends, formats and innovations in **social, content and creator economy**.
* Be the guardian of the brand’s tone, look & feel, and creative consistency across every touchpoint.

**Qualifications:**

* **7+ years of creative experience**, ideally starting as an **Art Director** and evolving into a **Creative Lead / ACD**role.

* Proven track record developing **social-first campaigns** and **creator collabs** for global or regional brands.

* Deep understanding of **platform-specific storytelling**, digital culture and the creator ecosystem.

* Sharp visual sensibility and the ability to craft ideas that are as beautiful as they are effective.

* Experience leading creative teams and managing partner agencies or freelancers.

* Fluent presentation and communication skills in **English (C2 level required)**.
* Curiosity, agility and passion for how creativity moves at the speed of culture.

And since you'll give this and much more, **we also want to give you much more**:

* A dynamic and creative work environment.

* High-profile clients and international brands.

* Full-time position.

* Hybrid format: 2 or 3 days in the office / 2 or 3 days remote work.

* Christmas, Easter, July, and August: FULL REMOTE.

* Flexible hours.

* Permanent contract with a six-month trial period.

* 22 working days of vacation per year + 12 extra days!

* Optional access to flexible compensation (health insurance, transportation, meals, and childcare).

* Ogilvy Wellness Program: Free psychological, legal, and financial support service. Discounts on physiotherapy and gyms.
* Ogilvy is recognized with the Family-Responsible Company (EFR) certification for its commitment to employee well-being and work-life balance.

If you’ve imagined yourself in this position, that’s a good sign. At Ogilvy, we want to work with the best talent—those who challenge us and make us better. People who are eager to experience an agency culture open to diversity as a principle and connectivity as a primary tool.

So, if you're nodding your head while reading this, **send us your CV!**

At Ogilvy, our people are at the heart of what we do: a creative agency that sparks game-changing ideas across culture and business through collaboration, integrity, and a celebration of self-expression.

We believe in building powerful teams with purpose - and we relentlessly curate transformative initiatives that make our commitment to fairness, and equity a reality.

Our ultimate mission is to leave a positive impact on the world, creating a better future for all, while supporting and uplifting the global communities we serve. This is central to our mantra of Borderless Creativity.

Ogilvy is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

If you need any assistance seeking a job opportunity, or if you need reasonable accommodation with the application process, please contact us at accommodations@ogilvy.com. Please note that this contact is only for candidates who are requesting accommodation. Emails for other purposes, including application status requests, will not receive a response.

title: Micro-Drama Director (Creative Director) | 100% Remote
description:
**Please be informed that Foxelli Group hires exclusively in-house and doesn't work with any external recruitment agencies. Any company or individual claiming to recruit on behalf of Foxelli Group is not affiliated with us.**

At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them.

If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us.

**THE ROLE**
------------

We're building an AI-powered entertainment studio producing addictive vertical micro-drama series for US audiences, primarily women aged 35–55.  
  
We're looking for a **creative director with exceptional storytelling instincts, strong cinematic taste, and a deep understanding of human emotions.**  
  
Your mission is simple: **turn good scripts into emotionally powerful episodes that people can't stop watching.**  
  
You'll work with screenwriters, AI video creators, and editors, taking creative ownership from script review to the final finished episode.  
  
You won't need to write the scripts or generate every video yourself. Your role is to guide the creative execution, identify what needs improvement, and ensure every episode meets our standards.  
  
**No AI experience?** No problem. We’re looking for exceptional storytellers and filmmakers, not AI experts. If you’re a talented screenwriter or director, we’ll teach you everything you need to know about AI filmmaking technologies.

We believe AI is opening up incredible new opportunities for creative professionals, allowing them to bring their ideas to life faster and with fewer traditional production limitations. You’ll have the opportunity to learn cutting-edge tools, develop valuable new skills, and become part of the next generation of filmmaking.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

**1. Script Review & Creative Direction**

* Review season storylines and individual episode screenplays.
* Evaluate storytelling, emotional impact, character motivations, hooks, and cliffhangers.
* Approve scripts or provide specific, actionable feedback to screenwriters.
* Add directing instructions only when necessary. If the script is already strong and production-ready, approve it without unnecessary changes.

**2. Direct AI Video Production**

* Establish the visual style and creative standards for each series.
* Guide AI video creators on cinematography, framing, character performance, lighting, and emotional delivery.
* Review generated footage and identify scenes or shots that need improvement.
* Maintain visual consistency and quality across episodes.

**3. Editing & Final Approval**

* Review episode edits for pacing, tension, emotional impact, music, sound design, and visual storytelling.
* Give clear, prioritized feedback to editors.
* Approve final episodes before release.
* Ensure the finished video delivers the intended emotional experience.

**4. Production Quality & Efficiency**

* Work with multiple AI video creators and editors.
* Help the team increase production speed without sacrificing creative quality.
* Identify recurring production problems and improve workflows.
* Use audience feedback and retention data to improve future episodes.

**WHO YOU ARE**
---------------

* **Exceptional storytelling instincts** – you understand why audiences feel anger, excitement, suspense, satisfaction, and anticipation.
* **Strong cinematic judgment** – you know how camera angles, acting, editing, lighting, and sound influence emotions.
* **Experience in directing or filmmaking** – ideally film, television, serialized drama, or narrative short-form video.
* **Understanding of AI filmmaking** – you know the capabilities and limitations of AI video generation and how they affect production decisions.
* **Strong attention to detail** – you easily spot continuity errors, weak performances, awkward cuts, or emotional moments that don't work.
* **Clear communicator** – you can explain exactly what's wrong, why it matters, and how to fix it.
* **Pragmatic** – you don't make changes just to make changes. You know when something is good enough to approve.
* **Comfortable with fast-paced production** – you can make strong creative decisions quickly.
* Excellent English communication skills.

**BIG PLUS**
------------

* Experience directing drama, romance, thrillers, soap operas, or telenovelas.
* Experience with AI filmmaking tools such as Kling, Runway, Seedance, or similar.
* Experience leading creative production teams.
* Understanding of audience retention and performance-driven storytelling.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
---------------------------

* Episodes consistently deliver strong emotional impact, hooks, and cliffhangers.
* Screenwriters and AI creators receive clear, useful feedback without unnecessary revisions.
* The team produces more high-quality episodes while keeping production costs under control.
* Finished episodes maintain consistent cinematic quality and improve based on audience feedback.

**THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS**
---------------------------

Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world.  
Ribbon AI Interview - Ribbon is a short, guided video step that helps us understand your thinking style in a calm, private space.  
Interview -A conversation with your manager to feel the work chemistry, get to know each other, and explore what we could build together.

**FIXED SERVICE FEE**

€2,000–5,000 monthly service fee, depending on experience.

Please note that this role is based on a contract/freelance agreement.

**LOCATION**
------------

Remote, hiring across selected European countries and South Africa.  
  
**RECRUITMENT PROCESS**

* Application and portfolio review.
* AI interview.
* Practical creative directing test.
* Interview and trial period.

**PERKS & BENEFITS**

* Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting, while Apploye ensures transparency and fairness.
* Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and to keep your physical well-being in check.
* A personal development budget is at your disposal for your personal and professional growth to ensure you keep growing continuously.
* Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested.
* A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like.
* Strong company culture and a network of unique individuals that celebrate you.

**ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS**

This role is 100% remote.

* Our tribe works primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET — UTC+2/UTC+3). We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported.
* For full-time roles, we ask that you’re available for at least 5 hours during typical EET working hours — it keeps collaboration smooth and communication easy.  
  (This doesn’t apply to part-time roles.)

Currently, **we are hiring in** Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Czech Republic, Estonia, Greece, Georgia, Kosovo, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Malta, Slovenia, Serbia, Cyprus, Bulgaria, Hungary, Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and South Africa.

title: Design Lead (Madrid only, contract)
description:
**This position is only for a particular project, not a full time inhouse position.**

**In this case, the social package (sick leaves, days off, vacation, necessary equipment provision, etc) is not covered by Selecto.**

### **PROJECT**

**Domain:** Sport Broadcasting

**Description:** We are designing a flexible, scalable multi-platform digital experience across responsive web, mobile apps, and connected TV, delivered through a comprehensive design system. The goal is to ensure a consistent and high-quality user experience across all digital touchpoints, compliant with WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility standards, and capable of smoothly shifting between lower-intensity “Flame to Flame” periods and peak-demand “Games Time” moments. The experience must serve a global, multilingual audience and perform reliably during major traffic spikes.

**Team:** Design Lead, Multidisciplinary designers (UX, UI, motion, accessibility specialist), Project Manager, Design Directors, Content and Development teams.

**Timeline:** full time, 6 months with the possibility of prolongation

**Location: Madrid, Spain only. There is a possibility of working from the client’s office once a week.**

**Languages: Fluent English, Fluent Spanish is a plus.**

This role is the strategic and creative anchor of project, and the face of the client in Madrid. You own the vision and quality of a multi-platform design system spanning responsive web, native mobile (iOS and Android) and, potentially, connected TV (Apple TV, Android TV, Amazon Fire TV, Roku), across two fundamentally different operating modes: the high-intensity, real-time data environment and the editorial, content-discovery focus.

You look at the product as a whole, not ticket by ticket. You set the design direction, govern the design system, guide the team's craft and hold the day-to-day relationship with the client, in person in Madrid, ideally once a week.

You bridge strategic intent and hands-on delivery, so the team works to one vision and the client feels the difference.

### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Strategy & Client Partnership**

* Hold the strategic view of the product and turn its objectives, priorities and brand evolution into a clear design direction and a deliverable plan.
* Anticipate needs and frame decisions proactively; work with the Project Director on scope, estimates and growth opportunities.
* Act as the trusted creative partner to the client: lead day-to-day communication, build relationships with Product Managers, manage expectations, take feedback with composure, and present to senior stakeholders in a multi-vendor environment.
* **Be on site in Madrid, ideally weekly, for reviews, workshops and working sessions.**

**Design Quality & Team Leadership**

* Set and hold the quality bar: run critiques, review all significant output before it reaches the client, and give direct feedback.
* Manage and coach the remote delivery team (Senior Product Designers and Product Designers across European time zones); grow seniors into leads.
* Set briefs, manage sprint workloads, protect focus, and coordinate with vendors and engineering partners.
* Define quality gates, review workflows and design operations frameworks that scale across engagements.
* Stay hands-on for explorations, key screens and defining moments.

**Design System**

* Architect and govern an atomic design system (tokens, components, patterns) across responsive web, native mobile and connected TV.
* Design for high-density real-time data (live results, schedules, medals), editorial storytelling and content discovery, plus TV-specific interaction (remote navigation, 10-foot UI, lean-back viewing).
* Build in accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA), multilingual support and RTL from the start.
* Define contribution models, handoff protocols, documentation and versioning so client teams and vendors can extend the system safely.

**Design Engineering & AI**

* Work where design meets code: tokens, coded prototypes and the component library as living sources of truth.
* Use AI for prototyping, asset generation, automated QA and routine production; champion adoption with the team and client, with judgement on where craft stays human.

**Research & Validation**

* Shape and support user testing with the client and research partners, turning findings into design decisions.
* Build the evidence base for recommendations: testing, analytics and benchmarks.

### **PROFILE**

* Senior design leader (typically 10+ years) experienced in complex, large organisations with many stakeholders, vendors and governance.
* Background in major events, sports, broadcast or streaming preferred; live, real-time data experience is an advantage.
* Proven track record building and governing enterprise-scale, multi-platform design systems (web, native mobile, and TV).
* Fluent English (Spanish a plus), confident presenting to senior stakeholders.
* Based in Madrid, able to be on site ideally weekly (travel costs partially covered).
* Strategic, tasteful, calm under pressure and decisive; comfortable as the most senior design voice in the room.
* At ease with code, design tokens and AI-assisted workflows.

### **REQUIRED SKILLS & TOOLS**

* **Figma (expert) and design token tooling**
* **Coded prototyping and AI-assisted design tools**
* **CTV/OTT design constraints**
* **WCAG 2.1 AA (hard requirement)**
* Real-time data and live event design
* Standard project tracking, documentation and communication tools

title: Media Buyer / Creative Strategist
description:
**Media buying has changed.**

In 2026, a great media buyer is not just a button pusher. They understand the full system: creative, offer, conversion rate, platform dynamics, competition, and what to test next.

At Sweat Pants Agency, we are hiring a performance media buyer who can drive growth across **Meta** ads for DTC and ecommerce brands.

This role is for someone who can run paid media and **also think like a marketer**.

You will build testing roadmaps, guide creative strategy, communicate with clients, and help us scale what works.

**If you've built or scaled your own eCommerce brand, we want to hear from you.**

If you love following SOPs and repeating the same campaign structure forever, this is not the job.

If you love thinking, testing, and building frameworks that win, keep reading.

**We're growing fast and we keep the bar high.**

We believe the best media buyer today is a sharp marketer who uses AI every day. We built an internal creative analysis tool that connects to Claude, and we use Pipeboard to read and write to ad accounts and run heavy analysis. You don't need to know our stack yet. You do need to actually use AI in your work, not be afraid of it, and teach yourself what you don't know.

 **Requirements**  

### **What You'll Do**

* **Own paid media strategy for DTC/eCommerce clients** on Meta
* **Build creative testing roadmaps**: develop angles, write briefs for editors, analyze what's working
* **Manage ad budgets** ranging from $30k / mo to $1m / mo per client
* **Diagnose the full funnel**: spot whether issues are creative, offer, or conversion
* **Communicate clearly with clients**: present results, plans, and next steps
* **Work with UGC creators**: source talent, write scripts, direct content when needed

### **You're A Great Fit If...**

**You have hands-on experience scaling eCommerce brands:**

* You've managed Meta Ads with real spend and can show results (CPA, ROAS, revenue)
* Bonus: You've built/operated your own Shopify store or eComm brand

**You understand creative is the lever:**

* You can pull insights from reviews, competitor ads, and comments to generate new angles
* You've written UGC scripts or creative briefs
* You can work with editors to create winning ad variations
* Video editing or design skills are a plus

**You're a strategist, not a robot:**

* You challenge assumptions and adapt fast
* You don't blindly follow "best practices"
* You can explain what you're doing and why
* You use AI tools daily and teach yourself new ones

**You have ownership and urgency:**

* You act like it's your money
* You move fast and follow through
* You don't wait to be told what to do

 **Benefits**  

### **Why This Role Is Exciting**

This is not a maintenance job. You will be surrounded by people who move fast, care a lot, and take the work seriously.

**You will work on real brands with real budgets.** We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

**You will grow into senior strategy.** We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

title: Media Buyer / Creative Strategist (Remote)
description:
**Media buying is now the easy part.**

In 2026, the buying itself is piping. The levers that actually move a DTC account are creative, offer, and conversion rate, and the platform keeps getting better at rewarding whoever gets those right.

So we don't hire media buyers. We hire marketers who buy media.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands across our service lines, 20 to 25 of them on paid media, and we spend $6-9M a month on Meta. We're hiring one person to own a handful of those accounts end to end.

Here's what "end to end" actually means here.

**You are the account manager.** We don't have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership and accountability: when you're the person answering for the account, it's your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

**You are the creative strategist.** You do the research, you find the angles, and you write the briefs and the scripts. You direct our editors and designers rather than filing requests with them. Creative isn't a ticket you submit. It's your job.

**You build the things the account needs.** If conversion rate is the bottleneck, you build the landing page. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

**You carry up to six accounts.** That's the capacity we run at today, and the team averages about four and a half. You'll manage far fewer accounts than you would at most agencies. In exchange you get real ownership of the results and you get to work as an end to end marketer instead of one station on an assembly line.

**You can live anywhere.** We're a remote team and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you're the client's point of contact and there's nobody else to cover it. The rest of your day is yours.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we'll both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

**We're growing fast and we keep the bar high.**

We believe the best media buyer today is a sharp marketer who uses AI every day. We built an internal creative analysis tool that connects to Claude, and we use Pipeboard to read and write to ad accounts and run heavy analysis. You don't need to know our stack yet. You do need to actually use AI in your work, not be afraid of it, and teach yourself what you don't know.

 **Requirements**  

### **What the job looks like**

**Own 4 to 6 DTC accounts** as the strategist, the buyer, the creative lead, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $30k/mo to $1M/mo.

**Own the client relationship.** There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you're the one who answers when something isn't working.

**Run the research before the ads.** Marketing is 80% research here. You mine customer reviews, ad comments, support tickets, and Reddit for the language and objections that become angles. You pull competitor ad libraries. You run our internal tooling that OCRs and transcribes the ads in your account and ties them to performance, so you know what winning and losing actually look like in *this* account.

**Write the briefs and the scripts, and direct the work.** Creative direction is yours. You run revision rounds with our editors and designers and you hold the quality bar.

**Ship creative on a cadence.** Roughly 8 to 10 new ad launches a week is where accounts hold, in batches every 1 to 1.5 weeks. Informed volume, not spray and pray. We want better hypotheses, not more randomness.

**Build and test landing pages.** Advertorials, comparison pages, PDPs. Built in Claude Code, deployed to Vercel, tested live on a subdomain before anything gets pushed into the client's theme.

**Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it.** Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.

**Report on new customer economics.** We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended ROAS and not last click. You'll be expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.

### **You're a fit if**

**You've done this with real money.** Hands-on Meta at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them.

**You're AI-native, and you build.** This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude (or equivalent) as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it. If you can research, write, and build a converting page from scratch, we can teach you the buying.

**You can write direct response in English at a native or near-native level.** Hooks, scripts, ad copy, advertorial. In the customer's own words, not invented. This is the single biggest source of leverage in the role and the thing we screen hardest for. If writing persuasive English isn't a strength, this isn't the job.

**You can communicate your ideas.** This matters as much as anything else on this list. You'll be in front of clients constantly with nobody in between, so you need to be able to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire.

**You have taste and you know when to hand off.** You direct creative, you don't half-build it yourself. AI slop shipped to a client is a habit we break, not a shortcut we accept.

**You can work US Eastern business hours** for client calls. Where you live is up to you.

**Bonus:** you've built or operated your own Shopify store or eComm brand. Several of our team have, and it shows.

### **You're not a fit if**

* **"That wasn't my role" is in your vocabulary.** It's the fastest way to end an interview here. If creative was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the creative.
* You want to be told what to do this week.
* You need a ticketing system to know what matters.

 **Benefits**  

### **Why This Role Is Exciting**

This is not a maintenance job. You will be surrounded by people who move fast, care a lot, and take the work seriously.

**You will work on real brands with real budgets.** We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

**You will grow into senior strategy.** We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

**About Checkr**
Checkr is building the data platform to power safe and fair decisions. Over 140,000 companies and millions of people rely on Checkr for AI verification in the moments that matter most: getting a new job, a new place to live, a car ride, childcare, even a date. Customers include Uber, Pennymac, Airbnb, Doordash, and Anthropic.
  
  
We’re a team that thrives on solving complex problems with innovative solutions that advance our mission. Checkr is recognized on Forbes Cloud 100 2025 List and is a Y Combinator 2024 Breakthrough Company.
  
  
**About The Team/role**
Reporting to Checkr's VP of Marketing, the Creative Director, Head of Brand will set the creative vision for how Checkr shows up in the world, while owning and evolving our newly refreshed brand identity.
  
  
This role will lead Checkr's Brand Studio team and creative execution across Marketing's full portfolio of work, turning brand strategy into distinctive, memorable creative that builds recognition and preference for Checkr. The role will build brand into an operating system — clear standards, briefs, and review processes paired with AI-powered, self-serve tools — so the rest of the company can produce great work without the team touching every asset. Partnering closely with teams across Marketing, Internal Communications, HR, and Product, and advising executives on how Checkr shows up and is perceived, this leader will play a defining role in the company's reputation as it continues to grow.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Set and lead the creative vision for Checkr, translating brand strategy into distinctive ideas, campaigns, and experiences that build recognition and strengthen the brand over time
* Own and evolve Checkr's newly refreshed brand identity system — visual language, voice, and design standards — ensuring it's applied consistently and thoughtfully while continuing to push the brand creatively as the company scales
* Lead and inspire the Brand Studio team, raising the creative bar through strong direction, mentorship, and a high standard of craft, while continually exploring new ways of working — including AI tools and processes — used additively to extend the team's craft, never in place of it
* Lead the development of high-impact brand campaigns and creative platforms from concept through execution, bringing strong creative judgment to work across channels and formats
* Build brand into an operating system — standards, briefs, review cycles, and clear decision rights — paired with AI-powered, self-serve tools, and partner across Checkr to put those tools directly in every team's hands
* Define and track brand health (awareness, sentiment, consistency) to measure the impact of brand investment beyond individual campaigns
* Own creative execution and exercise final judgment on high-visibility brand moments — from campaigns and product launches to executive communications — ensuring the work is strategically sound, creatively distinctive, and executed at a high level of craft, including knowing when AI-generated work is off-brand or needs a human hand
* Advise Checkr's executives on brand positioning and narrative, and partner with Marketing leadership to align brand strategy with go-to-market priorities

**What You Bring**

* 10+ years of experience in creative and brand leadership
* including experience building or significantly scaling a brand function — not just maintaining one
* A strong portfolio of brand-building work demonstrating exceptional creative thinking, conceptual ability, and craft across campaigns, channels, and experiences
* A proven track record of developing distinctive creative ideas and translating brand strategy into work that earns attention and builds brand recognition
* Exceptional creative taste and judgment, with the ability to recognize great work, articulate what makes it great, and help teams make it better
* Demonstrated use of AI tools in real, shipped brand work, with a clear point of view on where automation belongs and where human judgment and craft are non-negotiable
* Proven judgment shaping brand and narrative at the company level, with experience advising executives on positioning
* Rigorous measurement instincts — defines and owns brand health metrics like awareness and sentiment as a discipline in their own right, alongside campaign performance
* Strong people leadership experience, with a track record of building, inspiring, and developing high-performing creative teams, and comfort operating with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment
* An A-player mindset with a strong bias for action: you raise the bar, move with urgency, stay resilient through ambiguity, and take ownership to deliver meaningful outcomes.

**Pay Transparency Disclosure**
*We use geographic cost of labor as an input to develop ranges for our roles and as such, each location where we hire may have a different range. If this role is remote, we have listed the top to the bottom of the possible range, but we will specify the target range for an exact location when you are selected for a recruiting discussion. For more information on our compensation philosophy, see*
*our website*
*.*
On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (San Francisco, CA)
  
  
$233,000—$274,000 USD
  
  
On-target Earnings OR Base Salary range (Denver, CO)
  
  
$197,000—$232,000 USD
  
  
**What We Offer**

* A fast-paced and collaborative environment
* Learning and development allowance
* Competitive cash and equity compensation, and opportunity for advancement
* 100% medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Up to $25K reimbursement for fertility, adoption, and parental planning services
* Flexible PTO policy
* Monthly wellness stipend

*At Checkr, we believe an in office work environment strengthens collaboration, drives innovation, and encourages connection. Our hub locations are Denver, CO; San Francisco, CA; Nashville, TN; and Santiago, Chile. Individuals are expected to work from the office 3+ days a week. In-office perks are provided, such as lunch five times a week, a commuter stipend, and an abundance of snacks and beverages. A relocation stipend may be available for those willing to relocate to a Checkr hub location.*
**Equal Employment Opportunities at Checkr**
*Checkr is committed to building the best product and company, which requires hiring talented and qualified individuals with a diverse set of perspectives and lived experiences. Checkr believes in hiring people of all backgrounds, including those whose histories are impacted by the justice system in accordance with local, state, and/or federal laws, including the*
*San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance*
*.*

If you are a California resident or are located in Alberta or British Columbia, our Applicant Privacy Policy applies to our collection and processing of your personal information when you apply for a role with us or otherwise participate in our recruitment process.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

title: Head of Design
description:
**Head of Design**

**Remote - United** **States**

**About the Role**

As Head of Design, you will lead Blackboard’s global User Experience and Design (UXD) organization and own the vision and strategy for how people experience our products, from Blackboard LMS and Blackboard Illuminate to Ally and our institutional effectiveness solutions. Your multidisciplinary team spans design, research, documentation, and accessibility, and works across web and mobile platforms in multiple countries and time zones.

This is a strategic leadership role. You will refine and evolve Blackboard’s design strategy, so it anticipates how teaching and learning are changing and drives measurable outcomes for our customers and our business. As a peer to leaders in Product Management and Product Development, you will make sure design shapes decisions from early discovery through delivery, and you will champion the value of design with executives, customers, and the wider design community.

You will also lead how design works in an AI-first era. We build the industry’s most AI-advanced LMS, and we expect our Head of Design to work hands-on with generative AI every day. That means using tools such as Figma Make, Claude Design, and other large language model (LLM)-based technologies to explore ideas, prototype, and test faster, and guiding the team to adopt them thoughtfully and responsibly.

Our design team is spread across multiple geographies including the UK, US, Colombia and Europe. You will lead it with flexibility and inclusion, building connection across locations and adjusting your own working hours when the business or the team needs you, so every colleague, in every time zone, has the access and support they need.

What does success look like? Products that solve complex problems with simplicity and elegance, a design culture of rapid iteration and continuous learning, and a team that is proud of both the work and the way it gets done.

**What You Will Do**

* Refine and evolve the design vision and strategy for Blackboard’s products, aligned with company strategy, product roadmaps, and business outcomes
* Lead, grow, and inspire a high-performing, diverse UXD organization across multiple countries and time zones, developing strong leaders at every level
* Partner with Product Management and Product Development leadership so design is integral to product planning, prioritization, and execution
* Champion the user across the product lifecycle through research, customer feedback sessions, and usability testing that inform decisions and validate solutions
* Lead the adoption of generative AI across the design practice, using tools such as Figma Make, Claude Code and other LLM-based technologies in your own daily work and setting clear standards for responsible use
* Own design operations, including design systems, tooling, workflows, and quality standards that help teams deliver consistent, accessible experiences at scale
* Hold accessibility and inclusive design as the standard for every experience we ship
* Build an agile culture that iterates quickly and refines solutions based on data, user insight, and cross-functional collaboration
* Define clear roles, responsibilities, and ways of working between design, product management, and development teams
* Present design strategy, research insights, and solutions to executive, customer, and industry audiences, making the value of design clear
* Manage budget, resourcing, and priorities so work is delivered on time and aligned with product and organizational goals
* Flex your working hours as needed to support business priorities and a team distributed across time zones
* Travel up to 20% to support teams, customers, and company events

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience
* At least 10 years of experience in user experience, product design, or a related field, including significant experience leading design leaders as well as individual contributors
* Proven experience building and scaling design organizations of 10+ professionals across disciplines such as Product Design, research, documentation, and accessibility
* Proven experience leading diverse, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries, regions, and time zones
* A track record of defining and refining design strategy at an executive level and connecting design to measurable user and business outcomes
* Hands-on, everyday fluency with generative AI design technologies such as Figma Make, Claude Design, Claude Code and other LLM-based tools, with a clear point of view on how AI is reshaping design practice
* Deep expertise in modern design tools, including Figma, prototyping, and design systems, plus working knowledge of web standards (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, usability, and accessibility)
* Strong expertise in engaging customers and users through design research, testing, and iterative feedback loops
* A record of delivering simple, elegant solutions to complex problems in highly agile environments
* Strong leadership skills and the ability to create a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing team culture
* Flexibility to work outside standard hours when needed to collaborate with colleagues, partners, and customers in other time zones
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex design concepts clear to any audience
* Experience with accessibility standards such as the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)
* Fluency in written and spoken English

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience in education technology or enterprise software as a service (SaaS)

**About Blackboard**

Blackboard is a leading EdTech company and SaaS provider that delivers the digital environment for transformational teaching and learning. We serve thousands of institutions with the industry's most AI-advanced LMS, Blackboard Ally for accessibility, and institutional effectiveness solutions that put educators and learners at the center. We're an education company that builds technology. Learn more at blackboard.com.

*The expected salary range for this position is $186,300 - $200,000. The range reflects base salary only and does not include additional compensation such as company bonus or benefits. Placement within the pay range will depend on a variety of factors, such as experience, skills, internal parity, and location.*

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based at the time of hire and must maintain that authorization for the duration of employment. The company does not provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position.

This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time.

Blackboard is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, gender, age, color, religion, national origin, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, protected military/veteran status, or any other legally protected factor.

title: Head of Brand & Impact
description:
A **profitable DTC pet brand doing $50M+ a year, scaling to $100M+, fully remote** is looking for an experienced brand consultant, freelancer or agency to lead our brand revamp and set our brand direction as Head of Brand & Community, on a project / consultant basis! You will own how people see and feel about our two brands: the brand story and identity, and the brand moments that build awareness and goodwill, including shelter and charity partnerships, activations and events, PR and community.

We are looking for someone who has **done it before** and really understands building a brand: creating brand moments and knowing how to actually make them happen, so we build our brand and brand awareness from the ground up. The ideal candidate has **7+ years** in brand, communications or brand marketing at consumer brands, a track record of building awareness through cause partnerships, events and PR, and has run campaigns for a North American audience.

### **The mission of this role**

Make our brands the most loved and trusted pet brands in North America, not just the most bought. You will own how people see and feel about our brands: a clear brand story and identity used everywhere, and the brand moments that build awareness and goodwill, including shelter and charity partnerships, activations and events, PR and community. Success is more people searching for us by name, more customers coming from word of mouth, more earned press, and a giving-back program customers know us for.

### **Who are we?**

We're a profitable DTC pet brand selling premium stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched a dog brand, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business.

### **What is our culture like & who is a good fit?**

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values:

* **Better Everyday**: review every brand moment against its goal, and make the next one bigger, cheaper or better.
* **Speed Is King**: jump on cultural moments and press opportunities the same day, and launch every brand moment on schedule.
* **Work Smart**: use partners, agencies and AI instead of a large team. For example, use Claude to draft press pitches and partner outreach, track media mentions, turn reviews into customer stories, and build the monthly brand-health report from search, survey and press data.
* **Overdeliver**: bring the CEO new partnership and brand-moment ideas before being asked, and get more press and goodwill from each moment than the plan called for.

**If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it.**

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place.

### **Outcomes (what success looks like)**

*90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date.*

* **More people know and search for our brands**: branded search volume and direct traffic, monthly vs the same month last year
* **More new customers come from word of mouth and press**: share of new customers who say friend, family, press or social (not an ad) in the post-purchase survey
* **We earn press and attention**: earned media mentions and their reach each quarter, including press from each brand moment
* **Our giving-back program makes a real, visible impact**: shelters partnered, pets helped, and product and dollars donated each quarter, shown on the website
* **The brand looks and sounds the same everywhere**: quarterly brand audit across website, packaging, ads, email and social

### **Key Objectives**

* Own the brand story, positioning, tone of voice and brand guidelines for both brands, and keep the two brands distinct.
* Design and run a giving-back program with shelter and rescue partners that customers know us for, and track its impact.
* Build the yearly brand-moment calendar and run each moment end to end: concept, partners, budget, website and email, social and creators, and press.
* Run pop-ups, events, sponsorships and stunts, each with its own budget and goal.
* Win earned media: pitch every brand moment, cause campaign and launch, directly or through a PR agency you manage.
* Build a super-fan community and turn customer reviews, photos and stories into brand content.
* Report brand health monthly and own the brand budget.

  
**Requirements**  

* Fully remote, project / consultant basis (freelancers, consultants and agencies welcome), based in Canada, the United Kingdom or Ireland
* Fluent in English
* **Brand Experience:** 7+ years in brand, communications or brand marketing at consumer brands is ideal; 5–6 years with strong results is also considered.
* **Brand Builder:** You have built awareness and goodwill for a consumer brand through causes, events and PR, not just design, ideally from an early stage.
* **Brand Moments:** You have planned and shipped brand moments end to end, on time and on budget, across many partners.
* **Cause Marketing:** You have run nonprofit or shelter partnerships that were real, measured and credible, not a logo on a page.
* **PR & Storytelling:** You turn a moment into a story that press and customers repeat, and you have the press wins to show for it.
* **North America:** You have run campaigns for a North American audience, and can run events and partners there remotely through agencies, partners and local contractors.
* **Brand Taste:** A sharp eye for what is on-brand, and you protect consistency across every touchpoint.
* **Commercial Mindset:** You tie brand work to measurable results like branded search, word of mouth and press.
* No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.
* *Bonus points:* pet industry experience.

### **Accountabilities**

*What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.*

* **Brand foundation and guidelines**: Own the brand story, guidelines and asset library for both brands, review new pages, packaging, emails and key ads before they go live, and run a quarterly brand audit across every touchpoint.
* **Cause and shelter partnerships**: Choose each brand's anchor causes with the CEO, sign and manage national and local shelter and rescue partners, run adoption events and donation drives, and track and report the impact.
* **Brand moments and activations**: Build the yearly brand-moment calendar (National Cat Day, National Dog Day, Clear the Shelters, Giving Tuesday and our own owned moment), run each one end to end, and hand its story and assets to the growth and creator teams.
* **PR and earned media**: Pitch press and podcasts directly or through a PR agency you manage, win reviews, gift-guide placements and awards, keep the press kit current, and track every mention.
* **Community and customer stories**: Turn reviews, photos and stories into brand content, build a super-fan community with surprise-and-delight moments, and make the website show the brand properly.
* **Brand reporting and budget**: Report brand health monthly, own the brand budget (events, donations, PR, sponsorships), set monthly Rocks with the CEO, and write SOPs so the playbook works without one person.

### **How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

(1) Application + Screening Interview

(2) In-Depth Interview with the CEO

(3) Reference Calls

(4) Final In-Depth Interview with the CEO

### **Salary Expectation**

**US$85,000–120,000 base per year** (based on experience and expertise), plus a bonus of 10–20% of base.

* **Brand Builder:** You have built awareness and goodwill for a consumer brand through causes, events and PR, not just design, ideally from an early stage.
* **Brand Moments:** You have planned and shipped brand moments end to end, on time and on budget, across many partners.
* **Cause Marketing:** You have run nonprofit or shelter partnerships that were real, measured and credible, not a logo on a page.
* **PR & Storytelling:** You turn a moment into a story that press and customers repeat, and you have the press wins to show for it.
* **North America:** You have run campaigns for a North American audience, and can run events and partners there remotely through agencies, partners and local contractors.
* **Brand Taste:** A sharp eye for what is on-brand, and you protect consistency across every touchpoint.
* **Commercial Mindset:** You tie brand work to measurable results like branded search, word of mouth and press.
* No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work.
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
* Excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founder.
* *Bonus points:* pet industry experience.

### **Accountabilities**

*What you own. Each one is checked green, yellow or red every week.*

* **Brand foundation and guidelines**: Own the brand story, guidelines and asset library for both brands, review new pages, packaging, emails and key ads before they go live, and run a quarterly brand audit across every touchpoint.
* **Cause and shelter partnerships**: Choose each brand's anchor causes with the CEO, sign and manage national and local shelter and rescue partners, run adoption events and donation drives, and track and report the impact.
* **Brand moments and activations**: Build the yearly brand-moment calendar (National Cat Day, National Dog Day, Clear the Shelters, Giving Tuesday and our own owned moment), run each one end to end, and hand its story and assets to the growth and creator teams.
* **PR and earned media**: Pitch press and podcasts directly or through a PR agency you manage, win reviews, gift-guide placements and awards, keep the press kit current, and track every mention.
* **Community and customer stories**: Turn reviews, photos and stories into brand content, build a super-fan community with surprise-and-delight moments, and make the website show the brand properly.
* **Brand reporting and budget**: Report brand health monthly, own the brand budget (events, donations, PR, sponsorships), set monthly Rocks with the CEO, and write SOPs so the playbook works without one person.

### **How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate**

(1) Application + Screening Interview

(2) In-Depth Interview with the CEO

(3) Reference Calls

(4) Final In-Depth Interview with the CEO

### **Salary Expectation**

**US$85,000–120,000 base per year** (based on experience and expertise), plus a bonus of 10–20% of base.

title: Head of Creative
description:
**Head of Creative**

**Department:** Marketing

**Reports to:** CMO

**Location:** London Bridge, London (hybrid)

**Role Type:** Full-time, permanent

**About Us**

At Cambridge Audio, we're a different sort of global audio company, resolutely independent and always authentic.

We're on a mission to break down barriers to top-tier sound, so it's not the exception, but the norm. It's what we've been doing for over 50 years, and we're only just getting started.

Our award-winning product lineup includes headphones, lifestyle audio, and premium hi-fi. We also own StreamMagic, our own music streaming platform, plus a music venue and bar called Melomania at our London Bridge HQ.

Work at Cambridge Audio is more than just a job. We're passionate about what we do, and have fun doing it, developing our skills and careers, plus those of the colleagues around us. Learn more at https://cambridgeaudio.com/about-us

**Our Culture**

A shared love for music and a commitment to exceptional products and customer experience drive us. With strong team spirit across our five global offices, our core values define our work:

  

* **Made By Music -** Inspired by shared passion and independence.
* **Pride in our product and service -** Obsess over detail, always learning and improving.
* **Embrace the culture -** Integrity, Innovation, Energy, Openness, Teamwork, Diversity, Flexibility, Fun, Music.
* **Make an impact -** See it through. Go the extra mile.

  

**About the Role**

We are looking for an exceptional person to join Cambridge Audio at a crucial time. We launched our new identity last year and have released a run of category-defining products through 2026, earning awards, critical acclaim and design accolades along the way. We need a Head of Creative to set the creative standard for what comes next. You will be the creative authority for the brand, responsible for the quality, consistency and impact of everything we put into the world, from product film and photography to web, print and live events. You will work closely with the CMO and the Head of PR and lead a small in-house creative studio. The company is small, the goals are demanding and the pace is high.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Set the creative vision:** Define and champion the creative direction across all channels (web, print, video, physical and digital), expressing our pillars: *Inspired by music. Crafted by design. Shaped by culture.*
* **Lead the function:** Own the creative team, workflow, budget and resourcing, blending in-house talent with agencies, copywriters and freelancers to deliver first-class work.
* **Lead the work from concept to delivery:** Art direct every shoot and campaign, owning the quality of the output and the results it delivers.
* **Own content direction:** Help shape and deliver a content strategy built around our brand pillars that reaches the right audiences, with a clear view of what success looks like.
* **Unite copy and design:** Direct tone of voice and copy alongside visual work. Own and evolve the brand guidelines and roll them out consistently across global markets.
* **Connect product and marketing:** Work with Engineering, Product and Marketing to shape creative requirements early in product development.
* **Be a voice of the brand:** Present the brand and creative direction to listeners, press, retailers and internal teams with confidence.
* **Build the process:** Put in place the planning, briefing and approval processes that let a small team deliver at pace without compromising standards.
* **Stay hands-on:** Pitch in and support design at busy times with the right skills and tools.

  

**Requirements**

  

* Creative Director/Head of Creative experience leading creative teams and external partners, including remotely, delivering on time and on budget across the campaign lifecycle from concept to delivery.
* A strong creative portfolio across multiple mediums and channels, including AV, Stills, Digital and ATL.
* Agency or similar in-house studio experience is essential.
* Passion for music, contemporary culture and technology.
* Deep understanding of how brand contributes to business growth, helping Cambridge Audio reach new audiences, drive product relevance, and open up new opportunities.
* Experience in hiring, nurturing and developing creative talent.
* Experienced in the use of and experimentation with AI as a copilot, or at least genuinely receptive and excited to experiment with AI design tools and integrate them into your workflow.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the confidence to represent the brand.
* Strong planning and project management skills in a small, scaling business.

  

**Desirable**

  

* Experience in technology and/or lifestyle businesses, Agency or publishing background
* Experience repositioning or evolving a brand with heritage
* Adobe Creative Suite proficiency and/or Web UX/UI experience.
* Understanding of how brand and creative drive business growth, product relevance and new audiences

  

**Personal Profile**

  

* Charismatic, personable and easy to work with.
* Driven, with the conviction to guide change and the drive to keep the brand relevant and ahead of the curve.

  

**Working Pattern & Duration**

Full-time, permanent.

**Location**

This role is based at our London Bridge HQ on a hybrid basis. We're looking for someone based in or near London who can be in the office regularly.

**Compensation**

Competitive salary based on experience.

**Benefits**

**Health & Wellbeing**

* Subsidised private healthcare (50:50 contribution)
* Annual wellness benefit pot covering 50% of life-enriching activities
* Annual life-enhancement training allowance
* 24/7 GP and Mental Health assistance

  

**Time & Flexibility**

* Charity volunteer days - 3 per year to support a cause of your choice
* 4pm finish on the last Friday of every month

  

**Social & Culture**

* Regular socials organised by our "Director of Fun"
* Annual team trips to surprise destinations
* 50% off gigs and festivals with our "Passion for Music" benefit

  

**Recognition & Rewards**

* Profit share scheme
* Colleague suggestion scheme to shape the way we work

  

**Equal Opportunities Statement**

Cambridge Audio is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. If you need any adjustments to the recruitment process, let us know.

**How To Apply**

Complete the form to submit your details with CV and cover letter. All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

Read our candidate privacy notice: https://www.cambridgeaudio.com/candidate-privacy-notice to see how we handle your data.

title: Art Director - all games
description:
Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox's top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 160 million monthly active players across our games, we are one of the biggest Roblox studios by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 95+ full-time remote team members across the globe.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

Voldex is looking for an **Art Director** to lead and scale our Art function across our growing portfolio of live-service games. You’ll lead and develop our Art Leads, strengthen how our teams operate, and ensure we continue delivering high-quality, distinctive art across our games.

This role is ideal for an experienced art leader who brings together **strong artistic judgment, exceptional people leadership, and a deep understanding of art production**. You’ll partner closely with Art Leads and cross-functional leadership to navigate creative, technical, and production challenges, while ensuring our teams have the right structure, resources, and support to do their best work.

We’re looking for someone who knows how to lead through other leaders—coaching and empowering Art Leads while maintaining a strong quality bar and helping the broader Art organization scale. If you’re passionate about building great teams and creating exceptional player experiences, we’d love to hear from you.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own the overall health, scalability, and performance of the Art function across all of Voldex’s games
* Lead, coach, and develop Art Leads, empowering them to own the visual direction and day-to-day leadership of their games independently
* Partner with Art Leads to establish, maintain, and evolve distinctive visual directions that resonate with each game’s players
* Maintain a portfolio-level view of art capacity, roadmap demand, delivery risks, and capability gaps across all games
* Allocate full-time and contract resources across competing priorities to ensure teams have the support needed to deliver their roadmaps
* Build and maintain a reliable network of high-quality art talent that can be engaged as needs change
* Lead art hiring end-to-end, partnering with Art Leads to source, evaluate, select, and onboard full-time, part-time, and contract talent
* Establish and improve art standards, workflows, review processes, and sign-offs that increase quality, consistency, and efficiency
* Partner closely with Product Managers, Producers, Engineers, and company leadership to translate product goals into clear and achievable art plans
* Guide Art Leads and cross-functional partners through tradeoffs involving artistic quality, technical performance, scope, and deadlines
* Ensure consistent, high-quality art delivery across all games without relying on sustained crunch
* Manage performance across the Art leadership team, including delivering direct feedback, supporting development, and addressing performance issues when necessary

**Who You Are**
---------------

* Proven leadership of an Art function supporting multiple games (ideally), products, or teams simultaneously, with accountability for overall quality, capacity, delivery, and performance
* Deep experience leading sizable art organizations, including managing teams of at least 25 full-time employees and directly managing multiple Art Leads or other art people managers
* A strong track record of coaching and developing Art Leads into stronger, more independent leaders, alongside extensive people management experience including difficult feedback, performance improvement, and terminations
* Experience overseeing distinct visual directions across multiple games or products, with the artistic judgment to maintain a high quality bar across different styles and audiences
* Strong artistic and technical expertise spanning 3D art, animation, 2D art, and technical art, including direct experience leading teams responsible for 3D asset creation
* Experience establishing technical art standards that balance visual quality with reliable performance across supported devices
* Strong art production and resource management experience, including portfolio-level capacity planning and allocating full-time and contract talent across competing priorities
* A track record of consistently delivering high-quality art against roadmap commitments without relying on sustained crunch
* Experience leading Art within a live-service environment with regular content and game updates
* End-to-end art hiring experience, from identifying capability gaps and partnering with recruiters on sourcing through evaluating artistic and technical talent and making hiring decisions
* Experience building and scaling teams using a mix of full-time, part-time, and freelance/contract talent as production needs change
* Experience hiring and managing distributed, international teams across multiple markets and time zones

**Nice to Have**

* Experience serving as the senior-most leader of an Art organization, including reporting to a leader outside of the art discipline
* Roblox Studio and Roblox development experience, with an understanding of the platform’s technical and performance considerations
* Experience working within an art organization of similar size or complexity to Voldex, ideally managing teams of 40+ full-time employees
* Experience overseeing art across multiple game genres, audiences, and visual styles simultaneously
* Experience working on games involving external brand or IP partnerships with specific creative guidelines, approvals, or requirements
* A strong network of art talent and experience independently sourcing and hiring freelance or part-time artists as needs arise

**Tech Stack**
--------------

Please see below Voldex’s art stack in case you are interested:

* Roblox Studio
* Blender
* Photoshop
* Substance Painter
* Blender
* Maya
* Figma

*Voldex is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status*

**Permanent Voldex employees enjoy the following benefits:**

Competitive compensation - above-market salary + profit sharing + stock options

Retirement benefits - company contribution to your retirement plan (401k, RRSP, Pension), in Canada, UK and USA!

Medical, dental, and vision benefits - depending on the country, there may be additional benefits (Life, ADD, etc…) such as Canada, UK and USA.

Flexible PTO - vacations + Federal / Bank Holidays

Remote First - we have always been remote and will remain that way including work from home/anywhere

In-person get-togethers, virtual company-wide game events, Robux allowances, and so much more!

Professional Development - Reimburse the costs of courses, materials, and anything to help further their training and growth

Work with awesome people and impact millions of daily players

**Want to learn more about Voldex? Read about us here:**

* Voldex Acquires Brookhaven, most visited game on Roblox
* Driving Empire & NASCAR: Brand Partnership

title: Creative Director
description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

**Job Description**
===================

Location:

London, GB

Condé Nast is a global media company, home to iconic brands including Vogue , GQ , Glamour , CN Traveller , Vanity Fair , Wired , The World of Interiors , House & Garden and Tatler , among many others.

We are headquartered in New York and London and operate in 32 markets worldwide, with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers across print, digital, video and social platforms.

Condé Nast thrives on collaboration, and our teams come together in the office four days a week (Monday - Thursday).

We value diversity of background, views and cultures. We celebrate people for their personal qualities, skills and contributions, recognising the power our brands have to influence and shape culture.

Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company’s portfolio includes many of the world’s most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, Self, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others.

Based in our London office, this role helps to set the creative vision and leads the overarching delivery of global and UK branded content, advertiser partnerships, and brand marketing across Condé Nast’s editorial portfolio. As a culturally attuned, conceptual leader, you will drive 360° creative strategy that connects brands to culture at scale. You bring a track record of editorially inspired work, natural mentorship, and the capability to deputise for the Executive Creative Director—aiding in guiding the department vision, setting creative standards, and inspiring the wider team.

Reporting to the Executive Creative Director, you will partner with senior marketing, strategy, and sales leaders to shape major commercial opportunities, pitch transformative partnership ideas, and oversee cross-departmental execution with editorial teams. Success requires visionary storytelling, deep commercial strategy, and a sharp cultural perspective. The Creative Director oversees overall portfolio output, establishing the creative direction and directing senior talent on high-stakes, multi-platform briefs—from global luxury video campaigns to multi-market event sponsorships.

You excel at guiding cross-functional teams through complex, fast-paced workflows, bringing executive-level problem-solving and strategic clarity to every meeting. The ideal candidate ensures creative excellence while safeguarding Condé Nast’s brand authority, creative standards, and journalistic integrity across all commercial initiatives.

Individual & Team Responsibilities

* Develop bold multi-channel creative work that reflects the voice and ethos of all Condé Nast titles for advertisers across categories.
* Assign, collaborate with and direct the work of multi-disciplinary creatives suitable for each project (art directors, designers, etc).
* Apply strategic insights in order to craft inventive content, experiential solutions, and partnership ideas that align with audience data, brand ethos, and client objectives.
* Direct video and photo shoots with a focus on performance and editorial quality.
* Serve as the primary creative client liaison on campaigns—presenting work, managing feedback, and guiding creative integrity across production.
* Drive brainstorms and work hands-on when crafting proposals and presentations.
* Propose creative solutions that fit within the provided budgets.
* Ensure all commercial ideas authentically balance the voices and perspectives of our editorial brands with those of our advertising partners.
* Help build a thriving creative department; nurture talent, establish workflow efficiencies, and champion inclusive, forward-thinking creative culture.
* Deputise for the Executive Creative Director across key business forums, internal leadership meetings, and executive client pitches.

Essential Skills & Requirements

* 10+ years of experience as a creative lead in premium media or agency environments.
* A demonstrated appreciation for the subject matter and creativity of the brands you’ll represent at Condé Nast.
* Confidence working with and directing artists, experts, celebrities and creators as talent on commercial projects.
* Strong portfolio showcasing work across print, digital, video and events.
* Passion for brand marketing, with a sharp cultural perspective that informs consumer-facing campaigns.
* Skilled storyteller with excellent written, visual, and verbal presentation abilities.
* Extensive on-set experience and deep knowledge of video and photography production, from pre- to post-production (for digital and print).
* Demonstrated success managing creative teams and working within established systems to improve output and efficiency.
* A creative aesthetic emphasizing current standards in entertainment, fashion, luxury and design.
* Highly organized, adaptable and adept at prioritizing workloads in fast-paced environments.
* Ability to work fluently with collaborators in production - writers, DPs, photographers, editors, animators, and designers.
* Proficiency in Google Slides and treatment deck creation. Bonus: familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and editing software.

Desired Qualities:

* Culturally informed - Current on music and entertainment, luxury and fashion, as well as knowledgeable about Condé Nast brands and culture. Additionally, have awareness of relevant artists, and creative vendors.
* Highly imaginative - You’re a conceptual creative with innovative ideas that challenge outdated approaches to content and the definition of “experiential.”
* Detail-oriented - Equally obsessed with creating memorable work and impactful campaigns that solve our client’s challenges.
* Agile and adaptable - Open to taking input from others and willing to take on essential tasks needed to get the job done.
* Think critically - You strive to come up with ideas that solve brand challenges, can manage multiple projects at once, and know when to pivot if something isn’t working.
* Have an ego-less attitude - You give credit where credit is due, bring a positive attitude to work and support your teammates in gaining visibility and opportunities.
* A natural mentor - You prioritize diversity, inclusivity, and representation in every stage of the creative process and empathy in team collaboration.

What benefits do we offer?

* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) and extra days of annual leave if you move house or want to volunteer.

* You’ll have access to a competitive pension scheme , Bupa Private Healthcare , Season ticket loans and eye tests.

* We offer a range of tools to support your wellbeing, including core hours , 10 remote days (from home or a country with a Condé Nast office location), access to our Employee Assistance Programme , corporate gym membership and cycle to work scheme.
* We’re a dog-friendly office , plus you’ll enjoy discounts and magazine subscriptions , keeping you up to date with all things Condé Nast.

* We encourage personal and professional growth through the Condé Nast Learning Hub, where you’ll find an extensive portfolio of learning courses and training available in local languages.
* Our Employee Resource Groups provide a platform for employees to identify shared objectives, exchange ideas, and work on community priorities for our global workforce.

**What happens next?**
======================

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.

***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***
