description:
Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies with an iconic portfolio of brands across fragrance, color cosmetics, skin care and body care. COTY is the global leader in fragrance and number three in color cosmetics. COTY’s products are sold in over 150 countries around the world. COTY and its brands are committed to range of social causes as well as seeking to minimize its impact on the environment. For additional information about Coty Inc., please visit www.coty.com.
  
  
**MISSION**
Reporting to the SVP Brand & Equity, the role of Creative Strategy Snr Director, Consumer Beauty will be fully responsible for leading creative strategy across the iconic brands within the CB portfolio: across Color cosmetics and Mass scenting.
  
  
This pivotal role will partner with the creative teams and brand teams to enable disruptive thinking, ideas and execution – writing innovative creative strategy, cultural levers and conceptual ideas borne of consumer insight.
  
  
This is a hybrid role, half strategist half creative. The Creative Strategy Snr Director – Consumer Beauty might need to write a headline one day, write a compelling pithy presentation the next, a script the next, and think through what the cultural springboard is for a brand or a campaign. Or take the SVP’s place in a creative review to ensure the work is clear, effective and impactful, and refined until delivery. All while taking pressure off the SVP to free up focus for higher-level priorities.
  
  
Coty is a challenger brand; work is intense and entrepreneurial. It is agile and fast. Immediacy and hands on attitude is critical. Autonomy is pivotal.
  
  
Please note that whilst this position will be based in our Wimbledon Office, we do offer a flexible Omni-working policy which means that up to 50% of your hours will be based from the office and the remaining 50% of your hours can be remote.
  
  
**THE ROLE**

* Leading Creative strategy across the iconic brands within the Consumer Beauty portfolio.
* A unicorn with the ability to write disruptive creative strategy, borne of consumer insight, and concept ideas with the creatives.
* Critical ability to write in a pithy and provocative way, with fearless clarity.
* Partner with the creative teams to enable disruptive thinking, ideas and execution – helping generate vital creative thought starters which can be further developed.
* Pivotal ability to help teams (creative and brand) ‘see’ the idea amongst the clutter of creative development; articulating, expanding, and presenting story telling in a way that becomes unmissable and strategically flawless.
* Develop product claims and (both traditional and contemporary) to create something innovative that the world cannot miss!
* Responsible for creative strategy across color cosmetics, personal care, nail and mass scenting/fragrance.
* Social first thinker - with the ability to brand build in the new Meta led landscape our brands now live in.
* Connected to global culture, knowledgeable.
* GLOBAL - this is global business. Must be well versed in US beauty, as well as European beauty.
* A realist - not precious – if it doesn’t work or is too highbrow, move on!
* Hand-On. Not a floater waiting for other to action.

**What You’ll Bring**
Knowledge and Experience:
  
  

* 15+ years experience in an agency/in-house brand creative strategist.
* Global in outlook
* TikTok and socially savvy.
* Consumer first thinker.
* Ability to co-create with the SVP Brand & Equity, the creative teams, third parties and the brand teams within a highly collaborative environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels of hierarchy with both multifunctional partners and with external stakeholders.
* A ‘roll the sleeves up do-er’ not a floater. We are an entrepreneurial set of people that think and do, and we do it fast.
* Ability to work autonomously under pressure.
* Agile and adaptable as the business and brand environment changes daily.
* Experienced in the new beauty world - not the old traditional world.
* A good beauty aesthete - this person needs judgment and an eye. They will take responsibility for the work being on brand, on strategy and effective (passing IPSOS tests, and driving in market growth)

**REQUIRED SKILLS:**

* Ability to think creatively, highly-driven and self-motivated.
* Digitally literate and culturally plugged in.
* Well versed in UK/EU/Global mass consumer beauty universes (color cosmetics and fragrance)
* Ability to work in an international business context.

**CONCLUDING**
You’ll get to work in a diverse and environment with a team who are passionate about the work they do and know how to have some fun along the way. Our people make us who we are. They are the brightest minds bringing the boldest ideas to life every day. If you’re the kind of person who refuses to settle, if you want to think bigger, learn faster and go further than you ever thought possible, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Partner, Influencer Creative Strategy
description:
Brainlabs is the independent, founder-led agency building the future of media. We have over 1000 Brainlabbers based across the global, all united through the 12 principles laid out in our Culture Code. We're full-service, with people and AI agents working side by side, all aligned to one thing: maximizing our clients' revenue through a genuinely scientific approach to media. If you want to help play your part in achieving this for the world's biggest brands in an environment that will support and challenge you in equal measure, this is where you do it.
  
  
**What's The Role**
Newly Launched Brainlabs Creates is at an inflection point - growing fast, winning bigger briefs, and ready to make a serious statement about what great influencer marketing looks like. The Head of Creative Strategy is the person who shapes what that statement is. This is a senior, cross-functional role that owns two things simultaneously: the creative quality of our new business responses and the creative identity of Brainlabs Influencer as a brand. It is a rare opportunity to define a practice's voice from the inside, working alongside some of the sharpest commercial minds in the industry.
  
  
**What You Do**

* Lead the creative strategy offering across new business pitches and growth opportunities, shaping the central creative idea that sits at the heart of every response.
* Define and drive the Brainlabs Influencer brand identity — articulating who we are, what we stand for, and what makes our creative approach distinct in the market.
* Help to develop the visual brand identity for Brainlabs Influencer, translating strategic positioning into a coherent, recognisable aesthetic.
* Think beyond social executions: champion community-led campaign platforms, cultural ideas, and bold new creative territories that raise the bar for clients.
* Write compelling creative briefs, develop pitch decks, playbooks, and client-facing materials to a standard that sets the team apart.
* Coach and elevate the broader influencer team's creative thinking, running workshops, reviews, and critiques that make the work braver and more ambitious.
* Own the creative narrative through the full pitch process, from first brief to the room itself
* Supervise the team's day-to-day creative output, ensuring quality and consistency while delegating effectively so you can focus on the highest-impact work.
* Build strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, bringing creative vision and commercial understanding to every interaction.
* Flex across influencer-first and media-first briefs, adapting tone of voice and creative approach depending on the needs of the response.
* Integrate AI tools into the creative process, from ideation to content production, and help the team do the same.

**Who You Are**

* You have a genuine point of view on culture, creativity, and what makes influencer marketing actually interesting — and you're not afraid to push for it.
* You can move between big-picture brand thinking and hands-on craft: writing a brief, shaping a deck, or steering a pitch without needing to be coaxed into the detail.
* You're energised by building something from scratch - defining an identity, establishing a way of working, leaving a mark on how a team thinks.
* You bring out the best in people around you: your feedback is specific, your standards are high, and you make the team feel capable of more than they thought.
* You're as comfortable in a new business pitch as you are in a client workshop - you read the room, land the idea, and move things forward.
* You think in platforms and communities, not just posts - you're always asking how a campaign can become something people actually want to be part of.

**How You Succeed**

* You live our culture code every day!
* New business pitches are won with a strong creative point of view at their centre.
* Brainlabs Influencer's brand identity is clear, consistent, and recognisable in market.
* The influencer team's creative output improves visibly through your coaching and standard-setting.
* Creative ideas are grounded in measurable outcomes and built to be tested and iterated.
* Senior client relationships are strong and you are seen as a trusted creative voice.
* AI tools are embedded into the team's creative workflow in a way that accelerates quality, not just speed.

**What happens next?**
We know searching for a job is tough and that you want to find the best career and employer for you. We also want to ensure that this position is the best fit for both you and us. Therefore, you will participate in a comprehensive interview process that includes skills interviews with our team. The goal of this process is to allow you to get to know us as we learn more about you.
  
  
**A note on our offices:**
We pride ourselves in being a company with an office-centric culture and, for the majority of roles we expect people to be in commuting distance of the office and come in for around 3 days per week.
  
  
*Brainlabs actively seeks and encourages applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds and identities. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace: we are committed to equal opportunity for all applicants and employees regardless of age, disability, sex, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion, or belief, and marriage and civil partnerships. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the application process, please let us know!*
*For details regarding our data processing activities, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice*
**Protect Yourself from Job Scams:**
We've been made aware of fraudulent job offers circulating in Brainlabs' name. Your safety is our priority, so please stay vigilant. Brainlabs will never ask you to transfer money, pay for a job opportunity, or request sensitive information such as Social Security numbers, banking details, or passwords via email, WhatsApp, or unsecured channels. Our official hiring communications only come from verified email domains (@brainlabsdigital.com, @brainlabs.ai, @exverus.com, @jacknimble.com.au, @sparro.com.au) and trusted platforms including Greenhouse, Upwork, Yuno Juno, and Remote. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Brainlabs, do not engage. Instead, forward it immediately to security@brainlabsdigital.com. We're committed to protecting our community and ensuring a safe candidate experience. Thank you for your vigilance.

title: Head of Creative
description:
**Intro**

 

Founded by sisters Louisa and Rebecca, Regalrose is a British-born ecommerce jewellery retailer with over 15 years in business. Specialising in uniquely designed jewellery and accessories with a fierce edge and dreamy-dark twist, Regalrose is going from strength to strength as demonstrated by our exceptional growth over the last few years. We have built up a loyal community of passionate fans and customers, delivering our products to over 80 countries worldwide. We are now looking for an outstanding and experienced Head of Creative to join our team in our offices, located in St Albans.

 

 

**About You**

 

You will be a driven, self-motivated creative leader with an exceptional eye for brand and at least 10 years’ creative experience, or experience running a creative function as a Head of, Director or Senior Manager – ideally in fashion, jewellery or accessories. You will hold very high standards, make fast, confident creative calls under pressure, balance creativity with commercial awareness, and stay hands-on with asset creation while leading a team.

 

 

**Requirements and Skills**

 

As Head of Creative, you will be the guardian of the Regalrose brand – owning how it looks, sounds and feels across every channel, campaign and the website. Working from the founders’ vision, you will turn each collection into concepts, briefs, photography, copy and assets, lead the in-house creative team and have final creative approval on all outward-facing marketing. You will work as a peer to the Head of Marketing, who owns the commercial and go-to-market plan.

 

 

**The Role and Accountabilities**

Overall goal: Protect and grow the Regalrose brand by ensuring every piece of marketing and website output is on brand, to the highest standard and right first time.

 

*Brand guardian:*


 

* Final creative decision-maker, with a brand veto on any marketing output.
* Own the brand guidelines, copy and content rules, tone of voice, and social narrative and seasonal themes.
* Keep the brand culturally relevant, filtering trends and performance insight through the brand lens.

*Collection & campaign launches:*


 

* Turn the founders’ campaign vision into concepts, themes and the creative brief for every launch.
* Develop the founders’ photoshoot concepts and lead photoshoot direction.
* Own copywriting, artboard production and delivery of all assets; approve all copy, emails and assets before launch.

*Channel & website creative:*

 

* Assets, copy and tone of voice for paid media, social, CRM, blog, PR and the website (product descriptions, e-commerce imagery, banners).

*Partnerships:*

 

* Set the creator criteria across the four influencer pillars, sign off creator content and make the final call on Muse creators.
* Own the content of paid and brand collaborations; identify licence and influencer collaboration candidates.

*Leadership & budget*
**:**

 

* Line manage the in-house creative team (currently Graphic Designer and Content Creator) and external creative suppliers.
* Own the creative production budget and decide whether new or ad-hoc go-to-market elements can be resourced.
* Present creative strategy to the founders at agreed steer points; collaborate with the Head of Marketing and other department leads.

 

This is not an exhaustive list of tasks.

 

 

**Qualifications Required**

* 8+ years’ creative experience, or experience running a creative function (Head of, Director or Senior Manager)
* Ideally from a fast-paced retail, fashion or jewellery/accessories brand; ideally degree qualified in a creative discipline
* Brand management across digital, social, CRM, web, print and packaging
* Art direction of shoots and video; strong copywriting and editing
* Hands-on with Adobe Suite (specifically Illustrator), CapCut and Klaviyo
* Creative team leadership and budget ownership

 

Due to the nature of our business, our peak time stretches from November to January. As a small yet growing business, annual leave must be kept to a minimum during those months.

 

 

**Regalrose Values**

At Regalrose, we don’t follow trends, we create them – putting our customers at the heart of everything we do. Together we turn ideas into reality, always pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. If you're ready to make an impact and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want you with us.

 

 

**Team Structure**

 

Line Manager: Managing Director

 

Direct Reports: In-house creative team (currently Graphic Designer and Content Creator)

 

Works closely with: Founders, Head of Marketing, Social Media Executive, Buying & Merchandising, Quality Control and Customer Experience.

 

 

**Salary & Benefits**

 

Salary range: £55-£70K

* Employee discount
* Bonus scheme
* Flexitime
* Casual dress
* Company events
* Health & wellbeing programme
* Free on-site parking
* Taxi service provided from train station
* Enhanced Sick pay

 

**Hours:**

Flexitime Monday to Friday between the hours of 8.00am – 5pm (37.5 hours per week – 7.5 hours per day).

 

 

**Job Type:**

Full-time, Permanent, 4 days on-site and 1 day remote per week.

 

 

**Location:**

Office based role (4 days per week), St Albans, AL3 6PA

 

 

**Application Details:**

Please send your cover letter to careers@regalrose.co.uk explaining how you would be suitable for the role, along with your up-to-date CV and portfolio.

title: Creative Director
description:
Ibotta is seeking a
**Creative Director**
to join our innovative team and contribute to our mission to Make Every Purchase Rewarding. As Creative Director, you will shape how the world sees Ibotta as a leading technology company, elevating our look and feel across all enterprise marketing and communications while ensuring on-time delivery and efficient operations.
  
  
You will lead our creative studio to develop distinctive brand assets and impactful campaigns that build Ibotta's awareness and grow advertising revenue in the CPG industry. The ideal candidate will bring a blend of strategic thinking, creative excellence, and team leadership to drive our brand's impact and growth. This leader will be expected to have proficiency in design, copywriting, or video production, and will be asked to roll up their sleeves as a practitioner to guide execution and help the team produce exceptional work.
  
  
This position is located in Denver, Colorado as a hybrid position requiring 3 days in office (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday). Candidates must live in the United States.
  
  
**Not based in Denver? We will offer a relocation bonus to help make your move to the Mile High City a smooth one.**
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Build corporate brand identity and creative guidelines for Ibotta to show up visually and experientially across every touchpoint with distinction.
* Lead and mentor a diverse team of creative professionals across design and production, fostering a culture of proven concept, craft, and collaboration while ensuring consistent creative execution.
* Partner closely with product, analytics, marketing, and leadership teams to drive brand consistency and elevate Ibotta's market presence.
* Help translate complex product offerings, data, and value propositions into clean, engaging creative concepts.
* Establish and optimize operational processes to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability of creative output.
* Lead creative reviews, provide actionable feedback, and foster a culture of craft, curiosity, and innovation.
* Serve as a key brand ambassador internally and externally, articulating creative vision and strategy clearly across all levels of the organization.
* Manage team health, resource planning, and talent strategy, ensuring the right capabilities, skills, and staffing are in place to meet business needs.
* Embrace and uphold Ibotta’s Core Values: Integrity, Boldness, Ownership, Teamwork, Transparency, & A good idea can come from anywhere

**What We Are Looking For**

* 8+ years of experience as a hands-on creative with a proven track record across diverse media (agency and in-house). In-house experience is strongly preferred.

**About The Role**
The Experience Design Lead (Creative Director) is the vision-holder for how fans interact with the future of EA SPORTS, reporting to the Sr. Director of EA SPORTS Network. Serving as the design and user-experience anchor of the Network leadership team, this leader is responsible for transforming complex, shared platform and network capabilities into intuitive, memorable, and high-fidelity consumer experiences.
  
  
Rather than focusing on a single franchise or product, this role defines the design principles, reusable experience systems, and connected fan journeys that weave individual games (such as Madden NFL, FC, and College Football) into a cohesive, immersive EA SPORTS ecosystem. This role will be a visionary design leader who can establish and scale the Experience Design function for SPORTS Network, instill a design-centric culture across the team, and champion design innovation in partnership with studios and design partners within EA SPORTS.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
Experience Strategy:
  
  

* Ecosystem Experience Vision: Define the long-term, multi-platform vision for a connected EA SPORTS experiences, spanning console, mobile, web, and companion applications.
* Consumer-First Design Principles: Translate strategic growth objectives into high-caliber consumer experience principles that put the fan journey at the center.
* Ecosystem Roadmaps: Author and drive long-term experience design roadmaps that anticipate and support future portfolio growth and platform capabilities.

**Connected Fan Experiences**

* Unified Journeys: Map and refine end-to-end fan journeys that connect multiple EA SPORTS experiences, standardizing how identity, personalization, recognition, commerce, and community are experienced.
* Scalable Design Systems: Establish, govern, and continuously evolve scalable design systems, UI/UX toolkits, and reusable interaction models across the portfolio.
* Preserve Franchise Identity: Balance the need for network-wide experience consistency with the unique, highly branded visual identity of individual sports franchises.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* The Leadership Triad: Partner directly with the Sr. Director of Product Management and Technical Director to build a user-centered development lifecycle where design, technology, and business goals align.
* Experience Workshops: Lead collaborative experience workshops and build alignment around shared consumer experiences across different team boundaries.
* Influence without Authority: Guide design direction and build consensus across disparate teams, studios, and brand partners through collaboration rather than direct authority.

**Experience Innovation & Data Informed Design**

* Emerging Interactions: Explore and prototype next-generation interaction models, including AI-enabled personalization, spatial design, and real-time sports feed integrations.
* Data-Informed Iteration: leverage user research, player data, and run experience design workflows to continuously iterate and elevate experiences.

**Your Qualifications**

* Experience: 10+ years of experience leading UX, Product Design, Experience Design, or Creative Direction for world-class, large-scale digital consumer ecosystems or entertainment products.
* Ecosystem Design: A strong portfolio demonstrating the creation of unified, multi-platform design systems and seamless consumer journeys across web, mobile, and console.
* Experience leveraging AI in prototyping and creative or design concepting.
* Strategic Execution: Proven ability to balance high-level creative strategy with operational execution and governance.
* Tooling & Workflows: Mastery of Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, advanced prototyping tools, and modern collaborative design workflows.
* Storytelling: Exceptional executive storytelling, visual communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of building alignment through influence.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Digital Media, or equivalent experience.

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

title: Design Director
description:
Design Directors lead the creative heart of a project, from early ideas to final delivery. You’ll set the vision, guide designers and writers through execution, and bring clarity and perspective to every stage of the work. You’re someone who can turn strategy into concepts, concepts into systems, and systems into beautiful, functional design, while helping the team and our clients see where an idea can go. You have a sharp eye for craft, communicate clearly and generously, and stay curious about new tools and where design is headed.
  
  
At Rudy, everyone designs, directors included. Staying hands-on is how we stay sharp, stay current and keep our work honest. Design Directors are leaders, collaborators and co-authors who move easily between making the work and guiding it. You’ll lead brands built from scratch, refreshes of established ones, and work that brings clarity to complex challenges across digital, physical and experiential touchpoints. You’re confident making creative calls and know how to bring out the best in the people around you.
  
  
We’re looking for unique talent: people who take creative risks, have a real appetite for experimentation, and are excited to push what’s possible, with past work that shows it. You’re curious, culturally tuned-in, and drawn to work that has both conceptual depth and visual ambition.
  
  
**This Role Will Have You**

* Lead design and creative direction across brand identity, systems, campaigns, digital, print and everything in between
* Design hands-on alongside the team, from early explorations to final craft
* Guide designers, writers and interns from exploration through execution, with clear direction and feedback
* Shape strategy into creative: turn research and messy inputs into compelling concepts and clear directions
* Partner with studio leadership, strategists, technologists and collaborators to bring ideas to life
* Shape and share the work with clients, building trust and bringing them along on the thinking
* Champion experimentation, AI-enhanced workflows and non-linear exploration, and push the work into new territory
* Hold a high bar for detail, quality and conceptual integrity across every project
* Mentor the team and help foster a studio culture of critique, generosity and play

**You Might Be a Great Fit If**

* You have 8+ years of experience in branding, digital design or adjacent creative fields, including leading projects
* You still love to make things, and you have a hard time imagining not designing
* You have mastery of the fundamentals – layout, type, hierarchy, storytelling – and more importantly, can teach them
* You take smart risks and are energized by ideas that haven’t been tried yet
* You love the big swing and the tiny detail, and know which one a project needs
* You have range: you can lead identity, digital and campaign work without losing clarity
* You give feedback that makes work and people better, and welcome it in return
* You value craft, but you’re not precious – you iterate, explore and evolve until the work sings

**Bonus Points For**

* Experience directing motion, 3D or illustration
* Fluency in Figma, AI workflows, prototyping tools and modern digital design practices
* Interest in culture, ideas, technology and the future of what creative studios can be

**Compensation And Benefits**

* Salary: $110 - $130k, plus quarterly profit sharing and performance bonuses
* 401(k) retirement plan
* 3 weeks paid vacation, plus paid sick days
* Two-week studio closure at the end of the year, plus culture-forward holidays
* Medical, dental and vision insurance, with premiums covered for individuals
* Complimentary access to wellness and mental health services
* Life insurance
* Annual company retreat
* 2 weeks a year to work from any time zone
* 6 Learning Days a year
* One design event, festival or conference a year, on us
* Pre-tax commuter benefits and FSA

This is a hybrid role based in our Chinatown, NYC studio. We have a strong preference for NYC-based candidates, but are open to remote for the right person, working East Coast hours.
  
  
Email us your portfolio, resume and a note on why you’d like to join us – and include ‘Design Director’ as the subject line: jobs@ru-dy.com

title: Principal Creative Director, AI Video

title: Creative Director, Filmmaker for Brand Storytelling
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.**Roku is changing how the world watches TV**

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What is the role?

The Creative Director/Filmmaker — Brand Storytelling leads the concept, development, and production of Roku-produced brand commercials, video idents, experience videos, and other high-impact brand films within the Creative Studio. This is a hands-on creative leadership role for an exceptional storyteller who can find the simple, ownable, and entertaining idea, shape compelling narratives within the world of Roku City, and guide the creative vision from first pitch through post-production. You will turn brand and business objectives into entertaining, visually distinctive work that strengthens Roku's cultural relevance, recognition, and audience connection. The role requires both creative ambition and practical fluency across editorial, animation, visual effects, sound, color, and finishing. You will lead stories that can be funny, surprising, emotional, or all three—using comedy, character, visual invention, live-action sensibility, animation, and emerging production techniques. This role partners closely with an AI-assisted, in-house production team to establish creative standards, develop treatments and scripts, direct development, and bring the work to life with speed, flexibility, and craft. You will be accountable for ensuring work is high-quality, on-brand, emotionally resonant, and delivered efficiently across campaigns, products, and global markets.

For California Only - The estimated annual base salary for this position is between $209,400 - $232,800.

Compensation packages are based on factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, certifications, and specific geographical location.

This role is eligible for health insurance, equity awards, life insurance, disability benefits, parental leave, wellness benefits, and paid time off.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.

We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

* Lead end-to-end creative development of Roku Creative Studio brand commercials, video idents, experience videos, and related brand storytelling—from brief and insight through concept, treatment, script, visual development, production, post-production, and final delivery
* Define the creative point of view for each project, establishing the story, tone, visual language, comedic approach, performance direction, pacing, sound, and craft standards
* Write, develop, or collaborate on scripts, treatments, storyboards, beat sheets, visual references, and production plans
* Direct the creative process across live-action-inspired, animation, visual effects, motion, and AI-assisted video approaches—identifying when each technique best serves the story
* Lead an in-house production model using AI-assisted and agentic workflows, maintaining a high bar for originality, quality, brand integrity, and responsible use of AI
* Collaborate with Brand Strategy, Copy, Marketing, Product, Devices, Advertising, and other cross-functional partners to translate business objectives into audience-first stories
* Present concepts and creative recommendations to senior stakeholders, building alignment while protecting the strength and distinctiveness of the work
* Champion a culture of experimentation, candor, generosity, humor, and creative excellence within the team
* Build and maintain relationships with select external creative, production, talent, and finishing partners when specialized support is needed
* Establish and evolve a portfolio of Roku brand storytelling that scales across campaigns, products, experiences, and global markets

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

* 10+ years of experience as a video creative director, filmmaker, director, or equivalent creative leader in a brand, agency, entertainment, studio, network, or production environment
* A strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in commercial filmmaking and visual storytelling, including brand films, commercials, idents, experience videos, or other high-impact video work
* Demonstrated ability to develop an idea from a brief into a clear, compelling concept and carry it through pre-production, production, and post-production workflows
* Exceptional visual storytelling skills, with a sharp eye for composition, camera, performance, pacing, production design, motion, sound, and editorial rhythm
* Experience creating comedy-driven work, including strong premise, character, timing, tone, surprise, and emotional payoff
* Experience leading multidisciplinary teams of producers, editors, animators, designers, writers, technical artists, and production partners
* Ability to give clear, actionable feedback and inspire excellent work without creating unnecessary process or friction
* Comfort working in an evolving, AI-assisted production environment with genuine interest in agentic creative workflows and emerging approaches to filmmaking
* Sound judgment around the responsible use of AI, including originality, rights, likeness, representation, confidentiality, and brand safety
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to make complex creative choices simple and persuasive for a range of stakeholders
* A collaborative leadership style and a positive, creative team dynamic
* Experience with AI-assisted video tools, virtual production, procedural workflows, or AI-assisted editorial, animation, and visual effects is highly valued
* Experience developing global brand work and adapting stories across markets, formats, and cultural contexts
* A strong understanding of the streaming ecosystem and the role that simplicity and delight play in the customer experience
* A portfolio or reel showcasing commercial, visual storytelling, comedy, and animation work (please include links and passwords, if applicable)
* Bachelor's and/or master's degree in film, communications, design, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience

**What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

**What are some of the benefits?**

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

**Accommodations**

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

**What should I know about Roku's culture?**

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

title: AI-Enabled Creative Director (US-Based)
description:
As an
**AI-Enabled Creative Director**
, you will turn complex business challenges into compelling creative ideas while making AI an essential part of how creative work is developed and delivered.

You will lead multidisciplinary teams, shape creative direction, and confidently sell ideas to clients. Beyond using AI tools yourself, you will build and apply practical workflows that expand creative possibilities, improve production efficiency, and help your teams deliver exceptional work.

This role calls for both strong creative leadership and hands-on AI expertise. You know how to inspire people, make confident creative decisions, and use emerging technology to elevate the work without compromising originality, strategy, or quality.

Designity is a premium, AI-enabled and human-led Creative-as-a-Service platform. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.

**Why this role exists**

Designity is moving beyond Creative Directors who use AI for occasional tasks toward leaders who can integrate it meaningfully throughout client projects.

With each Creative Circle supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts, maintaining exceptional creative quality while managing continuous production requires smarter, more effective ways of working.

We need a Creative Director who can turn AI into a practical advantage: expanding creative possibilities when developing ideas, building workflows that streamline asset production, and helping creative teams work more effectively.

This role brings hands-on AI expertise into our existing Creative Director model. It is not a company wide AI systems position, but a client-facing creative leadership role that combines AI implementation with strong strategic thinking, independent decision-making, and end-to-end creative ownership.

**What you will be doing**

* **Set the creative vision**
  – Lead creative direction across multiple clients, industries, and disciplines, translating business objectives into compelling concepts, campaigns, brand identities, digital experiences, motion, and content.
* **Sell and champion creative ideas**
  – Present concepts with confidence, articulate the strategy behind your recommendations, and build buy-in from both clients and creative teams. Navigate objections assertively and constructively while protecting the integrity of the work.
* **Build and implement AI-enabled workflows**
  – Develop practical workflows for your client projects, combining AI tools to streamline asset creation, refinement, and production. Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive work, improve efficiency, and strengthen execution.
* **Expand creative possibilities through AI**
  – Use AI to explore new directions, challenge conventional approaches, and develop stronger creative solutions. Apply the technology where it adds meaningful value, not simply because it is available.
* **Lead and mentor multidisciplinary creatives**
  – Provide clear direction, actionable feedback, and support to designers, writers, motion specialists, and other creative professionals. Help teams strengthen their craft and incorporate AI effectively into their work.
* **Own the creative lifecycle**
  – Stay involved from the initial brief through final delivery, overseeing execution and quality control. Ensure every asset meets the highest standards of strategic relevance, originality, brand consistency, and production quality.
* **Collaborate closely with Creative Project Managers (CPMs)**
  – Partner with your CPM to align priorities, navigate feedback, and support smooth project execution while maintaining ownership of creative direction and outcomes.
* **Anticipate and resolve challenges**
  – Proactively identify creative or client issues, make confident decisions, and find solutions independently. Take responsibility for keeping creative work moving without relying on managerial escalation.

**What you will bring**

* **Around 8 years of relevant creative experience**
  , including at least
  **2 years in creative leadership and 2 years of hands-on experience applying AI to creative workflows**
  .
* **An outstanding creative portfolio with strong AI-enabled samples**
  , demonstrating strategic thinking, originality, and high-quality execution across creative disciplines. You can clearly explain your role, creative decisions, and the impact of AI on the final work.
* **Proven experience developing and implementing AI-powered creative workflows**
  , combining technologies such as Higgsfield, Weavy, or comparable tools to enhance creative development and production. Your expertise goes beyond basic prompting or isolated AI-generated assets.
* **A proactive, autonomous approach to problem-solving**
  , with the confidence to take initiative, anticipate challenges, and independently resolve creative or client issues without waiting for direction.
* **Exceptional organization and attention to detail**
  , with the ability to balance competing priorities, identify inconsistencies, maintain brand standards, and deliver high-quality work across multiple projects.
* **Assertive, persuasive communication skills**
  , with a demonstrated ability to pitch and sell creative ideas, defend recommendations, navigate difficult conversations, and build alignment among both clients and creative teams.
* **Experience leading and mentoring multidisciplinary creatives**
  , providing decisive direction, constructive feedback, and the motivation needed to bring ambitious ideas to life.
* **Strong creative and strategic judgment**
  , grounded in branding, storytelling, art direction, design, and audience-centered communication, with an understanding of responsible AI use and the importance of human oversight.
* **Experience managing a high volume and variety of creative deliverables**
  across multiple clients, brands, or products in fast-paced agency or in-house environments.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, along with the adaptability, reliability, and strong internet connection needed to succeed in a remote environment

**How we work**

Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection.

You will work within a
**Creative Circle alongside a Creative Project Manager (CPM) and a multidisciplinary team of creative professionals**
, supporting approximately 8–9 client accounts.

Your CPM partners with you on project coordination, timelines, priorities, and delivery. As the Creative Director, you lead creative strategy, guide the team, own the creative side of client relationships, and remain accountable for the quality of work from initial brief through final delivery.

**This role requires a high level of independence and accountability.**
You will operate autonomously without a Head of Department managing your day-to-day creative decisions or resolving routine client challenges on your behalf. We expect you to anticipate issues, communicate assertively, make sound decisions, and take ownership of solutions while keeping your CPM and creative team aligned.

**What this role offers**

* The opportunity to work alongside the top 1% of global creatives and marketers, in a multicultural environment that broadens your perspective and sharpens your craft
* Shape meaningful creative work across different brands, industries, and disciplines
* Collaboration with ambitious clients and multidisciplinary creative talent
* A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration
* W-2 role with health insurance and 401k benefits available after 90 days
* Paid time off to rest and recharge
* Professional growth and continued skill development
* A fast-moving, supportive environment that values creative thinking, accountability, and high standards
* Total compensation of $90,000–$110,000 USD based on your qualifications.

**We believe great teams are built on shared values:**

* Choose Positivity and lift those around you.
* Say It Straight with honesty and respect.
* Raise the Bar by never settling for average.
* Take Ownership of your work and your impact.
* Move with Purpose and make every action count.

**Success in this role means:**

* Delivering original, strategically strong creative work across multiple client accounts, maintaining exceptional quality from concept through final execution.
* Making AI a practical part of creative production by implementing workflows that expand creative possibilities and improve efficiency.
* Building trust and alignment with clients and creatives through persuasive presentations, confident leadership, and clear creative direction.
* Proactively resolving challenges, managing priorities independently, and maintaining strong organization and attention to detail.
* Elevating team performance through effective mentorship, practical AI adoption, and consistently high creative standards.

**Disclaimer:**

**When applying, please include an updated portfolio showcasing the work you would like us to consider, along with relevant project links, supporting work, or samples of AI Creative Workflows.**

**For collaborative projects, clearly specify your contribution and the areas you were responsible for.**

Our team reviews every submission carefully and will contact candidates who best fit the role within 2–3 weeks.

Be cautious when applying. Official communications from Designity will come only from the Designity.com domain.

At Designity, employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit.

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences; it’s what makes our team and our work stronger.

title: Director, AI Creative (Remote)
description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.
  
  
We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
  
  
Forbes Advisor is hiring a Director, AI Creative to design and implement how the Creative team uses AI to improve the quality and the quantity of our work across our social verticals. As this is a new department within the Creative team, you will define its function, build the systems that run it, and hire and oversee the required team. The ideal candidate has deep expertise spanning generative AI and tooling, direct response creative, and leadership of creative teams. You and your team will work across Forbes’ portfolio of verticals, partnering with Creative Directors who own end-to-end vertical creative strategy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Design the strategy, team structure, and systems for embedding AI tools in the creative process, with a focus on producing a high volume of generative AI content designed for paid social creative.
* Own generative output end to end for paid social and native: stills that hold the same character across every shot, AI video, lip-sync, and generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to organized, tagged, editor-ready footage. Set the quality bar for generated work and enforce it.
* Architect the systems that make generation scale past any one person: pipelines, prompt libraries, character reference libraries, internal tooling, and the automation that connects them.
* Measure how well AI content, and the systems that produce it, are working. What a finished asset costs to make, how long a job takes from approved script to editor handoff, how often work is accepted on the first pass, and how generated work performs in market against everything else we run.
* Help raise the AI fluency of the whole creative team. Work with Creative Directors and their teams to design AI-enabled tools, systems, processes that improve quality and quantity of output.

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in creative, production, or content, with at least the last 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production. You have stood up an AI capability inside a creative org before.
* A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built, and you can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished.
* Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted work that ran as paid creative, with an honest account of what you made versus what the model made, and how it performed. You can hold character and continuity across a whole spot, work out why a render broke instead of re-rolling blindly, and get work through platform filters yourself.
* Deep, current fluency with the generative tools: image models that can hold several characters consistent, AI video both with and without native audio, lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on the trade-offs, not a list of tool names.
* You architect the tooling. You can map out the systems and automations the team needs, build working versions yourself in tools like n8n, Gumloop, or Make, and brief engineering clearly enough that they can build the rest.
* Experience leading people or a function, whether as a manager, a team lead, or the person who built a capability others came to depend on. You can make the case for a hire and then hold the bar you set.
* Comfort working inside compliance rails: regulated-category claims, platform ad policy, and partner brand guardrails.
* Clear written communication, and the confidence to hold your position with senior people outside Creative, including the buyers and the executive team.
* Comfortable in a start-up style operating environment where the tools, and sometimes the plan, change under you.

****STRONG PLUSES****

* Video editing or motion and VFX background (Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci) that lets you hand editors better material and speak their language.
* Familiarity with DAM systems (Air, Frame.io, or comparable) and production project-management tooling.
* Comfort reading performance dashboards (Looker, Tableau, in-platform reporting) to close the loop between what rendered and what converted.
* A track record of forming a real point of view on brand-new tools fast, because these tools turn over monthly.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Engine**
Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.
  
  
That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).
  
  
We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
  
  
Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
  
  
**Your Mission**
Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in-product moments, and beyond.
  
  
You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high-performing, on-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
  
  
This is a role for a creative leader who wants to
**build as much as they lead**
shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* **The AI-assisted creative engine.**
  Design the end-to-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.
* **New tools and approaches to creative production.**
  Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.
* **Creative as targeting.**
  Treat creative as an audience filter and a growth lever. Build frameworks for high-performing creative territories, connect testing insights and customer behavior to new ideas, and diagnose what's working through signals like hook rate, hold rate, conversion, and creative decay.
* **The bridge between brand and scale.**
  Work closely with Engine's Brand team to translate creative and narrative into Engine's brand systems while finding new ways to scale performance without losing what makes the brand distinctive.
* **In-person and experiential creative.**
  Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.
* **Brand-distinctive, entertainment-first work.**
  Ship creative that earns its media spend: bold, memorable, and unmistakably Engine. Bring flagship ideas that break category conventions while keeping the creative pipeline fresh ahead of fatigue.
* **Testing velocity.**
  Partner with Growth on structured testing frameworks, concept logs, and learning agendas so every cycle compounds into smarter, stronger creative.
* **The creative team.**
  Lead and develop designers, editors, AI specialists, and producers. Set the creative bar, stay close to the work, and deploy your own craft when it counts. Build a culture that values experimentation, speed, accountability, and exceptional creative standards.

**How We'll Measure Success**
Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in-person moments.
  
  
Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* Extensive experience in creative strategy or creative leadership, with a track record of innovation and measurable business impact.
* A portfolio that spans both experiential or event creative and performance-driven digital work.
* Hands-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.
* Strong direct-response instincts: you can diagnose hooks, understand why creative performs, and know what makes work effective platform by platform.
* A systems-builder mindset. You naturally think in workflows, SOPs, pipelines, and ways to increase creative velocity without compromising quality.
* Craft pedigree in copy, art direction, design, or video that grounds your strategic judgment.
* Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.
* Experience leading and developing creative talent while remaining close enough to the work to contribute directly when needed.
* Visionary and pragmatic, with high agency and an appetite for building in a fast-moving, AI-forward environment.

*We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.*
**Compensation**
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.
  
  
Base Pay Range
  
  
$157,505—$218,000 USD
  
  
**The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation**
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:
  
  

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
* **Benefits:**
  Check out our full list at engine.com/culture
* **Environments for Success:**
  Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

*Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more*

title: Creative Director - Design, Enterprise Marketing (Remote)
description:
For more than 150 years, Zions Bancorporation (ZBC) has built on the dedication and talent of our people, earning recognition as one of the “Best Banks to Work For.”
  
  
With a $90B market cap, we are a leader in the U.S. banking industry. Throughout seven unique affiliated bank brands who welcome clients at 400 local branches across the West, Zions Bancorporation is committed to business and commercial banking because we believe that businesses are the cornerstone of thriving communities. Together with consumer banking, wealth services, and robust banking products and services, we are known for our exceptional service and deep local roots.
  
  
Today, we are shaping the future of banking—leveraging innovation, strengthening local relationships, sharpening sector expertise, and delivering exceptional value across our family of great banks.
  
  
Our newly founded enterprise Marketing team is a transformative organization that puts an in-house Creative Studio arm-in-arm with data, insights, strategy, tech, and governance teams to evolve and elevate how we tell our story and connect with clients. This is a collaborative hub for meaningful and holistic brand-building, bold ideas, and breakthrough campaigns.
  
  
Now, we are adding the role of Creative Director for a new digital banking platform to our team.
  
  
As the organization continues to grow, this key position offers the opportunity to help shape not only a rapidly scaling digital banking brand, but also the future of modern marketing across the enterprise.
  
  
Designed to move nimbly into the future and transcend our footprint while leveraging the Zions Bancorporation foundation of strength and stability.
  
  
This role combines the energy and influence of a high-growth business with the resources, stability, and support of a leading financial institution.
  
  
The platform has successfully launched and is now actively adding new clients offering a unique opportunity for a dynamic, creative leader with bright, modern ideas and deep chops in brand design to help build the identity of one of the fastest-growing areas of the organization
  
  
The Creative Director - Design (Enterprise Marketing) will deliver innovative design and creative direction that prioritize innovation while balancing business goals with brand integrity. They will be a culturally savvy self-starter and systems-thinker who uses data and insights to create compelling, conversion-focused work that positions us as a leader in digital-forward business banking.
  
  
Initially, this position will lead and execute design and creative leadership within a small, discreet startup team, working directly with leadership, and aligning with Creative Studio executive leaders at regular intervals to ensure holistic brand alignment.
  
  
While entrepreneurial in spirit, this is not a ground-floor build from scratch. The platform is established, operating in market, and supported by an expanding Enterprise Marketing organization. The Creative Director will partner closely with an existing designer and writer who support the platform's marketing efforts, providing creative guidance and direction while benefiting from the broader capabilities and resources of the Enterprise Marketing team.
  
  
Primary Function
  

* Act as a leader in the creative visioning, stewardship, and hands-on design of the platform’s brand and its marketing approach.
* Deliver creative strategy and design of brand assets, guidelines, and marketing campaigns that will strengthen client trust and drive measurable results across digital, print, physical, and in-person experiences.
* Collaborate with performance marketing teams and other organizations to optimize creative for ROI, conversion, and sustainment.
* Leverage client insights, campaign performance data, and market learnings to evolve the brand and create increasingly effective client experiences as the business scales.

Leadership and Team Development
  

* Provide creative leadership and mentorship across a designer and writer while fostering strong collaboration with performance marketing, content, strategy, and enterprise creative partners. (more may be added)
* Regularly connect with and seek direction from Creative Studio.
* Act as an evangelist for the platform’s brand and its application throughout the enterprise.
* Demonstrate expert level skills in design tools, methodologies, and production processes, and coach junior members toward the same, fostering a culture of excellence.
* Establish creative workflows that enhance efficiency and productivity.
* Maintain an extensive network of creative resources for freelance and recruiting. Help shape the future growth of the platform's creative capabilities as the organization continues to expand.

Brand Building and Stewardship
  

* Establish robust brand identity systems that work across many channels, ensuring quality and brand integrity across all touchpoints.
* Balance innovative approaches with regulatory requirements and financial industry standards.
* Develop creative solutions that resonate with small business owners and business decision- makers, helping strengthen client trust and differentiate the brand in a competitive digital banking landscape.

Data-Driven Innovation
  

* Use performance data and testing insights to refine creative strategies.
* Track and forecast marketing trends, technologies, and best practices.

Vendor and Partner Collaboration
  

* Manage relationships with internal stakeholders, external agencies, and production vendors to ensure quality and cost efficiency.
* Maintain a knowledge of regulatory requirements and ensure application of best practices to avoid risk for the organization and ensure clarity for clients.
* Operate with organizational savvy in a collaborative, productive manner.
* Partner effectively across a matrixed organization, influencing stakeholders and building alignment while maintaining speed and creative excellence.

QUALIFICATIONS
  

* Bachelor's degree or master's degree in design and minimum 8 years of experience in graphic design, interactive, advertising, media, UX, and/or related fields.
* Strong visual, written, and oral presentation skills
* Preferred: experience in banking, fintech, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.
* Preferred: experience developing creative and marketing programs that support small business acquisition, engagement, and growth.
* E xperience building brands in growth-stage environments is highly valued.
* A combination of education and experience may meet job requirements

BENEFITS AND COMPENSATION
  
This position is eligible to earn a base salary in the range of $115,000 - $175,000 annually depending on job-related factors such as level of experience and location.
  
  
This opportunity can be located across the Zions Bancorporation Footprint or 100% remote within the United States.
  
  

* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance start day one
* Life and Disability Insurance, Paid Parental Leave and Adoption Assistance
* Health Savings (HSA), Flexible Spending (FSA), and dependent care accounts
* Paid Training, Paid Time Off (PTO) and 11 Paid Federal Holidays, and any applicable state holidays
* 401(k) plan with company match, Profit Sharing, competitive compensation in line with work experience
* Mental health benefits including coaching and therapy sessions
* Tuition Reimbursement for qualifying employees enrolled in an accredited degree program related to the needs of the business, maximum of $5,250 per calendar year, employees are eligible for the program upon hire
* Employee Ambassador preferred banking products

title: Senior Art Director
description:
**THE ROLE**

Do you want to be part of an award-winning team of creatives and creators, redefining industry norms, and disrupting industry standards through social-first thinking and culturally-inspired work? At Movers+Shakers, we're not just about creating ads; we're about crafting cultural moments. We help our clients take big swings, craft big moments, and create big impact.

We're on the hunt for a conceptual Senior Art Director who doesn't just follow the latest visual trends but sets them. Someone who loves making content as much as they love coming up with big ideas. Someone who is as passionate about pop culture as they are about pixel perfection. If you're ready to disrupt the norm and craft groundbreaking work for the digital age, then you might just be the visionary we're looking for.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Lead with Vision:** Partner with Copywriters and Creative Directors to conceptualize and execute innovative, high-volume social-first content that resonate, captivate, and convert.
* **Be a Trendsetter:** Stay ahead of visual and design trends, especially on short-form video platforms like TikTok, Shorts and Reels, ensuring our clients always get the freshest creative.
* **Build it Social-First:** You bring a passion to collaborate with influencers and creators to bring ideas to life in a social-first way.
* **A Creative who is Also a Creator:** If you can think it, you can make it.
* **Challenge the Status Quo:** We're a disruption agency. Bring us ideas that push boundaries and defy expectations.
* **Craft with Care:** From storyboards to final edits, from big ideas to daily content, ensure every piece of content reflects the brand's essence and meets the highest standards of design.
* **Present with Passion:** Articulate your creative decisions to internal teams and clients, always rooting your ideas in strategy and insight.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 5-8 years of design experience in an agency setting, with a portfolio that showcases your ability to work across digital and social content & campaigns.
* Proven experience art directing always-on social content in a fast-paced, high-output environment, consistently delivering polished, on-brand work across multiple platforms
* Experience taking projects from concept through activation.
* Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, with a knack for picking up brand visual identities quickly.
* Out-of-the-box creative thinker with a portfolio of disruptive work.
* The ability to produce high-quality work in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* A deep understanding of how to craft visuals that not only look good but also drive results with entertainment and social storytelling platforms, and a high interest in new and emerging social platforms.
* Spreads Joy! ✨

We look forward to hearing from you!

  

**BASE SALARY RANGE**

**Our estimated range for this role is $95,000-105,000\***

* Don't let this range drive your decision to apply. Actual compensation packages are based on the level of skill and experience each candidate brings to their role. Similarly, there might also be a more senior or junior position available, that would be a better fit with your expertise. For example, a person may apply for a Senior Creative Producer role, and we may assess that their skills are at the Creative Producer level. Each level has its own compensation range.

At Movers+Shakers, we pride ourselves on competitive salaries, and we work hard to ensure there is pay equity across the company. We welcome open and honest conversations about compensation in all of our initial calls. We look forward to meeting you!

title: Art Director, Brand & Design
description:
**Job Title:** Art Director, Brand & Design  
**Location:** Remote  
**Reports to:** Director of Brand Marketing  
**Status:** Full-Time  
**Salary Range:** $110,000-$130,000  
**Direct Reports:** Graphic Designers

**About Bask & Lather Co.**

Bask & Lather Co. is a fast-growing, family-founded haircare brand dedicated to restoring crowns and confidence. What began as a kitchen remedy has evolved into one of the most celebrated textured-hair care brands in the U.S., loved for our authentic story, transformative results, and community-first approach.

It’s an exciting time to join our team as we grow and build a culture rooted in creativity, collaboration, and care. Together, we’re shaping the next chapter of a brand powered by community and led by purpose to help people everywhere love their hair, love their journey, and love themselves.

**Role Overview**

Bask & Lather is seeking an Art Director, Brand & Design to bring our brand to life across campaigns, digital experiences, product packaging, retail displays, and experiential marketing.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a strong designer who can develop compelling concepts, personally execute key creative, and lead graphic designers to deliver cohesive, commercially effective work. You will translate brand strategy into clear visual direction and help build the systems, standards, and team capabilities needed to support a growing beauty brand.

Reporting to the Director of Brand Marketing, you will collaborate with Brand, Growth, E-Commerce, Retention, Retail, Experiential, Product Development, and Supply Chain to ensure creative builds brand recognition, communicates product value, and supports business goals.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Art Direction & Brand Design**

* Develop creative concepts and visual systems for integrated campaigns, product launches, and ongoing brand marketing.
* Translate approved brand strategy into clear art direction, design briefs, and cohesive execution across customer touchpoints.
* Maintain and evolve design standards, templates, and asset libraries within the brand’s established identity.
* Art direct photography, short-form video, creator content, and product demonstrations, including mood boards, composition, styling, and post-production guidance. Ensure clear product education and consistent brand presentation.

**Hands-On Creative Execution**

* Personally design key creative across e-commerce, social, email, paid media, marketplaces, sales materials, and brand campaigns.
* Develop platform-specific creative for TikTok Shop, paid and organic social, creator content, and livestream shopping, adapting storytelling and design to how customers discover and purchase on each channel.
* Translate customer questions, hair concerns, cultural insights, and relevant trends into creative that resonates with our audience and reflects the brand’s voice and standards.
* Partner with Growth, Social, E-Commerce, and the Director of Creative Performance to develop and refine creative using performance insights and customer feedback, supporting structured testing and iteration.

**Packaging, Retail & Experiential Design**

* Design packaging, labels, cartons, kits, and other physical brand materials from concept through production-ready artwork.
* Develop retail displays, merchandising assets, signage, and environmental graphics that translate the brand into physical spaces.
* Work with internal partners and external vendors on dielines, specifications, proofs, color, materials, and finishes.
* Ensure artwork includes approved content and completes the required cross-functional reviews before production.

**Team Leadership & Creative Operations**

* Manage, coach, and develop graphic designers, providing clear direction and constructive feedback.
* Prioritize projects, balance workloads, and maintain accountability for creative quality and deadlines.
* Review deliverables for brand consistency, accuracy, channel suitability, and production readiness.
* Build scalable workflows that improve turnaround time and reduce unnecessary revisions while maintaining high standards.

**Key KPIs & Success Metrics**

* A cohesive, recognizable brand across digital and physical touchpoints.
* Strong creative delivered accurately and on time.
* A design team with clear direction, useful feedback, and consistent standards.
* Packaging and displays that meet brand, retailer, and production requirements.
* Creative systems that support growth and improve team efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of professional brand design or creative experience, including experience leading designers and providing art direction.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating consumer brand campaigns, photography and short-form video art direction, creator content, packaging, and retail or physical brand experiences.
* Hands-on proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and Figma, with strong typography, composition, layout, and image-editing skills.
* Practical knowledge of packaging and print production, including dielines, artwork preparation, color management, and proof review.
* Experience designing for e-commerce and digital marketing, with an understanding of how creative supports customer education and conversion.
* Strong judgment, organization, communication, and the ability to move projects forward independently.
* A collaborative approach and the ability to balance personal execution with effective delegation.
* Experience in beauty, haircare, skincare, wellness, or consumer packaged goods is strongly preferred. Experience supporting social commerce, particularly TikTok Shop, is strongly preferred. Ability to direct video and motion work is required; hands-on motion design or video editing is a plus.

**Why Join Bask & Lather Co.?**

* Be part of a passionate, fast-paced team changing the narrative around scalp care
* Play a pivotal role in a high-growth, high-impact brand with national reach
* Directly support strategic initiatives and help shape scalable infrastructure
* Competitive salary, collaborative culture, and room to grow with the business

**Benefits**

* Medical Insurance- (Health, Dental, Vision)
* Paid Time Off
* 401K

**How to Apply**

Please include a portfolio with examples of digital campaigns, photography or short-form video art direction, creator content, packaging, and retail or physical brand design. Identify your personal design contribution, art direction, and team leadership on the work shown.
