The mechanical design engineer will primarily support the hydraulic + passive mechanical braking systems through the entire life cycle from conceptual design through detailed design and development, testing, qualification, manufacturing, and installed fleet support. The engineer will drive technical excellence and continuous improvement in the design, analysis, cost, and reliability of the components under their responsibility.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

You will:

* Execute projects pertaining to new product introduction, new technology integration, and field issue resolution with a heavy focus on quality and reliability verified by physical testing
* Be responsible for designing yaw system components for wind turbines focusing on hydraulic pressure unit (HPU) systems, yaw bearings, yaw drives, and yaw brakes encompassing component design, system interaction, and system reliability
* Hold ownership of and drive lessons learned, best practices, and standardization into design related documentation such as design practices, drawings, and technical specifications
* Responsible for design, development of testing/validation plans to prove component function and reliability
* Provide innovative design solutions to meet aggressive timing, product cost, and reliability targets
* Ensure quality of new and revised drawings, BoMs, and specifications applying all GEV and industry processes, standards, and best practices
* Work cross functionally, developing strong relationships with quality teams, manufacturing engineers, sourcing, suppliers, field support, and others to improve product quality and first-time yield
* Support manufacturing, sourcing, and the field with issue resolution and quick corrective actions for design related causes (NCR, SDR, PAC)
* Drive quick, complete technical root cause analysis of field failures and identify design related corrective actions to prevent recurrence
* Identify and execute cost saving ideas and strategies
Drive efforts to introduce advanced technology, materials, manufacturing methods, new design tools/methods to advance the strategic position of yaw subsystem components  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering
* Significant experience in mechanical analysis and design experience in industry
* Working knowledge of technical drawings, GD&T, and manufacturing
* Experience with 3D-CAD tools like Unigraphics / Siemens NX

* Excellent communication, project management, interpersonal, and presentation skills
* Proven ability to lead global projects with team members across cultural boundaries
* Ability to work under pressure and challenging conditions
* Established problem solving process knowledge and execution
* Strong desire and ability to drive improvement and change
* Fluent English written and spoken
* Ability to travel up to 10%
  

**Desired Characteristics**

* Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering
* Working knowledge of Ansys or other finite element analysis tools
* Design experience working on components in the wind turbine yaw subsystem (yaw drives, yaw bearings, bolted joints, hydraulic + mechanical yaw braking systems)
* Experience with system design including interface definition, system stiffness, DFMEA, and design for manufacturability / installation / serviceability.

* Proven track record of collaborating with business product managers and suppliers/vendors to optimize component costs and influence purchasing strategy

**Business Development**

* Defining our Data & AI proposition for energy companies and utilities, from AI strategy and Agentic AI to data foundations, across networks, operations, the energy transition and customers.
* Originating and scaling strategic transformation opportunities, from use-case portfolios and business cases to enterprise-wide programmes.
* Identifying pull-through opportunities for technology solutions and services through consulting engagements and gained knowledge of clients’ business challenges.
* Shaping complex value cases and facilitating executive workshops that link AI and data investments to measurable business outcomes.
* Leading deal shaping, pricing and commercial negotiations, and managing revenue, margin and delivery health across engagements.
* Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of opportunities with energy companies and utilities across Iberia.
* Creating eminence and thought leadership through provocative points of view on AI, the energy transition and critical infrastructure.
  

**Client delivery & leadership**

* Setting the direction for complex, multi-disciplinary consulting engagements, identifying the right functional knowledge, technical expertise and proprietary tools required to deliver.
* Serving as a trusted advisor to the C-suite of energy companies and utilities, turning emerging technologies into pragmatic roadmaps and measurable value.
* Leading Agentic AI and Generative AI programmes from opportunity and business case through architecture, implementation and adoption.
* Applying AI to networks and operations: predictive maintenance, asset and network management, digital twins and field operations.
* Building scalable data foundations: data strategy, data governance, operating models and modern architectures, including data for sustainability reporting.
* Advising clients on how to deploy AI in line with sector regulation, including the EU AI Act requirements for critical infrastructure, NIS2 and sustainability reporting.
* Collaborating with the wider Uvance Wayfinders network and technology partners to bring the right capabilities and solutions to each client challenge.
* Providing senior technical oversight across multiple AI and data engagements.
* Validating architectural approaches spanning data platforms, machine learning, large language models, AI agents and orchestration layers.
* Ensuring AI solutions are production-grade, scalable, secure and aligned with enterprise standards, with strong engineering discipline and MLOps practices.
* Guiding teams on trade-offs between rules-based systems, machine learning, LLMs and hybrid approaches.
* Acting as the senior escalation point for complex technical, architectural or Responsible AI decisions.
* Building and sustaining long-term client relationships, ensuring high satisfaction and repeat business.
  

**Practice development**

* Collaborating with the Consulting Partner to shape the Energy & Utilities offering, including methodologies, accelerators and thought leadership.
* Building a high-performing Energy & Utilities team, providing direction, mentorship and quality assurance over team performance and deliverables.
* Working with Uvance Wayfinders partners across Europe and with the teams already present in client accounts.
* Inspiring Uvance Wayfinders consultants to realise their full potential, supporting collaboration, continuous development and a culture where talent thrives.
  

**Your transferable skills and experience:**

* 14+ years of experience in consulting or equivalent senior industry leadership roles, including experience at Associate Partner, Principal Director, Director or Managing Director level in a tier-one consultancy or technology advisory firm.
* Proven ability to build trusted C-suite relationships and originate consulting revenue.
* Experience working with energy and utilities clients in Iberia (electricity networks, generation, energy retail or oil & gas).
* Hands-on leadership of Data & AI in the energy sector: Agentic AI, Generative AI, advanced analytics, data strategy and data governance.
* Track record leading large multidisciplinary teams and project portfolios, balancing growth, delivery quality and talent.
* Solid knowledge of the sector’s regulatory framework, including the EU AI Act, NIS2, sustainability reporting (such as CSRD) and the role of the energy regulators (CNMC and ERSE), and its impact on AI initiatives.
* Experience building practices or offerings from scratch and taking them to market.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with a hands-on approach to growing, developing and inspiring cross-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of modern data and AI architectures, including cloud-native data platforms and pipelines, machine learning and advanced analytics, LLM-based solutions (prompting, RAG, agents), and orchestration, monitoring and lifecycle management.
* Experience overseeing AI systems in production and understanding their operational risks: performance, drift, reliability and security.
* Proven ability to build complex value cases and to facilitate workshops with senior decision-makers to shape engagement outcomes.
* Strong commercial acumen, with revenue and margin accountability.
* University degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* Fluent Spanish and professional English; Portuguese is a plus.
  

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with IoT, OT/SCADA environments or digital twins.
* Experience in energy transition programmes (renewables, electrification, storage or hydrogen).
* Experience with ecosystems, technology partnerships or acquisitions.
* Market presence through executive teaching, speaking or publications.

Our services span four domains: Industries, Operations, Experiences and Technologies.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!**

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

*Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.*

**About the role**
------------------

We're looking for the top 1% - engineers who treat their craft like athletes treat performance, and who want to work alongside people who do the same. The world has changed dramatically in the last quarter. What used to take a team of consultants six months now takes a sharp engineer a few days. The momentum is unreal, and we're growing into it fast.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you're embedded directly in our customers' environments, taking a messy enterprise problem from first conversation to a working production system in days - not quarters. You work as part of a small senior team - alongside a Senior Consultant and other FDEs - and you own the technical solution end-to-end: architecture, integrations, agent and workflow logic, frontend where needed, evals, deployment. The work starts and ends with the customer, not the codebase. Feedback cycles are measured in hours, the bar is high, and the people you ship with will push you to raise it.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Sit with end-users, process owners, and client engineers to understand the real workflow - and the real problem underneath the stated one
* Translate the target-state process into a concrete technical solution: architecture, data model, integrations, agent and workflow design - and ship it in days and weeks, not quarters
* Demo early and often, rough edges included, and fold real feedback into the next iteration
* Make speed / quality / cost trade-offs in real time. Choose build vs. buy vs. configure existing platform capability
* Own observability and evals once live. Iterate until the system is reliable in the customer's real conditions
* Earn trust with the client's own engineering and security teams - API access, data flows, deployment, reviews
* Bring patterns back - reusable components, prompt structures, integration approaches - so the next engagement ships faster

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Builder background with real shipping experience - you've taken systems from zero to production and kept them running
* Fluent with modern AI tooling: LLM APIs, tool and function calling, agent frameworks, evals, prompt engineering as a real discipline
* Strong with TypeScript on the backend. Comfortable with APIs, auth, queues, and integrating with legacy systems
* Daily, fluent use of Claude Code, Cursor, or similar - expected to ship meaningfully faster than a traditional engineer because of them
* Customer-facing instinct - you genuinely enjoy being in the room with users, asking sharp questions, and pushing back respectfully when needed
* You move fast, communicate clearly, and operate well with ambiguity. Comfortable being dropped into an unfamiliar domain and coming back with a working prototype
* Fluency in English. German is a plus
* **MUST**: experience automating business processes in the ERP space (SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, NetSuite, or similar), or prior background in consulting, solutions engineering, or founding/building products end-to-end

**What you'll get**
-------------------

* **Ship in days, not quarters.** Watch a messy enterprise problem become a working production system inside a single engagement.
* **Work at the frontier.** We use and build with state-of-the-art tech, the latest LLMs, agent frameworks, and AI coding tools, with the budget and mandate to keep up as the field moves.
* **Build with the best tools.** No legacy stack to drag around.
* **Big responsibility, fast.** You own customer engagements end-to-end from day one: architecture, build, delivery, and the relationship.
* **A team that raises the bar.** You're working alongside other FDEs and senior consultants who were hired for exactly this pace.

The Data Platform Engineer builds and runs the platform that all of Graitec's reporting, analytics and AI depend on: the Microsoft Fabric data lake, the pipelines that feed it, and the controls that keep it reliable, secure and affordable.

The priority is a governed single source of truth: data from Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, CRM, services

licensing and product telemetry, integrated once, modelled consistently and served to every function, with sensitive data protected by design.

You will work with the Data and AI Leader, BI developers, IT Operations & Platforms, Information Security and R&D. It is a hands-on senior engineering role, setting the patterns others build on.

Key Outcomes Expected

What success looks like in the first 12 months

* A published data platform architecture and engineering standards, with a layered data model in use
* Core sources ingested reliably and monitored, with failures detected before users notice
* Platform capacity right-sized and its cost transparent, with workloads separated so reporting and engineering do not collide
* Access, classification and privacy controls in place, including for HR and financial data
* Pipelines and models in source control, with automated deployment across environments
* A clear interface with R&D for product telemetry and shared data platforms

Responsibilities

Platform Engineering

* Design, build and run the Microsoft Fabric platform: lakehouses, warehouses, pipelines and dataflows
* Ingest and integrate data from Dynamics 365, CRM, Kantata, licensing and telemetry, using standard connectors and APIs where they fit
* Build a layered, medallion-style data model that turns raw data into certified, reusable datasets
* Resolve customer and product identities across CRM, ERP, licensing and telemetry, so every report counts the same customer once

Reliability & Cost

* Monitor pipelines and automate data quality tests for completeness, freshness, uniqueness and referential integrity, with alerting and clear ownership of failures
* Manage platform capacity and cost, separating workloads and scaling only when justified
* Run source control, environments and deployment pipelines for data and BI content

Security & Governance

* Implement access, classification, row- and column-level security, masking and privacy controls with Information Security
* Protect sensitive data such as compensation, using anonymisation and restricted workspaces
* Maintain lineage and documentation, supporting the data governance the business agrees

Collaboration

* Set engineering standards and coach BI developers and analysts in using them
* Work with the Enterprise Architect and R&D on integration patterns, master data and telemetry
* Prepare data for AI, exposing governed, well-described data to agents and models through controlled interfaces

Responsibilities:

* 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering, including at least two years working with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, or Databricks.
* Strong experience with SQL and Python or PySpark, and data modelling for analytics.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse, Warehouse, Pipelines, Notebooks, and OneLake.
* Experience integrating ERP and CRM data, ideally from Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and Dataverse.
* Experience with master data management and entity resolution, including matching customers and products across multiple systems.
* Practical experience implementing security and governance, including Entra ID, row-level security, and Microsoft Purview.
* Experience managing capacity and costs on a shared analytics platform.
* Uses AI tools such as Copilot in day-to-day work for code generation, testing, and documentation.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to document effectively and explain technical trade-offs to non-engineering stakeholders.
* Experience with product telemetry or event-driven data.
* Experience preparing data for AI solutions, including retrieval, vector search, and governed access for agents (for example through MCP).
* Experience with other modern data platforms and tools such as dbt, Snowflake, or Databricks, and with infrastructure as code.

Qualifications:

* Strong proficiency in **SQL** and **Python/PySpark** development.
* Expertise in **analytics-focused data modelling** and data architecture.
* Deep knowledge of **Microsoft Fabric** technologies, including:
  + Lakehouse
  + Warehouse
  + Data Pipelines
  + Notebooks
  + OneLake
* Experience with **source control and CI/CD practices for data platforms**, including Git and Azure DevOps.
* Knowledge of enterprise **security, governance, and compliance frameworks**, including:
  + Entra ID
  + Row-Level Security (RLS)
  + Microsoft Purview
* Understanding of data platform operations, including performance, scalability, and cost optimization.
* Practical application of AI-assisted development tools such as **Copilot**.
* **Preferred Certifications**
  + Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer (**DP-700**)
  + Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer (**DP-600**)
* Familiarity with modern AI data architectures, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Vector Search
  + MCP-enabled data access and governance
* Knowledge of modern data engineering ecosystems, including:
  + dbt
  + Snowflake
  + Databricks
  + Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.

Interview Process:

**At Graitec, we’re proud to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace.**

We value our employees for who they are and the contributions they bring, encouraging everyone to be their

authentic selves at work. This diversity helps us better serve the wide range of customers and markets we

operate in. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and assess candidates solely on their skills and

ability to succeed in the role.

Graitec uses AI to support and streamline internal processes; however, all application reviews, screening, and

hiring decisions are made solely by our Talent Acquisition team and hiring managers.

* **HR Screening –** An initial “get to know you” discussion.
* **Technical Assessment Interview –** May include a presentation or a collaborative exercise.
* **Hiring Manager Interview –** A role-specific discussion with the hiring manager.
* **Final Interview –** Conversation with the Business Unit Leader.

Additional Information

As a signatory of **United Nations Women’s Empowerment Principles**, Graitec is committed to equal opportunity and

pay transparency.

**On Target Earning pay range for this role**

* **Role Targeted Variable Pay Mix:** 10%
* **Minimum Annual On Target Earning:** € 40,000
* **Maximum Annual On Target Earning:** € 60,000

**Note:** Salary range indicated in this add is for information only & targeted for a specific seniority level and targeted location. Final salary offer might vary depending on final candidate location, seniority, competencies...

title: Team Lead, Reliability Engineering
Supply Chain Transformation Lead – Head of Anaplan Supply Chain South
description:
### **About the role**

As **Head of Anaplan Supply Chain South**, you have **three roles.** **You grow our Anaplan business** in Switzerland, Austria, Iberia and France, together with Anaplan. **You lead complex end-to-end supply chain transformation programs** for our clients. And you **lead and develop your squad** of (senior) consultants. You also drive the AI transformation in your region: in what we bring to clients and in how we deliver.

**What you'll do**

**Drive growth in the South region**

* Own the growth of our Anaplan business in Switzerland, Austria, Iberia and France.
* Build a strong partnership with the regional Anaplan teams. Plan accounts together, run joint campaigns and win deals together.
* Identify and shape new opportunities with new and existing clients. Collaborate with our sales and presales team, who support you through the full sales cycle.
* Bring AI into client conversations. Help clients see where AI improves their planning decisions, and turn that into new opportunities.
* Use your understanding of the local markets to strengthen Bluecrux' presence and reputation in the region.
* Set regional priorities together with fellow Bluecrux leaders.

**Lead end-to-end supply chain transformation programs**

* Lead complex supply chain planning transformations, from scoping and design through implementation.
* Bring deep supply chain planning expertise. Challenge and guide clients on their planning processes.
* Lead the solution design together with the client. Make sure design decisions support the client's business objectives.
* Use AI to make our delivery faster and better. Apply AI tools in design, build and testing, and share what works with other squads.
* Deliver the end-to-end implementation with a team of solution architects and model builders. Set clear plans, governance and responsibilities. Manage risks and dependencies.
* Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders. Guide them through difficult decisions and grow the collaboration over time.

**Build and lead your squad**

* Lead your squad as their team lead. Set clear expectations, give regular feedback and manage performance. Foster innovation, collaboration and high quality in everything we do.
* Support each team member's career development and support your team leads to do the same.
* Build the skills and leadership capacity your squad needs as the business grows.
* Drive AI adoption in your squad. Make sure your team builds AI skills and uses AI in their daily work.
* Hire new talent and grow the team in line with regional growth.
* Bring lessons from clients and projects back into our Anaplan offering, together with other Bluecrux leaders.

#LI-AH1

### **About you**

***Growth and partnership***

* You have a track record of growing client relationships and winning new work. You identify opportunities and shape proposals in collaboration with our sales and presales team.
* You bring an entrepreneurial mindset. You set direction, take initiative and follow through.
* You are comfortable working with technology partners to build a joint pipeline.
* You are driven by the change AI brings to supply chain planning and consulting. You experiment, learn fast and take others with you.

***Supply chain transformation***

* You bring substantial consulting experience in supply chain planning transformation.
* You understand end-to-end supply chain planning. You guide clients and teams from design through implementation.
* You have led transformations with Anaplan or comparable planning solutions, such as SAP IBP, Kinaxis or OMP. You do not need technical Anaplan expertise. Your strength is leading delivery, aligning stakeholders and managing teams.
* You oversee multiple engagements, support project leads and take accountability for delivery outcomes.
* You build credibility with senior client stakeholders. You guide conversations on business priorities, transformation decisions and investment.

***Team leadership***

* You have experience in leading and developing teams, including performance management, coaching and career development.

***General***

* You are fluent in English. Spanish or French is a plus.
* You have a master’s degree in Economics, Engineering or another related field.
* You are ready to represent our values: dig deep, own it, come together, move fast and be kind.
* You work well in an international team with a hybrid working model. You travel to clients (20%) and Bluecrux offices (Barcelona ES, Mechelen/Aalst BE, Zug CH – Min 40%).
* You have a valid driving license, or you obtain one within six months.

### **Why join us?**

* **Shape regional growth.** You decide with us where and how we grow our Anaplan supply chain business in the South region.
* **Lead complex transformations.** You guide clients through programs that change how they plan, and you build lasting relationships.
* **Lead your own squad.** You own your team's performance, development and growth.
* **Shape innovation into a concrete offering.** You work with fellow leaders and partners to develop our planning capabilities, embed AI in everything we do and bring innovation to our clients.
* **Shape how we use AI.** You help define how AI changes our client offering and the way we deliver.

* Enjoy a flexible & hybrid work environment, combining remote work, office presence and onsite client visits.
* Benefit from a **competitive salary** package, complete with **multiple extra-legal perks** designed to reward your expertise.

### **About us**

At Bluecrux, we transform supply chains into smart, efficient value chains through a blend of expert consulting and cutting-edge technology. We collaborate closely with industry leaders like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bridgestone, AkzoNobel, Beiersdorf, Oatly, and many more – creating partnerships that drive meaningful impact. With a global presence in Europe, the US and APAC, we're committed to shaping the future of value chains, one success story at a time.

#### **Anaplan**

With the power of **Anaplan**, a leading connected planning solution, and our planning expertise, we help our customers make the right planning decisions and drive growth. We connect people, plans and data, bring scenario planning capabilities and connect supply chain to sales, finance and HR. Visit our Anaplan page to learn more about our services and the implementations we have worked on with our customers.

Our Anaplan squad is a successful and fast-growing part of the consulting business unit. We make a difference for clients by combining our strong supply chain and Anaplan expertise. We are **the** supply chain frontrunner in the Anaplan eco-system, having been awarded multiple awards to recognise our impact. We love to collaborate with Anaplan sales, product and customer success teams to develop the best solutions for and with our clients. We bring standard best practices on a.o. Demand Planning, Supply Planning and S&OP as well as specific developments such as advanced optimization and AI forecasting to fit client-specific needs.

title: Senior Campaign Manager (Temp Contract)
description:
**About Pleo**
Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.
  
  
The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.
  
  
Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Senior Integrated Campaign Manager, Brand & GTM to join our Integrated Marketing team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help architect, roll out, project manage, and drive the Go-To-Market (GTM) execution for our major 2027 brand marketing strategy and campaigns and be part of turning brand strategy, positioning, and creative concepts into operational GTM blueprints as we scale our multi-segment (SMB, Mid-Market, Enterprise) reach across 6 key European markets. If you're excited about high-visibility, full-funnel orchestration and balancing long-term brand equity building with full-funnel conversion, and are passionate about integrated brand and GTM marketing in high-growth B2B SaaS, then this is the opportunity for you!
  
  
**Please bear in mind this role is a temporary contract of 1 year.**
**Who You’ll Be Working With And Reporting To**
You’ll report to our Director of Integrated Marketing and work closely with teams in Brand Marketing, Digital, Field/Events, Content, PR, Product Marketing (PMM), Marketing Ops, Data, and Sales/Growth channels. Our team is highly collaborative and dedicated to bridging top-of-funnel brand awareness with lower-funnel acquisition, ensuring every campaign moment translates into market salience, customer engagement, and measurable business impact. You’ll also have the chance to partner with teams across country teams, local market stakeholders, Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field squads to ensure success.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
As a Senior Campaign Manager, you will:
  
  

* Integrated GTM Architecture & Strategic Planning: Translate the overarching 2027 brand strategy into actionable, full-funnel GTM campaign blueprints across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments, architecting campaign flighting and distribution models across 6 European markets.
* The "Master Brief" & Cross-Functional Squad Leadership: Own and author comprehensive Integrated Campaign Master Briefs, leading the operational rhythm of cross-functional squads to execute multi-channel strategies (OOH, Paid Social, VIP activations, Digital, ABM) on time and within scope.
* Localization & Regional Adaptation: Partner with country teams and local market stakeholders to ensure master campaign frameworks balance global consistency with local relevance and execution precision.
* Strategic Brand Partnership & Enablement: Serve as the strategic execution peer to the Brand Marketing Lead, while partnering with Sales Leadership, SDRs, and Field teams to equip customer-facing squads with the stories, tools, and campaign momentum needed to capitalize on campaign-generated intent.
* Campaign Operations, Budget & ROI Accountability: Maintain and protect the integrated campaign master calendar, manage and allocate the multi-country integrated campaign budget, and partner with Marketing Ops, Data, and Brand Intelligence to track brand lift, consideration, pipeline growth, and closed-won impact.

**What You Bring**
You’ll thrive in this role if you have:
  
  

* A proven track record leading multi-million dollar, multi-country, full-funnel integrated campaigns in high-growth B2B SaaS or tech environments.
* Deep experience taking high-level brand frameworks and translating them into multi-channel GTM blueprints across varied audience segments (SMB to Enterprise).
* High proficiency in aligning cross-functional teams (Creative, Digital, PR, Ops, Sales) and holding squads accountable to tight deadlines and complex campaign launches.
* Deep understanding of how to run campaigns across diverse European markets, with a clear perspective on modular campaign design and local adaptation.
* Experience with tracking brand-to-pipeline performance metrics, campaign flighting dynamics, brand lift, consideration, and total ROI.
* A background in integrated marketing, GTM campaign management, or brand marketing orchestration within B2B technology or SaaS.

**Why is this role a good fit for you**
This role is a good fit for you if:
  
  

* You thrive as the operational bridge between high-level brand strategy and lower-funnel demand generation, turning concepts into structured GTM blueprints.
* You love leading cross-functional squads across multiple international markets, balancing consistency with local nuances across 6 key European countries.
* You take pride in end-to-end accountability, from authoring master briefs and handling multi-country budgets to tracking downstream pipeline velocity and closed-won revenue impact.

This role is not a good fit for you if:
  
  

* You prefer focusing purely on high-level creative ideation, copy, or audience insight development without building the operational execution machinery.
* You prefer running single-channel or single-market marketing initiatives rather than orchestrating complex, multi-segment (SMB to Enterprise), multi-channel matrices.
* You are uncomfortable navigating data, campaign flighting performance, budget allocations, and downstream pipeline attribution alongside brand metrics.

**How You’ll Develop In This Role**
In your first 6 months at Pleo, you’ll:
  
  

* Lead the architecture and rollout of the 2027 integrated brand campaign calendar across all target European markets.
* Collaborate with the Brand Marketing Lead, country teams, and Marketing Ops to stand up the Master Briefing framework and streamline cross-functional execution rhythms.
* Grow your skills in full-funnel orchestration and multi-market scale, driving measurable brand lift, consideration, and downstream pipeline velocity as Pleo continues to expand.

**The location**
Please note: We can hire on a hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.
  
  
**Show me the benefits!**

* Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
* Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
* Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
* 25 days of annual leave + public holidays (additional days may apply in select countries based on local standards).
* For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
* We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
* Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

**The interview process**
We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:
  
  

* Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.
* Hiring Manager Interview: A 45 minute chat to deep dive into your experience
* Challenge & Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role
* Final Interview: A final interview with a senior leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!
  
  
Last time we hired for this role, we received a total vast number of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call.Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:
  
  

* CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!
* Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
* Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

**About Your Application**

* English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
* A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
* Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
* Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
* Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
* Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
* Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

title: Senior HR Business Partner New
description:
Barcelona, Spain

  

**Our Mission: Why Lighthouse?**

At Lighthouse, we’re on a mission to revolutionize commercial strategy as hospitality’s most powerful AI platform. We take the world's largest hotel data network and transform it into real-time intelligence that drives action. We don't just deliver insights; we empower businesses to make decisions that move revenue.

With $370M in Series C funding and over $100M in ARR, we are scaling at lightspeed. Our 850+ teammates across 35 countries aren't just building software—they are leveraging cutting-edge AI to help hoteliers be the first to act. Tens of thousands of hotels across 185 countries trust Lighthouse to execute their commercial strategy, including every one of the top 15 global chains and thousands of independent hotels that consistently outperform their markets. With Lighthouse AI, the intelligence gets deeper. Decisions get smarter. Actions get faster. We help hoteliers be first to act.

**Lighthouse Values: Our guiding light**

We are **Lumineers**. Our shared values keep us on a collaborative path fostering a cultural and customer centric environment

* **Pursuit of greatness**: We’re innovators who care deeply about our customers’ success. Our team brings their best work, stays curious, and delivers excellence through attention to detail
* **Meaningful work matters**: We make every moment count by knowing what to deliver, why it matters, and how it drives Lighthouse forward
* **Elevate each other**: We don’t just work together - we grow together. What unites us is understanding each other as people and working toward shared goals

We’re more than just a workplace – we’re a community. Collaborative, fun, and deeply committed, we work hard together to revolutionize the hospitality sector. Are you ready to join us and shine brighter in the industry’s most exciting rocket-ship?

**Job Details**

* People & Talent
* Barcelona, Spain
* Full-Time / Hybrid

**What you will do**

As a **Senior HR Business Partner** at Lighthouse, you'll partner with directors, vice presidents and leadership teams across Revenue and Marketing to shape people strategy and turn business priorities into practical action. This is a hands-on advisory role, combining workforce redesign and talent development with performance management and complex employee relations. Within an AI-native People & Talent function, you'll use people analytics and tools such as Claude to connect signals across clusters and bring leaders clear recommendations. You'll challenge assumptions, help leaders own their decisions and measure success by whether the business makes better decisions about its people because of your involvement.

**Where you will have impact**

* Partner with senior Revenue and Marketing leadership teams to shape people strategy and translate business priorities into quarterly people plans and targeted projects.
* Lead workforce redesign conversations as artificial intelligence changes roles, structures and capability needs, helping leaders decide what should change and put those decisions into practice.
* Partner closely with business leaders on change management and communication, shaping clear messages, preparing managers for team conversations and supporting employees through organisational transitions.
* Guide managers at all levels through feedback, performance improvement plans and performance calibration, in collaboration with People Operations.
* Advise on compensation, promotions, development and retention, addressing underperformance while helping strong performers succeed.
* Coach managers, strengthen leader onboarding and provide a confidential space for complex concerns, exercising judgment about when to escalate or involve others.
* Lead complex, sensitive employee relations cases as the senior escalation point for the portfolio, partnering with People Operations and involving Legal when needed.
* Challenge hiring profiles, levels, budgets and timelines constructively in partnership with Talent Acquisition.
* Synthesise engagement, attrition, performance, compensation and employee relations signals across clusters into business recommendations, using AI for analysis and pattern recognition and building simple dashboards where needed.
* Contribute to the design of performance, development, engagement and workforce planning programmes, bringing cluster insight into approaches that work in the business.
* Identify cross-cluster patterns that signal organisation-wide risk or opportunity and bring a clear recommendation to the Director of Talent Enablement.

**About our team**

You'll work closely with fellow HR Business Partners, People Operations and Talent Acquisition to support Revenue and Marketing leaders across Europe, the United States and Asia-Pacific. The work combines direct communication, practical manager support and a broader view of the business, with flexibility to organise your week around stakeholders in different time zones.

**What's in it for you?**

* Flexible working environment: Work from home or at one of our global offices.
* Flexible time off: Autonomy to manage your work-life balance.
* Alan Healthy benefits: 160€/month for food or nursery.
* Payflow App: Access your earned salary in advance at no cost to you.
* Flexible retribution: Optional benefits through tax-free payroll deductions for food, transportation and/or nursery.
* Wellbeing support: Subsidized up to 80% ClassPass subscription.
* Comprehensive health insurance: 100% Alan coverage for you, your spouse, and dependents.
* Collaborative team: High-bar, friendly, creative, and passionate colleagues.
* Career development: Workshops, frameworks, tools, training, and processes to realize your full potential.
* Impactful work: Shape products relied on by 85,000+ users worldwide.
* Competitive compensation: Proactively maintained to value your work.
* Referral bonuses: Earn rewards for bringing in new talent.

**Who you are**

* Experience partnering with Revenue teams in an international organisation, with an understanding of commercial pressures.
* Credibility advising directors and vice presidents on people strategy, organisation design and workforce change, alongside hands-on performance management experience.
* Clear, concise communication and senior stakeholder influence, including the ability to present recommendations, challenge assumptions and maintain a constructive position under pressure.
* Data storytelling skills that connect signals across clusters, distinguish local issues from organisation-wide patterns and build a business case for action.
* Understanding of how artificial intelligence reshapes roles, team structures and capability needs, and the ability to guide leaders through workforce redesign decisions.
* Generative AI fluency for synthesis, pattern recognition and insight generation, including basic analysis and HTML dashboards, with sound judgment about the limitations of AI outputs.
* Experience independently managing complex employee relations cases with significant business, legal or reputational dimensions, including knowing when to escalate or involve Legal.
* Ability to hold a multi-cluster portfolio in view while remaining hands-on, adapting to changing priorities and organising work across time zones.

**We welcome**

* International Revenue partnering experience from outside SaaS; SaaS experience is helpful, not required.
* Experience contributing to or designing HR frameworks, programmes or operating models.
* Familiarity with organisation design methods, including responsibility mapping, spans of control and role design principles.
* First-hand experience supporting a function through significant AI-driven transformation.

**Diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging**

Thank you for considering a career with Lighthouse. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that values equal opportunity for all. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, and disability. Our commitment to equality is part of our culture. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point during the application or interview process, please notify your recruiter.

Not ticking every box? No problem! We value diverse backgrounds and unique skill sets, and we encourage individuals from all walks of life to apply. If your experience looks a little different from what we've described, but you're passionate about what we do and are a quick learner, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Freelance Account Director
description:

Remedy Edge brings strategic thinking and bold communications to healthcare — cutting through the noise to move people and change results. We don't do comfortable. We do cutting edge. Join us and GET THE EDGE.

They are also responsible for business growth, account profitability, and effectively managing teams to deliver compliant and impactful results.

**Key responsibilities**

*Client Management:*

* Acting as the lead contact for a medium portfolio of global clients and brands, ensuring relationships are strong, proactive, and solution focused.
* Applying strategic thinking to meet client objectives.
* Lead strategic workstreams including the preparation and facilitation of client workshops.
* Adapting communication style for different audiences internally and externally, including senior stakeholders.

*Commercial:*

* Understanding the commercial side of the agency to develop detailed and sizable omnichannel Statements of Work (SOWs).
* Managing a significant annual revenue target and supporting your team to deliver against your target each month and contributing to the agency's annual profitability.
* Growing the value of your portfolio through organic opportunities including proactive and value-add services.
* Leading new business pitches working with the support of the agency team to drive agency growth in innovative areas.

*Agency:*

* Working autonomously with your client services team to deliver omnichannel global campaigns across multiple channels and touchpoints.
* Supporting Group Account Director / Chief Client Officer as required, particularly on new business opportunities and strategic initiatives.
* Providing both formal and informal mentoring to junior team members, fostering their growth and development.

**About you:**

You are an experienced account manager who's worked across various brands in different industries at creative agencies. Additional experience that's beneficial but not mandatory includes healthcare and digital– because that's our day-to-day focus. Ultimately, we're looking for someone to easily slot into the multicultural dynamics of an agency team made up of 20 different nationalities.

You will be passionate about health, strategy and creativity, and about the role that our work can play in promoting strong, well-informed decisions around health issues for all audiences. You enjoy working collaboratively and are able to speak from a strong basis of knowledge.

You are someone who thrives in a close team environment, working with and through others to solve business issues. Always seeking out solutions that work for all parties, you will use your experience and social understanding to influence both internally and externally. You'll also be a firm believer in the importance of making work fun. It's advertising, right? If we're not having fun, we're not doing it right.

description:
### **Position**

**Being part of LOEWE** gives you the opportunity of learning new things every day and working with people passionate about what they do, in a fast moving and ambitious company.

As a **Stoc** **k** **K** **eeper**you will be responsible for the activities of the Back of House , ensuring the creation of an environment wh ich allows efficiency, effectiveness, and excellence in routines and execution . You will work closely with the store team ensuring the right products are available on and close to the shop floor enabling an excellent client experience.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will be:**

* Maintain the organization of the stockroom to the highest standards with merchandise stored in a clear and organised way which allows the efficient flow between front and back of house.
* Manage the delivery of stock into the store, checking that it matches against the invoice and informing HQ / Inventory of any discrepancies.

* Support the flow of stock and packaging between the back and front of house, ensuring the right products are available on the shop floor to improve efficiency and client experience.

* Process all paperwork, reports and general administration connected with stock management.
* Work with internal teams (Visual, Merchandising, Press) making available their product requests.
* Support and coordinate the aftersales process (repairs, alteration, etc) to ensure an excellent client experience.
* Fully integrate and participate in the store activities such as morning briefings, relevant training, etc.

### **Profile**

**What is important for the role:**

* Proven experience in achieving individual goals and contributing to team results
* Experience within a similar role , preferably in fashion/luxury
* Organised, with close attention to detail and able to work effectively in a fast-paced environment
* Clear communication with the ability to connect with and influence various people
* Confident to work a utonomously and as part of a team
* A deep interest in Fashion, Art and Culture
* Fluent in Spanish, English will be a plus

### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  
At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Expansion Project Manager
description:
**About Impress**

We believe everyone deserves a smile they’ll love. We are IMPRESS, the largest chain of digital orthodontic clinics in Europe, revolutionizing the invisible orthodontic sector and bringing smiles to people's faces. Our unique combination of medical expertise and digitalization has earned us recognition as one of the top fastest-growing Health Tech companies by Forbes. Born in Barcelona in 2019, we have expanded across 10 countries with more than 110 locations, offering leading care and state-of-the-art technology.

#### **Role Overview**

We are looking for an **Expansion Project Manager** to oversee the full expansion lifecycle for Impress, driving commercial growth through strategic partnerships and leading the delivery of flagship clinic construction projects worldwide. This role is responsible for identifying and closing real estate and B2B dental opportunities, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing CAPEX budgets, and executing end-to-end fit-out and site delivery.

### **Your Responsibilities:**

#### **1. Business Development & Real Estate Partnerships**

* Identify, prospect, and engage new real estate partners, including landlords, property owners, retail groups, and shopping centers.
* Pitch the Impress model to generate strong interest in hosting clinic locations.
* Build and manage an active pipeline of prospective sites, leading the full negotiation cycle through to contract signature.
* Develop and maintain an ongoing network of strategic partners, including landlords, commercial brokers, and investors.
* Represent Impress during meetings, site visits, and industry events to maximize expansion opportunities.

#### **2. Dental Partnership Development (B2B)**

* Prospect dental practices and orthodontists to establish strategic B2B partnerships.
* Present the Impress partnership model, tailor the pitch to partner needs, and execute agreements.
* Maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing partner practices to optimize ongoing collaboration.

#### **3. Construction & Project Delivery**

* Lead and manage flagship construction projects worldwide, owning each phase from design coordination and the tender process through construction, opening, and site handover.
* Manage the workload and output of regional teams involved in design and construction.
* Ensure all projects align with expansion forecasts, new opening schedules, and operational goals.
* Oversee the maintenance and remodeling of operational clinics to reflect strategic decisions, policy updates, and brand improvements.

#### **4. Budget Management**

* Build budgets prior to presentation to senior management for executive approval.
* Oversee comprehensive cost and budget management, evaluating and approving additional spending when necessary.

#### **5. Cross-Functional Coordination & Reporting**

* Collaborate closely with operations, finance, legal, marketing, and construction teams to ensure cross-functional alignment on expansion priorities and deadlines.
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders (such as Country Managers and Medical Directors) to communicate regional needs, address requirements, and mitigate escalations.
* Escalate critical issues promptly to ensure all project milestones and opening dates are met.
* Identify potential operational, financial, or delivery risks early and implement corrective solutions.
* Deliver regular, structured reporting on pipeline status, contract negotiations, construction milestones, and upcoming clinic openings.

### **What you need to be successful:**

* Academic Background: Degree in Engineering (Civil, Industrial, Mechanical, Architectural, or related field).
* Experience: 5+ years in commercial real estate expansion, retail/network rollouts, or multi-site technical project management.
* Languages: **Native or Professional fluency in English** (additional languages are a plus).
* Mobility: **Willingness to travel frequently** for site visits, contractor inspections, partner meetings, and industry events.
* Commercial & Deal-Making Track Record: Proven background in B2B sales, real estate acquisition, lease negotiation, and partnership development with landlords, brokers, and healthcare professionals.
* End-to-End Project Delivery: Direct experience managing fit-outs and construction projects from initial design and tender to contractor oversight, site handover, and maintenance.
* Financial Acumen: Strong experience formulating, tracking, and managing multi-site CAPEX budgets and construction cost accounts.
* Stakeholder Management: Exceptional interpersonal and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence C-level executives, landlords, regional country managers, and medical directors.
* Project Management & Organization: Strong organizational skills with a track record of running parallel projects across multiple regions while hitting strict launch deadlines.

title: Store Manager Barcelona
description:
**Become our Store Manager and establish Hatstore in Barcelona**
----------------------------------------------------------------

#### **Help build Hatstore’s next international store**

2026 is an important year for Hatstore. Following our first international store launch, we’re taking the next step in our retail expansion and opening a new store in **Barcelona**.

Since launching in 2011, we’ve grown into one of Northern Europe’s leading e-commerce retailers for caps and headwear. Now we’re continuing to develop Hatstore as a brand and a place to meet, both offline and online. With our store in Barcelona, we want to create an inspiring destination for caps, fashion and a great customer experience.

For this exciting chapter, we’re looking for an **entrepreneurial, driven and hands-on Store Manager** who wants to help build our presence in Barcelona from the very beginning.

**About Hatstore**
------------------

Hatstore was founded on a genuine passion for caps, creativity and innovation—and those are still what drive us forward.

Today, we have more than 100 employees and sell to customers in 55 countries. Our range includes tens of thousands of caps, beanies and hats, including the option to create custom designs.

Our international retail expansion is an important part of Hatstore’s continued growth. We’re now looking for someone who wants to help make Barcelona an important part of our international store expansion.

**Your role as Store Manager**
------------------------------

As Store Manager of our new store in Barcelona, you’ll play a key role in establishing and developing Hatstore in the Spanish market.

You’ll be responsible for the store’s day-to-day operations, building and leading your team, and ensuring our customers have an experience that reflects the Hatstore brand.

You’ll also work closely with our head office in Sweden and be an important link between the local business and our international team.

This is an opportunity to be involved from the start, influence the way we work and lay the foundations for future Hatstore stores in other markets.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

**Store launch & development**  
Take part in planning, launching and developing our new store in Barcelona.

**Leadership & team**  
Recruit, onboard, develop and motivate the store team, and build a strong team culture.

**Sales & customer experience**  
Ensure a high level of service, create an inspiring store environment and actively work towards the store’s sales targets.

**Store operations & merchandise flow**  
Take responsibility for day-to-day operations, stock, merchandise flow, inventory and orders.

**Building the brand locally**  
Help build Hatstore’s local brand through social media, partnerships, events and other creative initiatives.

**Budget & performance follow-up**  
Manage the store’s budget and key performance indicators, and monitor and report results to our head office in Sweden.

**We believe you**
------------------

* Have experience in retail, for example as a Store Manager, shop manager, team leader or in a similar role
* Are a natural leader who enjoys developing people and building teams
* Have a strong customer focus and understand what makes a great in-store experience
* Are entrepreneurial, solution-oriented and used to taking responsibility
* Enjoy working hands-on and are ready to roll up your sleeves when needed
* Have a good understanding of retail and the local market in Barcelona
* Are comfortable with social media and enjoy creating content and building a brand
* Are proficient in English, as you’ll work closely with our head office in Sweden
* Are proficient in Spanish; Catalan language skills are an advantage
* Have a genuine interest in caps, fashion, sport and streetwear

You’re also someone who gets things done. You’re sociable, down-to-earth and confident in your leadership. You enjoy meeting people and building relationships, while also being clear and direct when needed.

An interest in American sports is an advantage, as a large part of our range is connected to MLB, NBA, NHL and NFL.

**What we offer**
-----------------

**A key role in Hatstore’s international expansion**  
You’ll be an important part of our continued international retail journey and help launch our new store in Barcelona.

**The opportunity to build something from the ground up**  
You’ll have plenty of scope to influence how the store develops, how the team works and how Hatstore establishes itself locally.

**International collaboration**  
You’ll work closely with our head office in Sweden and become part of a growing international team.

**Employee discounts**  
Enjoy attractive employee discounts across the Hatstore range.

**Annual wellness allowance**  
All employees receive an individual wellness allowance that can be used for activities such as sports and outdoor pursuits, or for spa, wellness and recovery.

**A growing and passionate organisation**  
Join us on an exciting growth journey where caps, creativity, entrepreneurship and people are at the heart of everything we do.

**Become part of Hatstore**
---------------------------

We’re looking for our next **Hatstar**, someone who wants to help make Hatstore a go-to destination for caps and headwear in Barcelona.

Does this sound like you? Apply today and become part of Hatstore’s international expansion.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Principal, Talent Marketing
description:
**About us**
------------

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times as Africa's fastest-growing fintech, Moniepoint is trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of dollars in transactions monthly. Having built resilient, high-volume financial infrastructure that powers commerce across emerging markets, Moniepoint is embarking on its next phase of global scale.

**About this role**
-------------------

As our Senior Principal, Talent Marketing, you will be the strategic architect responsible for establishing Moniepoint's talent brand and candidate pipeline in new markets from scratch. Where Moniepoint is not yet an established consumer brand, you will solve complex talent acquisition problems by understanding how senior engineers, engineering managers, and technical leaders think, connect, and evaluate career moves across Europe. Working from a blank piece of paper with high autonomy, you will translate our global Employer Value Proposition (EVP) into localized, high-converting talent marketing strategies. You will bridge the gap between Talent Acquisition, Engineering Leadership, and Brand - combining developer community immersion, high-touch physical events, and targeted campaigns that turn brand discovery into qualified, closed engineering hires.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **1. Zero-to-One Market Entry & Tech Hub Architecture**

* **Define European Hub Talent Strategy:** Architect and lead the talent go-to-market strategy for Moniepoint's newest engineering hubs (principally Poland and Spain), crafting localized narratives that appeal to discerning software engineers.
* **Anchor the 'Founding Team' Narrative:** Position early European engineering cohorts as foundational builders, creating compelling narratives around technical scale, system complexity, and ownership that resonate with elite technical talent.
* **Navigate Market Nuances:** Diagnose and navigate country-specific developer dynamics—recognizing that developer communities in Poland, Spain, and the UK behave differently and require tailored engagement models rather than copy-pasted playbooks.

### **2. Developer Community, Ecosystem & Event Activation**

* **High-Impact Physical & Virtual Presence:** Conceive, curate, and lead our physical presence at key developer conferences, engineering meetups, hackathons, and university partnerships across target markets.
* **End-to-End Pipeline Activation:** Ensure events are never vanity exercises; architect end-to-end follow-up systems and talent nurture funnels that convert event attendees into active, screened pipelines for our TA partners.
* **Developer Platform Immersion:** Leverage deep knowledge of where engineers consume information (e.g., GitLab/GitHub communities, tech forums, Discord/Slack groups, Meetup, Eventbrite) to drive authentic engagement.

### **3. Strategic Hiring Campaigns & Technical Enablement**

* **Targeted Campaign Architecture:** Partner with TA leads and Engineering Directors to identify acute hiring bottlenecks and build agile, multi-channel marketing campaigns that address specialized, hard-to-fill tech disciplines.
* **Technical EVP Translation:** Translate technical architecture, distributed systems challenges, and fintech infrastructure realities into authentic, intellectually rigorous technical messaging that outshines local competitors.
* **Recruiter Enablement & Narrative Toolkits:** Equip our technical sourcing and recruitment teams with high-leverage narrative assets—outbound pitch decks, technical one-pagers, culture collateral, and messaging sequences that double recruiter outreach conversion.

### **4. Performance, Analytics & Optimization**

* **Hiring-Centric Metrics:** Discard vanity metrics. Evaluate every initiative against pipeline contribution, qualified applicant rates, candidate quality score, cost-per-hire, and time-to-fill.
* **Budget Oversight:** Own and allocate dedicated talent marketing budgets with extreme commercial discipline—scaling programs that drive measurable hires and rapidly decommissioning initiatives that underdeliver.
* **Paid Acquisition (Tactical Lever):** Oversee and strategically deploy paid recruitment marketing spend across relevant technical platforms and channels when targeted outbound and community channels require acceleration.

### **5. Strategic Leadership & Scalability**

* **Strategic Thought Partnership:** Serve as the trusted advisor to the Head of Talent Acquisition, VP of Engineering, and Brand Leadership on talent market intelligence, competitor positioning, and developer sentiment.
* **Playbook Documentation:** Establish and document Moniepoint's global talent expansion playbook, creating scalable frameworks that will be deployed across future international markets.
* **Mentorship & Functional Growth:** Provide strategic guidance to broader TA and brand team members, with the opportunity to mentor or direct junior talent marketing specialists as the function scales.

**Experience & Background**
---------------------------

* **8+ Years of Talent Marketing Leadership:** Experience leading talent marketing, technical recruitment marketing, or developer relations/advocacy, with substantial time dedicated to hiring software engineering and product disciplines.
* **European Market Expertise:** Demonstrated experience building talent brand presence and hiring pipelines across European tech ecosystems (particularly Central/Eastern Europe such as Poland, and Western/Southern Europe such as the UK or Spain).
* **Zero-to-One Market Entry Track Record:** Proven success entering new geographies or scaling talent brand where the employer brand was nascent or non-existent, creating playbooks from a blank sheet of paper.
* **Fintech & Scale Exposure:** Experience in hyper-growth fintech, high-frequency/payments infrastructure, or high-scale distributed systems environments.
* **International Collaboration:** Experience collaborating with international founding teams or distributed tech hubs across emerging and mature markets.

**Skills & Competencies**
-------------------------

* **Mastery in Event-Driven Pipeline Activation:** Extensive hands-on experience designing and executing physical and digital developer events and architecting the subsequent candidate nurturing journey that yields hires.
* **Deep Engineering Domain Fluency:** Genuine understanding of software engineering culture, tech stacks (distributed systems, backend, infra, DevOps), and developer channels (Meetup, Eventbrite, GitLab/GitHub, Reddit, tech conferences).
* **Comfort with Substantial Ambiguity:** High agency and entrepreneurial drive; ability to make decisive bets, test hypotheses, and build structure in fast-moving, high-growth environments.
* **Strategic Campaign Design:** Ability to connect high-level EVP strategy to pragmatic, sprint-based talent acquisition sprints that deliver on an aggressive hiring plan (500+ tech hires).
* **Paid Digital Campaign Optimization:** Direct experience running and optimizing paid digital recruitment advertising campaigns independently across social and developer networks.

**What success looks like in this role**
----------------------------------------

* **First 30 Days (Discovery & Immersion):** Map the competitive landscape and developer talent dynamics in Poland and Spain. Establish alignment with technical hiring leads (PEP, Engineering Directors) and TA leads to define immediate priority pipelines. Audit existing employer brand collateral and identify localized messaging gaps for European tech hiring.
* **First 90 Days (Initial Market Entry & Quick Wins):** Launch the first pilot physical event / developer meetup presence in Poland with a complete post-event pipeline conversion funnel. Roll out the European Recruiter Enablement Toolkit (localized pitch decks, outreach sequences, and technical one-pagers). Launch targeted marketing sprints for top 3 hardest-to-fill senior technical roles.
* **First 6 Months (Hub Establishment & Pipeline Ramp):** Position Moniepoint as a recognized, compelling engineering hub in Poland, supporting the identity and pride of the founding engineer cohort. Consistently contribute qualified, pre-warmed candidate pipelines directly supporting the ramp toward 500 tech/product hires. Prove multi-channel attribution showing which community and marketing initiatives are yielding quality hires.
* **Year One (Global Expansion Playbook):** Complete Moniepoint's International Talent Expansion Playbook, ready to be deployed across future tech hubs. Measurably decrease time-to-fill and increase direct outbound response rates across all European technical roles. Solidify Moniepoint's reputation as an employer of choice for Europe's most ambitious engineers.

**Why join us**
---------------

* **High-Impact Mission:** Play a career-defining role in building the engineering backbone of Africa's fastest-growing fintech as it scales globally.
* **True Ownership & Dedicated Resources:** Autonomy to build from scratch with dedicated budget backing and direct executive sponsorship.
* **Front-Row Seat to Tech Hub Creation:** Help build engineering hubs from their inception, shaping culture, talent standards, and brand identity.
* **Competitive Executive Package:** Competitive base salary (calibrated for Senior Principal level), performance bonuses, comprehensive private healthcare, and pension schemes.

#### Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.
