title: Strategy & Transformation Specialist
description:
Quiénes somos

We are TK Airport Solutions, a business unit of TKE Group.

TK Elevator (TKE) is a global leader in vertical transportation and urban mobility, providing engineering — from design through installation, maintenance and modernization — for elevators, escalators, moving walkways, passenger boarding bridges, stairlifts, platform lifts and home elevators. TKE employs more than 50.000 people around the world, being present in more than 100 countries.

From our engineering and manufacturing site in Mieres, Asturias, TKAS offers a full portfolio of airport apron and gate mobility solutions. Our **passenger boarding bridges** connect terminals to aircraft safely and efficiently. Our **ground support equipment** covers preconditioned air, ground power units and potable water units for aircraft turnaround. Our **advanced visual docking guidance systems (A-VDGS)**, including the LiDAR-based Apron Vision, ensure precise and safe aircraft docking. Our **digital solutions** — MAX Automate, MAX Monitor & Control and MAX Maintenance Manager — bring AI and remote operation to the apron.

We also provide **modernization and service** programs, including upgrades and spare parts that extend equipment life and performance, and we adapt this same engineering expertise to **seaports**, with our Seaport Passenger Boarding Bridges (SPBB) for ferry and cruise terminals.

Our equipment is used at more than 370 airports in over 100 countries, and TK Elevator boarding bridges have carried over 1.8 billion passengers worldwide.

Joining TKAS means working on real engineering challenges at global scale, combining German engineering heritage with a strong local team in Asturias, and contributing to safer, smarter and more sustainable airport infrastructure.

**Qué esperamos**
-----------------

**Your mission :** Support the Head of Strategy and the CEO Office in defining, tracking and delivering the company’s strategic initiatives. You’ll provide high-quality analysis and reporting, and use data to challenge initiative owners so that initiatives move forward, are properly prioritised and deliver the expected impact.

**What you’ll do:**

**Analysis and reporting (c. 50%)**  
Half of your time will go into turning information into decisions. You’ll prepare the management reports, dashboards and materials that committees and senior leadership use to steer the business. You’ll also run ad hoc analyses whenever a strategic question comes up, from market sizing and benchmarks to business cases for new initiatives. Working closely with the Head of Strategy, you’ll help shape executive presentations that are clear, well-grounded and ready to support key decisions.

**Strategic initiative tracking (c. 50%)**  
The other half is about making sure strategy actually happens. You’ll manage the portfolio of strategic initiatives as you would a project, keeping a clear view of owners, milestones, KPIs, risks and status. You’ll meet regularly with directors and initiative owners, not just to collect updates but to ask the right questions: what is being done and why, what impact it is having, and what is holding progress back. When something goes off track, you’ll raise it with the Head of Strategy and the CEO Office, always bringing a proposal on how to get it back on course.

**A quién buscamos**
--------------------

You have 2–4 years of experience, ideally in strategy consulting, working on strategy, transformation or operations projects. You hold a degree in Engineering, Business Administration or a similar field, and your English is strong. A master’s degree is a plus, but not a requirement.

You’re highly analytical. You work comfortably with advanced Excel and build executive-level PowerPoint presentations, and experience with Power BI or an equivalent tool is highly valued. You know how to synthesise complex information and turn it into a clear, compelling storyline.

You’re also well organised. You track milestones rigorously and can manage several workstreams at once without losing sight of priorities.

Above all, you have the presence and confidence to challenge directors without creating friction. You’re results-oriented, proactive, and you don’t wait for problems to escalate before acting on them.

**Qué ofrecemos**
-----------------

* The opportunity to join an international team working on high-impact, technically demanding projects within the airport mobility sector.
* Hybrid working model: on-site in Mieres (Asturias) with partial remote work.
* Professional development within a specialized, expanding technical environment, as part of the TK Elevator group.
* Terms and conditions to be discussed based on candidate profile.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition
description:
**Why Keyrus, Why Now!**

Keyrus is an international group of 3,000 consultants and experts across 30 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence.

AI does not replace people; it elevates us to where no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. At Keyrus, you will develop more than skills—you will cultivate judgment. Your expertise will deepen with every system you architect, client challenge you solve, and deployment that builds on the last.

Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates.

**What You'll Architect**

You will join Intake, Keyrus' international Talent Acquisition team: a cross-border team that advises Keyrus entities worldwide, combining market intelligence with strategic recruitment to help leaders make smarter, data-driven hiring decisions. In this role, you combine advisory and sourcing skills, using AI-enabled tools and talent data to find, assess and attract the people who build intelligent systems for our clients.

* Partner with Managing Directors and senior stakeholders across Keyrus entities, turning business plans into clear hiring strategies backed by real market data

* Source, engage and attract top talent in Data, AI and Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), with a primary focus on the French market and support for other EMEA markets when needed

* Recruit the profiles that power intelligent systems: AI and ML engineers, data engineers, data scientists, data architects and AI consultants

* Use AI-enabled sourcing and talent intelligence tools (e.g. LinkedIn Recruiter and Talent Insights, AI sourcing platforms, ATS automation) to identify and reach the right talent faster and more precisely

* Combine these tools with advanced human sourcing methods: headhunting, X-ray and Boolean search, growth hacking and deep networking

* Produce talent market insights on skills availability, salary trends, and competitor activity to guide where and how Keyrus hires

* Build and maintain talent pools in our core technologies, so entities can staff new client projects quickly

* Lead and deliver recruitment projects, managing the full recruitment cycle from intake to offer

* Run competency-based interviews that assess both technical depth in data and AI and consulting skills, with human judgment at the heart of every hiring decision

* Strengthening the Keyrus employer brand with data and AI communities through content, networking and community engagement

* Share your expertise in AI-enabled recruitment and help grow TA capabilities across the group

**Who You Are**

* You think beyond filling roles: you understand what the business is trying to achieve and recruit with that in mind

* You are fluent in the language of data and AI, and understand the roles you recruit for well enough to have credible conversations with engineers and consultants

* You use technology to work smarter, and you know where automation adds value and where a human conversation makes the difference

* You thrive in a cross-border team, working remotely across countries, cultures and markets

* You build genuine, long-term relationships with candidates and stakeholders

* You keep improving how we recruit, and share what works with the wider team

**What You Bring**

Qualifications/Certifications

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Business, **Psychology,** or a related field, or equivalent by experience

* 5+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally with a headhunting background

Technical Skills

* Proven success sourcing and hiring technical profiles in Data, AI, and Digital

* Experience recruiting for the French market

* Advanced sourcing skills: headhunting, Boolean / X-ray search, LinkedIn Recruiter

* Hands-on use of AI-enabled recruitment and talent intelligence tools in your daily work

* Fluent English and French (written and spoken)

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience recruiting in other EMEA markets

* Any additional language (e.g., Spanish, Portuguese, Dutch)

* Background in Resource Management (in-house, MSP or RPO), ideally with nearshore/offshore recruitment experience

* Experience recruiting EPM profiles

* Experience with recruitment analytics and reporting dashboards

* Experience recruiting for consulting firms or professional services

**What Makes You Successful**

* Clear, persuasive communication with candidates and senior stakeholders across cultures

* The ability to influence hiring decisions with market data and a well-argued point of view

* Commercial awareness: you understand how a consulting business runs and why the right hire at the right time matters

* The judgment to combine AI-driven efficiency with personal, high-quality candidate experience

* High energy, curiosity and the drive to keep raising the bar on how Keyrus recruits

**Rewards – What We Offer at Keyrus**

* A full-time contract

* Benefits and package depending on your location

* A team that supports and guides you from day one

* Plenty of challenges and opportunities to keep developing your skills

* An environment built on trust, openness and collaboration

**What We Stand For**

* Collective Intelligence — Collaboration across expertise, functions, and geographies makes it possible to combine know-how and deliver more comprehensive responses to client challenges.

* Reliability — The ability to deliver complex projects with rigour is one of the pillars of our client relationship.

* Pragmatism — Prioritising concrete impact and measurable value over abstract technological discourse.

* Entrepreneurial Spirit — Curiosity, energy, and freedom are the foundations of our culture; they enable initiative and sustained innovation.

**Our Hiring Process**

We keep our process clear and respectful of your time:

* Interview with the Intake Manager: a deep dive into your recruitment experience, sourcing approach, and use of AI and data in your work

* Initial conversation with the Intake team: to get to know you, your motivations, and tell you more about us

* Practical exercise: you walk us through your sourcing and market-mapping strategy for a Data & AI role

* Final conversation with Intake leadership

**ABOUT KEYRUS**

At Keyrus, we help organizations move from experimental AI to industrialized AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution. This is the discipline we call being an Architect of Intelligence. Designing the Operating System of an intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalize intelligence.

Powered by our proprietary Human Orchestrated Model (HOM), we architect reliable:

* Intelligence Foundations,

* Human in Command governance,

* and Performance Steering,

To create intelligent environments where technology amplifies human capabilities and performance compounds over time.

With 30+ years of expertise and 3,000 employees across 30 countries, we help organizations go beyond transformation: to build adaptive, resilient, and continuously improving intelligent organizations.

AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does.

title: Personal Assistant to the Director of Policy, Development and Advocacy (PDA)
description:
The Barcelona Institute for Global Health (ISGlobal) is a cutting-edge institute addressing global public health challenges through research, translation into policy and education. ISGlobal has a broad portfolio in communicable and non-communicable diseases including environmental and climate determinants, and applies a multidisciplinary scientific approach ranging from the molecular to the population level. Research is organized in five programs: Climate, Air Pollution, Nature and Urban Health; Environment and Health over the Lifecourse; Global Viral and Bacterial Infections; Malaria and Neglected Parasitic Diseases and Maternal Child and Reproductive Health. ISGlobal is accredited with the Severo Ochoa distinction, a seal of excellence of the Spanish Science Ministry.

### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

ISGlobal is seeking a motivated Personal Assistant to provide administrative and secretarial support to the Director of the Policy, Development and Advocacy (PDA) Department. The position will play a key role in managing the Director’s agenda, correspondence, travel and events, ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the Director’s activities.

The Personal Assistant will report to the Director of PDA and work in close coordination with the Head of Director’s Office, contributing to the effective functioning of the Area and to clear, timely communication with ISGlobal’s departments and external partners.

In parallel, this person will contribute to the organization of the PDA team’s internal events, coordination meetings and retreats, and to the logistics of high-level visits and external events.

### **MAIN DUTIES**

* Provide day-to-day secretarial and administrative support to the Director of PDA.
* Manage the Director’s agenda and the scheduling of meetings, appointments, calls and videoconferences, and monitor the Director’s email and calls, flagging urgent matters.
* Prepare and circulate meeting agendas, supporting documents and minutes, and follow up on agreed actions and deadlines.
* Draft, proofread and format correspondence, briefing notes, presentations and reports in English, Spanish and Catalan.
* Plan and organise the Director’s national and international travel, including visas and invitation letters, and prepare travel reports and expense justifications for the Accounting Department.
* Support the organisation of internal events (coordination meetings, retreats) and of external events and high-level visits, including logistics and communications to participants.
* Provide administrative support in the management of purchases, supplies and service requests for the PDA team, as well as in procedures for new staff, interns and visitors, keeping documents and files organised and confidential.
* Support the development of processes and templates for the Director’s Office, and perform other tasks as requested by the Director of PDA.

**AUXILIAR TASKS**

This job description reflects the present requirements of the post but may evolve at any time in the future as duties and responsibilities change and/or develop providing there is appropriate consultation with the post-holder.

This job description is not a definitive or exhaustive list of responsibilities but identifies the key responsibilities and tasks of the post holder. The specific objectives of the post holder will be subject to review as part of the individual professional assessment process.

### **SKILLS**

* Time management and ability to meet deadlines under pressure.
* Discretion, confidentiality and professionalism.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Must have self-motivation, eagerness to grow professionally and commitment to self-development.
* Clear written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills at all levels.
* Teamwork and collaboration.
* Proactivity and autonomy.
* Attention to detail and problem-solving ability.
* Flexibility and adaptability.
* Empathy.
* Cultural sensitivity and ability to work in an international, multicultural environment.
* Excellent Excel and Microsoft Office products.
* Working knowledge mainstream AI tools and a willingness to use them to improve everyday work processes.

The post holder will adhere to ISGlobal principles contained in **People management policy, including Equity, diversity and health safety**. The post holder will respect, and be accountable to ensure ISGlobal policies and procedures.

### **TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE / QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum education: Higher education in Secretarial Studies, Administration or related field. A university degree, as well as postgraduate studies, will be considered an asset.
* Proven experience (at least 5 years) as a secretary, executive assistant or personal assistant supporting senior management, preferably in an international, non-profit or research environment.
* Willingness to work in a collaborative, international and multicultural environment, in an institute committed to improving global health.

### **KEY RESULTS EXPECTED**

* Effective coordination and resolution of the Director’s daily operations, ensuring smooth and efficient workflows. Clear, timely, and professional internal communication between the Director’s Office and all departments of ISGlobal, fostering collaboration and alignment.
* Effective management of external relations and communications, including the preparation and dissemination of relevant content, high-level visits, and interactions with partners. To support the Director’s agenda, priorities, and operational activities to enable timely decision-making, strategic execution, and overall excellence in the functioning of the Area.

### **LANGUAGE LEVEL**

* Proficiency in Catalan, English, and Spanish.

### **CONDITIONS**

* Contract: full time, permanent contract
* Salary: 30.656€ gross annual
* Work-Life Balance: 36 days off per year (23 vacation days + 13 personal days)
* Start date: as soon as possible

### **HOW TO APPLY**

Applicants must complete the application form and upload a CV and a Cover Letter. Each document must be clearly named with the candidate’s name and surname.

Applications will remain open until 10th of November 2026.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and shortlisted candidates may be contacted and interviewed as applications are received. Interviews may take place during the application period.

We encourage diverse applications, including but not limited to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, age, sexual orientation, physical abilities, and political beliefs.

The selection process is designed in two phases:
  
1- Interview phase of a technical nature, with the team that requires the incorporation. To assess the person's skills and CV.  
2 - Meeting with HR with the finalist(s) to finish assessing the profile and discuss contractual and institutional issues.

If needed any technical test could be passed. A Psychological Competency Evaluation Test will be required for the structural or transversal positions.

description:

We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.

**Who we are supporting**

At Spektrum, we support a wide range of NATO organizations and programmes by providing highly skilled professionals across defence, security, digital transformation, engineering, and information technology. Our teams contribute to projects that strengthen the Alliance's operational readiness, enhance interoperability between member nations, and enable the delivery of critical capabilities across land, air, maritime, cyber, and space domains.

For this opportunity, our client is a private technology company that delivers advanced IT and engineering services in support of NATO programmes. Working alongside NATO stakeholders, the company provides technical expertise, software development, systems integration, and digital solutions that help modernize and sustain mission-critical capabilities. As part of this project, consultants will contribute to the development and support of technologies that underpin NATO's operational effectiveness and long-term digital transformation.

**Cloud / M365 Security Engineer**

  

**Role ID:** **TG-001-3**

  

**Role Background**  
  
The Cloud Computing Support – Expert Support (ICT Security Officer) will provide highly specialized ICT security services in support of the client, covering the ICT environment and systems defined in the overarching Service Level Agreement (SLA) between client and the Office, including the management of a dedicated Microsoft 365 tenant.  
Services shall be provided in accordance with applicable ICT governance, standards, and security policies, commensurate with the available capacity to ensure reasonable service coverage (5x8 during defined working hours), complemented by a duty officer modality outside working hours under specifically defined conditions to support and respond to urgent security-specific needs, including incident response.  
Expert Support level: the incumbent shall possess extensive relevant professional experience requiring specialized technical knowledge and skills. He/She will be expected to develop new approaches, techniques, or policies and/or design guidelines and standards of considerable depth that have an impact on the overall execution of programmes or services of a function or various interrelated areas. Expected outputs at this level include, inter alia, highly specialized technical security support and project-wide proposals.

  

**Service Scope**

**Cloud & Collaboration Environment**

* Microsoft 365 tenant: Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, and associated collaboration workloads.

* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD): identities, authentication, conditional access, and privileged accounts within the covered tenant.

* Microsoft Defender XDR suite: Defender for Office 365, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud Apps, and Defender for Identity, as deployed.

* Microsoft Purview and related compliance, audit, and data-protection capabilities, as applicable.

  

**Security Monitoring & Response Systems**

* Designated ICT security systems and services generating security reports and alerts for the covered environment.

* Threat intelligence sources and platforms relevant to the covered environment.

* Vulnerability identification and assessment capabilities applicable to the covered ICT environment and systems.

  

**Resilience & Recovery**

* Operational Resilience (OR) controls implemented and maintained by relevant operations teams across the covered ICT environment and systems.

* Disaster recovery plans and Disaster Recovery Exercises (DRX) performed by the respective operations teams.

  

**Technical Knowledge**

* Microsoft 365 & Cloud Security

* In-depth expertise in Microsoft 365 security administration: Microsoft Defender XDR, Defender for Office 365 (anti-phishing, safe links/attachments, mail-flow protection), and Defender for Endpoint.

* Microsoft Entra ID security: identity protection, risky sign-in/user investigation, conditional access design, MFA enforcement, and privileged identity management.

* Investigation and remediation of compromised accounts, suspicious e-mails, business e-mail compromise (BEC), and other cloud-borne threats.

* Microsoft Sentinel or equivalent cloud SIEM/SOAR platforms: analytics rules, incident triage, automation/playbooks, and watchlists.

* Advanced hunting using Kusto Query Language (KQL) and other environment-specific threat-hunting capabilities.
  

**Security Operations & Incident Response**

* Security incident response methodologies aligned with recognized frameworks (e.g., NIST SP 800-61), including containment, eradication, and recovery.

* Digital forensics analysis: evidence collection and preservation, log and artifact analysis, and root-cause determination for cloud and hybrid environments.

* Design, documentation, and continuous improvement of detection and response methods, procedures, runbooks, and tooling.

* Threat intelligence handling: collection, analysis, sharing, and coordination of recommended mitigation measures (e.g., MITRE ATT&CK mapping, IOC management).
  

**Vulnerability & Risk Management**

* Security assessment of ICT environments and systems throughout their life cycle, including configuration reviews against security baselines and benchmarks (e.g., CIS, Microsoft Secure Score).

* Vulnerability verification, prioritization (e.g., CVSS-based), remediation guidance, and validation of corrective measures.

* Preparation of security advisories, notifications, and remediation recommendations referencing relevant security updates.

  

**Governance, Advisory & Awareness**

* Security architecture and configuration-baseline advisory for system design, development, and modification in alignment with applicable architectural standards and security policies.

* Development of security guidelines, standards, and policy inputs with organization-wide impact, consistent with the Expert Support level.

* Preparation of end-user security awareness materials and support to awareness campaigns.

* Security reporting within established governance and reporting frameworks, including incident and status reporting.
  

**Resilience & Recovery**

* Identification and assessment of Operational Resilience (OR) controls commensurate with business requirements.

* Disaster recovery planning, coordination, and support to Disaster Recovery Exercises (DRX).

  

**Role Duties and Responsibilities**

  

The ICT Security Officer will perform, but not be limited to, the following duties in accordance with applicable ICT governance, standards, and security policies:

* Monitor, verify, and escalate security reports and alerts generated by designated ICT security systems and services.

* Monitor and respond to Microsoft 365 security incidents, including compromised accounts, suspicious e-mails, and other threats affecting the tenant.

* Conduct proactive threat-hunting activities using environment-specific capabilities, including M365 security tools and other relevant technologies, as appropriate.

* Establish, document, and maintain methods, procedures, and tools appropriate to the environment to support threat detection and response.

* Perform security incident response activities, including forensics analysis, and coordinate and advise on appropriate response measures for incidents detected by the team or reported/escalated to it from other sources.

* Monitor, share, and act on relevant threat intelligence, and coordinate the implementation of recommended measures where applicable to minimize exposure to associated risks.

* Perform regular security assessments of the ICT environment and systems throughout their life cycle (as appropriate) to identify potential security issues, provide guidance on effective remediation, and help minimize risk exposure.

* Issue security advisories and notifications to alert relevant operational teams to vulnerabilities affecting ICT systems, providing remediation recommendations including references to relevant security updates to effectively and promptly reduce exposure to associated risks.

* Verify vulnerabilities reported through various sources, notify relevant teams, provide appropriate recommendations for prompt remediation, and confirm the effectiveness of implemented corrective measures.

* Provide security-specific advice to operations teams to support system design, development, modification, and security configuration baselines in alignment with applicable architectural standards and security policies.

* Prepare and issue end-user awareness materials and support awareness initiatives to strengthen users' ability to recognize and respond appropriately to security threats.

* Prepare reports and provide regular updates on security-related issues, including incidents, in accordance with the established governance and reporting framework.

* Identify Operational Resilience (OR) controls for implementation and maintenance by the relevant operations teams across the covered ICT environment and systems, commensurate with business requirements, and perform OR assessments to verify correct implementation.

* Support Disaster Recovery Exercises (DRX) performed by the respective operations teams and coordinate the implementation of disaster recovery plans.

* Participate in the duty officer modality outside defined working hours, under specifically defined conditions, to support and respond to urgent security-specific needs, including incident response.

  

**Essential Skills, Experience and Certifications**

  

**Essential Skills:**

* Minimum 7–10 years of progressively responsible experience in ICT security roles, of which at least 3 years in cloud security operations for Microsoft 365 / Azure environments in enterprise or mission-critical settings.

* Demonstrated expert-level experience in security monitoring, incident response, and digital forensics, including response to compromised accounts, phishing/BEC, and other cloud-borne threats.

* Proven hands-on experience with the Microsoft Defender XDR suite, Microsoft Entra ID security capabilities, and Microsoft Sentinel or equivalent SIEM/SOAR platforms, including advanced hunting (KQL).

* Demonstrated experience in threat intelligence handling, vulnerability management, and security assessments across the system life cycle.

* Demonstrated ability to develop methods, procedures, guidelines, standards, or policies with organization-wide impact, consistent with the Expert Support level.

* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200) or equivalent

* CISSP, CISM, GIAC (e.g., GCIH, GCFA), or equivalent recognized security certification.

* Fluency in English, both written and oral, is required.

  

**Desirable Skills:**

* Experience with Hyper Converged Infrastructure or Software Defined Storage solutions is an advantage.

* Good presentation skills and ability to convey complex technical information to non-technical audience

* Experience with service reporting and business analytics

* Experience with cloud storage solutions (e.g., AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage)

* Experience with virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V)

* Experience supporting operational resilience, disaster recovery planning, and disaster recovery exercises is highly desirable.  
  Experience in UN, NGO, peacekeeping, or international mission environments is highly desirable.

* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100) or Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)

* CompTIA Security+ / CySA+

* ITIL Foundation

  

**Working Location:**

* On-site from Valencia, Spain or Brindisi, Italy.

* Remote work is restricted to Poland, Romania, Czech Republic, Hungary, Portugal, Greece, Slovakia and Bulgaria.

title: (Senior) Integration Engineer, ERP (Oracle)
description:
**Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!**

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

*Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.*

**About the role**
------------------

BLP only works when it talks to our customers’ ERP systems. As an Integration Engineer, you build and own those connections and keep live integrations running for enterprise customers. Every new ERP system is a new problem to solve. You’ll lead our Oracle integrations across Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards, while also contributing to other integrations.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Own our integrations with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite and JD Edwards and ensure their market fit, usability and reliability.
* Design and implement interfaces for diverse protocols: REST, SOAP, direct DB access and file transfers.
* Explore new ERP systems and determine the best way to connect them.
* Build new ERP integrations, often in close collaboration with pilot customers.
* Own existing integrations end to end, including issue resolution, and document them so teammates can pick them up.
* Enable technical project managers to consult on, install and configure mature integrations.

**What you'll bring**
---------------------

* Hands-on integration experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, ideally more than one. You have built or maintained interfaces yourself, not only used the system as a functional consultant or key user.
* Experience with the native interfaces of at least one of these:

  + **Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP:** REST and SOAP web services, File-Based Data Import (FBDI) through the ERP Integration Service, and data extraction with BI Publisher or BI Cloud Connector (BICC).
  + **NetSuite:** SuiteTalk REST and SOAP web services, SuiteQL, SuiteScript 2.x (e.g., RESTlets, Map/Reduce scripts), and Token-Based Authentication or OAuth 2.0.
  + **JD Edwards EnterpriseOne:** AIS Server and Orchestrator, Business Services (BSSV), and Z-file interface tables (e.g., F0411Z1) with their batch processors.
* A good understanding of purchase-to-pay data in Oracle ERPs: suppliers, purchase orders, receipts and supplier invoice matching.
* Solid programming skills in at least one backend language. We build our integrations in Go. If you come from Java, C#, Python or similar and are keen to pick up Go, that works for us.
* A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* A structured, self-reliant way of working, and ideally experience in a client-facing role.
* Fluent English. German is a plus, as most of our customers are in the DACH region.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with both cloud (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite) and on-premise (JD Edwards) environments, and the constraints of each (e.g., no direct database access in Fusion, governance limits in NetSuite).
* Extensive experience with SQL, common data formats (JSON, XML, CSV) and transports (REST/SOAP APIs, SFTP).
* Familiarity with modern engineering practices: Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.
* Integration experience with other ERPs, such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or Infor.

**Integration Engineer or Senior Integration Engineer**
-------------------------------------------------------

**We hire at both levels.** Four things decide where you start: years of experience, breadth of experience, coaching experience and scope.

**Integration Engineer**

* **Years:** 2+ years of hands-on integration work, including Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.
* **Breadth:** in-depth experience with one Oracle ERP and its interfaces.
* **Coaching:** you learn quickly from senior colleagues and share what you learn with the team.
* **Scope:** you deliver and maintain integrations and resolve issues independently, with guidance on architecture decisions.

**Senior Integration Engineer**

* **Years:** 5+ years of hands-on integration work, several of them with Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, NetSuite or JD Edwards.
* **Breadth:** integration experience across two or more of Fusion, NetSuite and JD Edwards, or across Oracle and other ERPs, in cloud and on-premise environments.
* **Coaching:** you have coached or mentored other engineers and help technical project managers grow.
* **Scope:** you own our Oracle integrations end to end, set technical direction and take on the most complex customer cases.

**Why BLP**

* **Real impact:** your integrations decide whether a customer goes live.
* **Breadth:** Oracle, Infor, Microsoft Dynamics and many other ERPs, plus EDI and e-invoicing standards.
* **Growth:** fast-tracked growth, with promotions and a bonus scheme that includes company shares.
* **Team:** regular team events.

Practical information

* **Location:** our Zurich office, hybrid with 3+ office days per week, or remotely from anywhere in Europe.
* If you work remotely, we pay for regular visits and stays in Zurich.
* **Employment:** full-time, permanent.

Learn more about blp and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

*Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.*

**The team**
------------

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

**About the role**
------------------

* **What you'll do and for whom.** You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.
* **Where you'll work.** You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.
* **What success looks like.** In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Build the service that product teams build on.** Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.
* **Own the persistence layer.** Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.
* **Scale BLP for large enterprises.** Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.
* **Own email, in and out.** Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI.
* **Make setup self-service.** Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own.
* **Work with customers.** Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.
* **Own it end-to-end.** From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

**Tech stack:** Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

**We're excited about you because**
-----------------------------------

* You have **4+ years of experience as a software engineer**, with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production.
* You have **2+ years of professional Go experience**, writing services that run in production, not side projects.
* You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.
* You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.
* You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.
* You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.
* You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work.
* You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

**Strong plus**
---------------

* Experience with *distributed systems*, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).
* Experience running multi-tenant systems.
* Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

**What you'll get**

* **Ownership of visible outcomes.** The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.
* **Impact at scale.** Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.
* **Senior scope from day one.** You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

Please note: Hybrid work in London office, or remote in wider UK and Europe.

title: Market Development Manager — EMEA
description:
#### **About the Role:**

Hearing care is consolidating. Regional chains are becoming national ones, national ones are going multi-country, and most of them are still running on software that cannot take them there. Auditdata already powers the largest groups in the industry. The question this role answers is which markets and which companies come next.

As Market Development Manager you own how Auditdata enters and grows beyond its established accounts across EMEA: which markets are worth opening, which chains are worth pursuing, and what it takes to get in. You will shape that view with the VP EMEA and then go and prove it in the market yourself. This is a build role, working alongside the people who actually decide — no layers to push through, no waiting for permission.

**Your mandate:**

* **Market selection:** build the commercial case for where Auditdata expands next and turn it into a prioritised target map across EMEA.
* **Market entry:** create the first real pipeline in countries where we have no presence and close the deals that establish us there.
* **Demand:** turn interest into qualified opportunity across the region and make sure what we generate matches what we have decided to go after.

Who you work with the VP EMEA on strategy and prioritisation, the VP Marketing as an equal partner on campaigns and account-based programmes against your target map, the Account Managers and Account Executives when an opportunity grows into an enterprise cycle. Pre-sales and customer success are yours to call on. Product Management is your partner in crime for shaping how to enter new markets.

#### **What You Will Do:**

* Build the EMEA target map: enter new markets, new chains, new segments, and provide the reasoning for pursuing each.
* EMEA wide inbound & outbound motions: prioritise what is important vs urgent, you are the owner of your own success across the region.
* Open conversations at the owner, operations and clinical leadership levels in companies that do not yet know us.
* Carry and close your own quota of Enterprise & mid-market deals, within your EMEA territory.
* Partner with marketing on positioning, campaign design and follow-up, so demand generation and direct outreach pull in the same direction.
* Bring the market back into the business: what competitors are doing, what buyers are asking for, where the product needs to go.
* Keep HubSpot as the single source of truth, and own a pipeline forecast the business can plan on.

#### **What You Bring:**

* 3+ years generating pipeline and winning new logos in B2B software or medtech, with success cases you are proud of.
* Proven ability to build a target market from scratch rather than work a list handed to you.
* Commercial judgement: you can argue why one market or account deserves our attention over another.
* Comfort with CRM and modern prospecting and automation tooling; HubSpot is a plus.
* Fluent English plus one additional European language - German, Dutch, French, Italian or Spanish.
* Curiosity about healthcare and a willingness to learn the audiology domain properly.
* A self-directed mindset: you will be creating this territory, not inheriting it.

#### **What’s in It for You:**

* Remote-first and async-friendly with a flat organizational structure.
* A modern IT environment: leading AI tools, HubSpot CRM and the means to automate your go-to-market.
* A real career path and leadership track, with development and certification support.
* A global, diverse team across 30+ nationalities.
* A product held to ISO 13485 and EU MDR, and a mission that matters: do this well and more people hear better, sooner.

Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway.

We look forward to your application! (***please submit your CV in English and a few lines on why this role interests you***)

*Auditdata is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to create a diverse work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills.*

title: Head of Engineering
description:
**About Pillar**
----------------

Pillar was founded in 2025. Today, we are 90+ people, serve 1000+ customers, raised €15.2M (pre-seed and seed round) and are expanding internationally.

We are building the financial operating system for construction: bringing AI, automation and modern software to an enormous industry still full of slow, fragmented processes.

**We are looking for a Head of Engineering who has built production systems with their own hands, loves making a platform stronger as it grows and wants to lead the engineers who build it.**

**Why join now**
----------------

We have product-market fit and our customers, users and data are growing fast. Now we need someone who makes sure the platform holds as everything grows many times over, without slowing down delivery.

**The mission**
---------------

Own the health, scalability and day-to-day operation of Pillar's platform: lead our engineers, keep delivery fast and the system strong, side by side with our CPO.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead and grow our engineers, who report directly to you.
* Make sure the system scales as customers, users and data per customer grow.
* Make the infrastructure calls that keep the platform easy to run, weighing each option against its DevOps and running cost.
* Set and look after the standards for architecture, code quality, testing and reviews across the monorepo.
* Map technical debt, prioritise it and pay it down with a plan everyone can see.
* Balance short-term delivery and long-term health, and make the trade-offs clear to Product.
* Run engineering operations day to day: reliability, incidents, releases, on-call and team rituals.

**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------

**Builders at heart who think at scale and lead with care**

* You have built and shipped production systems yourself, and you can still go deep in code reviews and design docs.
* You have experience in B2B SaaS, ideally multi-tenant platforms with data-heavy workflows.
* You have lived a 1 to 10 phase: scaling a product, its architecture and its engineering team after product-market fit.
* You have made infrastructure and architecture decisions at scale, and paid down technical debt without stopping delivery.
* You have managed engineers directly: hiring, setting goals, giving feedback and helping people grow.
* You explain technical trade-offs in simple words, to Product and to people who do not write code.
* You stay calm during incidents and help the team learn from them, without blame.
* You are AI-native: AI is already part of how you build and how your team works.
* Fluent English. Based in Barcelona or happy to relocate.
* Nice to have: deep Postgres, Supabase and Vercel (and knowing when to move off them), AI agents in production, ERP, fintech or construction, Italian or Spanish.

**How we work**
---------------

* Small squads, high autonomy, no unnecessary layers.
* AI-first, in the product and in the way we build.
* Simple by design: we keep DevOps overhead low and choose managed tools until there is a real reason not to.
* Pillar is not for you if you are looking for a large platform team to manage. We are building it, and you will lead it.

**Hiring process**
------------------

* CV screening
* 30-min People call with Marta
* 1-hour conversation with Lorenzo, usually in person
* Business case, prepared at home (3 to 4 hours)
* Business case presentation with Lorenzo (1 hour, online)
* Conversations with our co-founders Paolo and Gabriel
* Optional: meet our product managers

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Gross salary 100.000-120.000 €, based on experience
* **A real leadership seat:** you will own the platform as it scales, not just keep the lights on
* **A team to grow:** engineers who report to you and want to learn from you
* **The chance to build something that lasts:** the system you shape will change how an entire industry works
* **An AI-native team:** AI is part of the whole development cycle
* **Our Barcelona product hub,** with Italian roots and a team in Milan
* **People who care:** a team that celebrates wins together, gives honest feedback and has fun along the way.

Compensation Range: €100K - €120K

description:
### **Position**

The Global Social Media Specialist reports directly to the Head of Global Media and Social Media, collaborating closer with other functions and departments including global and local Marketing teams.

This role acts as a key point of contact for regional Marketing teams, ensuring alignment between global social media strategy, content creation, planning and local marketing execution.

**Your Mission:**

To manage and execute LOEWE Perfumes’ global organic social media presence, ensuring a consistent, distinctive and engaging brand expression across international markets and platforms.

The role combines global social media management, editorial calendar ownership, creative content ideation, trend analysis and global coordination.

The Global Social Media Specialist will play a key role in identifying social media trends, defining content opportunities and translating platform insights into clear, actionable creative briefs for the Creative and Content teams.

The ideal candidate combines a strong understanding of social media culture with a refined aesthetic sensibility, ensuring that LOEWE Perfumes’ unique creative universe is translated into relevant, innovative and platform-specific storytelling while preserving the brand’s luxury positioning.

### **Job responsibilities**

**Global Social Media Management & Editorial Planning**

* Manage day-to-day execution of LOEWE Perfumes’ global organic social channels, ensuring consistency in messaging, visual identity, tone of voice and content quality.
* Own the global editorial calendar, aligning brand priorities, launches, campaigns, cultural moments and key marketing initiatives.
* Oversee end-to-end content planning: identify needs, define Creative briefs, coordinate asset delivery with internal stakeholders, schedule, publish and track performance.
* Translate global campaign storytelling into platform-specific content to maximize relevance and engagement.
* Evolve the brand’s organic presence through new formats, creative approaches, and platform developments.
* Monitor audience conversations, emerging trends and community sentiment, identifying opportunities for meaningful engagement and stronger brand affinity.
* Gather community insights to inform content planning and creative recommendations.

**Creative Content Ideation**

* Identify emerging trends, cultural conversations, formats, and content opportunities relevant to LOEWE Perfumes.
* Develop original, innovative, social-first ideas that translate the brand universe into engaging, platform-specific storytelling, including content beyond global campaign assets.
* Define creative and actionable briefs for Creative and Content teams, covering objectives, key messages, storytelling, formats and platform requirements.
* Partner with these teams throughout development to optimize creative execution for each platform.
* Contribute a social media perspective to brainstorming, campaign planning and content reviews; continuously evolve the content approach through creativity, cultural awareness and performance insights.

**Global & Regional Social Media Coordination**

* Act as a key contact between HQ and regional teams, aligning organic social media planning, content and define guidelines.
* Coordinate global calendars and content deployment across markets, including Asian channels (WeChat, RED, Weibo, Douyin, LINE, KakaoTalk)
* Support reviews of regional calendars, creative proposals and local adaptations, ensuring alignment with global strategy and approval processes.
* Facilitate HQ–regional communication and content sharing for efficient workflows and timely execution.
* Monitor international social media developments, particularly in Asia, to identify trends, best practices and brand opportunities.
* Contribute to global social media guidelines and content frameworks.

**Social Media Performance & Optimization**

* Analyze organic performance across global platforms, including reach, engagement, audience growth, video views and content effectiveness.
* Produce regular reports with actionable insights to improve content and channel performance.
* Benchmark competitors and track developments across luxury, beauty and digital culture, translating findings and performance insights into creative recommendations and content opportunities.
* Partner with Paid Media to identify organic content amplification opportunities and align paid and organic initiatives.
* Support testing of new formats, creative approaches, and platform features.

### **Profile**

**Hard Skills**

* Proven experience managing organic social media channels for international or global brands, including content planning, editorial calendar management and publishing.
* Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with Instagram and TikTok, including platform-specific content formats, best practices and audience behavior.
* Previous experience or demonstrated working knowledge of Asian social media platforms, particularly WeChat, Xiaohongshu (RED), Weibo, Douyin, LINE and/or KakaoTalk.
* Experience coordinating content calendars, campaigns and social media activities across multiple markets or regional teams.
* Strong ability to identify social media trends and translate them into relevant content concepts, creative directions and actionable briefs.
* Proven experience collaborating with Creative and Content teams on content ideation, briefing, development and execution.
* Strong understanding of social-first storytelling, short-form video formats and platform-specific creative best practices.
* Ability to assess creative content from both a brand positioning and social media performance perspective.
* Experience with social media management, scheduling, listening and analytics tools.
* Strong understanding of organic social media KPIs and performance reporting.
* Awareness of digital culture, emerging social media trends and luxury industry best practices.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong creative instinct and refined aesthetic sensibility, with a deep understanding of luxury brand codes.
* Ability to translate social media insights into relevant creative opportunities.
* Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple content streams, deadlines and stakeholders.
* Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership of projects.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, particularly in multicultural and international environments.
* Ability to balance creative thinking with operational excellence and attention to detail.
* Curious, culturally aware and passionate about social media, luxury, beauty and digital storytelling.
* Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
* Analytical mindset, with the ability to translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Approachable, inclusive and collaborative.

**Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communication, Digital Media or similar
* 2–4 years of experience in social media, digital marketing
* Demonstrated experience managing editorial calendars and coordinating social media content across multiple markets.
* Previous experience developing content concepts and creative briefs in collaboration with Creative and Content teams.
* Experience or strong familiarity with Asian social media ecosystems, with an understanding of how content strategies and platform dynamics differ from Western markets.
* Experience in luxury, fragrance, fashion or lifestyle brands is highly valued.
* Proven examples of social media projects demonstrating editorial planning, creative ideation and collaboration with creative teams.
* Fluent English, written and spoken. Spanish is highly valuable; additional languages, particularly Asian languages, are a plus.

### **Additional information**

*LOEWE Perfumes represents the organic part of LOEWE. We are the unique Maison that crafts* *collectable botanical art pieces* *connected with nature in its purest form.*

*LOEWE Perfumes respects diversity and promotes inclusion from its recruitment process. We are committed to create an integrative working environment where all talents and singularities are engaged and valued.*

***LOEWE PERFUMES*** 
**MAISON**
--------------------------------

### **Additional information**

**About us:**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.

At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.

  

If you think this role is made for you, please send us your CV!

***LOEWE*** 
**MAISON**
-----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  
Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts & Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  
Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  
Radical and ever-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  
Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  
Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.

And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Regional Design Producer Lead - ( Madrid )
description:
**Regional Design Producer Lead - ( Madrid )**

Seen & Heard is a global creative agency with studios in Newcastle and London, delivering design, video production, creative communication and brand adaptation for global brands. Now we're going further. This is a brand-new role and a rare opportunity for a designer who's ready to step up, take the lead and shape how great creative lands across an entire region.

**THE ROLE**

As Regional Design Producer Lead, you'll be the **guardian of cultural and creative relevance** for your region. Global marketing toolboxes and their localisations are created in our UK design hub. Your mission is to make sure that work doesn't just arrive in your markets, it truly lands.

This is a Design Producer role first. Creative judgement and output sit at its heart, with project management running alongside. Yes, there's plenty of coordination, and you'll need to be brilliantly organised to do it well. But the real magic is this: looking at an asset built for everyone, knowing instantly how it will and won't work in your markets, and directing what needs to change. That cultural instinct is exactly why this role lives in the region, not the hub.

You'll also be the person who brings the region together. Markets get what they need faster, and for less, when their requirements arrive as one set rather than one at a time. You'll pull those requirements together, sharpen them along the way and get them in on time, then make sure the finished work gets back out to the markets just as smoothly.

This is leadership without line management: you'll lead through influence, expertise and great creative judgement. It's the perfect next step for a designer with a strong creative eye who's ready to start delivering through others, and who wants to grow with our business. You'll embody our values of **curiosity**, **partnerships**, **insight**, **agility** and **integrity**, and solve problems through beautiful design, rather than treating design as just an output.

**Where you'll fit in**

You'll report directly to a Director.

You'll partner closely with the client's creative operations lead for your region. They own the workflow, approvals, budgets and reporting. Within all of that, you're the one who **owns brief quality, cultural judgement and market consolidation**.

You'll also be part of a growing network of regional producers. They're your peers, with no reporting line either way: the people you'll swap ideas with, cover for and build a genuine support network alongside.

Expect two to three days a week in the client's office in the region, with the rest of the week working from home. And because this role is brand new, you'll have room to help shape exactly what that looks like as working relationships in the region settle.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Cultural Relevance**

This is the heart of the role, and the part that simply can't be done from the UK. It's why you'll be based in the region.

* Alongside the marketing teams in the countries, decide what adapts, what has to be made from scratch, and what is not right for a market at all.
* Check what comes out of the hub for cultural fit, inside the hub’s quality gate rather than as another approval on the end of it.
* Say when something will not work, say why, and say what would. Flagging a problem without an answer is a job half done.
* Hold a position when a market asks for something that would damage the work or the brand, and know when to concede.
* Know what is going on in the region. Retail landscape, salon landscape, competitors, language, trends and what the markets are reacting to.

**Markets and Briefs**

Every market in the region briefs through you, making you the region's creative gatekeeper. A half-finished brief costs everyone time, so you'll set the bar for brief quality and make sure every brief that reaches the hub is ready to fly.

* Be the contact for the markets in the region, and build relationships with them that go further than email.
* Quality-gate every brief before it reaches the hub. Push back, and help markets get a brief to the point where it can be worked on.
* Refuse variations that are off-brand, inappropriate or not worth what they cost. Explain why rather than simply saying no.
* Consolidate requirements so the hub gets one set from the region rather than several. These requirements need to land alongside the other regions as the model expands so scale can be leveraged in the hub.
* Coordinate with the global team what the markets keep asking for, so the next toolbox has it built in.

**EXPERIENCE**

* Producing or managing creative work across more than one market, in an agency, a brand, an in-house studio or a market team.
* Working inside established creative or operational systems, and adapting them for market or business unit.
* Running briefs/requirements and stakeholders across several countries or departments.
* Running feedback and approval rounds to a deadline, and holding people to them.
* Creative automation or AI-assisted production/operations, hands-on and current, with a clear view of what AI does well and where it does not add value.
* Reporting on volumes, progress and spend accurately and on time.
* Fluent English, and fluent in the language of the country this role is based in.

**SKILLS AND ATTRIBUTES**

* Creative judgement. Can look at a piece of work and say why it will not land in a market, and what would.
* Able to hold a position with a market, with the hub or with a client colleague, and to know when to concede.
* Highly organised. Several markets converge on this role and nothing can be allowed to fall through it.
* Comfortable being the only Seen & Heard person in the room, being able to represent the company and the work.
* Clear about the difference between a preference and a problem.
* Writes a brief someone can start work from.
* Generous with what they know, and curious about markets other than their own.

**DESIRABLE**

* A design background, and enough hands-on Adobe Creative Cloud to make a small amend without asking.
* Conversational skills in additional languages from the region.
* Beauty, fashion or FMCG background, and an understanding of salon and retail.
* Experience of a hub-and-spoke or centralised production model, from either end of it.
* Localisation or transcreation specifically, rather than general production.
* Working knowledge of a DAM or creative workflow platform.
* Experience of a business going through growth or structural change.

**What we offer**

* **Pension:** 3% matched contribution
* **Holiday:** 23 days plus bank holidays, with time off between Christmas and New Year guaranteed
* **Sick pay:** 5 days at full pay each year
* **Flexible working:** hybrid options that work for you and the team
* **Wellbeing:** free gym classes in Newcastle and rooftop sauna access in London
* **Learning and development:** monthly lunch-and-learns, plus funding and time off for relevant courses

**READY TO LEAD?**

If you're a designer who's ready to step into leadership, bring creative judgement to a whole region and help shape a brand-new role from day one, we'd love to hear from you.

**About the role**

As our Marketing Planning & Performance Manager for Iberia, you’ll lead insight-driven marketing planning, budget management and marketing effectiveness. You’ll translate global and Western Europe priorities into commercially grounded local plans. Working closely with Marketing and Finance, you’ll connect consumer, shopper and market insights with investment decisions, monitor performance and recommend action when results move off track. The position will belong to the marketing leadership team reporting directly to the Head of Marketing.

  
  

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven experience in coordinating planning cycles, tracking spend and forecasts, investigating variances and supporting month-end and year-end financial processes.
* Strong ease working with figures and complex datasets; ability to check data accuracy, identify trends and variances, interpret marketing, consumer, shopper and commercial data, evaluate effectiveness and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Advanced Excel, strong PowerPoint and confidence working with reporting and planning systems to produce accurate analysis and clear decision-ready presentations.
* Stakeholder influence and collaboration: build strong relationships across Marketing, Finance and regional teams
* Being able to connect analysis to business priorities, communicate a clear storyline and present practical recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Prioritisation, ownership and adaptability: focus on the highest-impact priorities - make trade-offs, anticipate risks, maintain attention to detail and deliver reliably under pressure
* Professional fluency in English and Spanish
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Applied marketing mix modelling, campaign evaluation, or consumer and shopper research to guide media and marketing investment decisions.
* Coordinated integrated marketing plans across multiple markets, aligning local priorities with regional direction.
  

**What you'll build**

* Coordinating the marketing contribution to Iberia’s annual strategy, bringing together insights and priorities to shape a coherent plan aligned with business objectives and Western Europe direction.
* Optimising marketing budgets throughout the year, allocating and reallocating investment in line with strategic priorities and business performance to focus resources where they can have the greatest impact.
* Balancing brand-building priorities, commercial objectives and budget constraints, including recommendations to address gaps to target.
* Translating complex performance data and marketing effectiveness findings into practical investment choices and clear stakeholder narratives.
* Improving planning tools, data quality and ways of working while building shared ownership of performance and continuous learning.
  

  

If you’ve owned a marketing budget or planning cycle and used performance data to change an investment decision, you’ll feel at home here. What matters most is making complex findings clear, practical and useful.

  
  

**Life on the team**

You will work directly with the Head of Strategy and the rest of the team, partnering closely with business leaders and subject matter experts across the organization. You can expect to spend your time both supporting the Executive Board decision-making, and working with the business to drive execution. Your contributions will drive strategic initiatives, bring new clarity to complex problems, align stakeholders through challenging trade-offs and ultimately help STG deliver our strategic ambitions. Our team are the stewards of the Focus2030 strategy, and you will play a core part in keeping the strategy alive in the business while remaining responsive to market changes and execution learnings.

This would be an ideal role for an associate-manager level consultant looking to transition into a corporate role so they can take longer term ownership of their projects and see them come to life.

  

**What your day will look like**

As a Manager in the Strategy & Execution team, you can expect to work across a wide range of projects and initiatives. Example projects could include:

* Preparing materials for the Board of Directors strategy days

* Building a business case to optimise our product portfolio to maximise growth and operational efficiency

* Project managing complex, cross-functional projects
* Creating insightful analysis (gathering, testing, combining, summarising, visualising)
* Developing frameworks to bring simplicity and clarity to complex problems and decisions
* Working closely with experts and stakeholders to identify and refine recommendations
* Running workshops with senior leaders
* Building slide decks to tell a compelling message
* Managing and supporting the development of more junior team member(s)

* Demonstrated project management experience and attention to detail
* Strong stakeholder management and team working experience
* Demonstrated strong analytical skills including experience delivering complex analyses in Excel
  + Understanding P&L / key accounting principles / Cashflow modelling is a plus
  + Understanding of data structuring principles and leveraging multiple data sources a plus
* Good slide development skills (storyboarding, content development, polishing) for C-level messaging
* A learning and growth mindset – developing yourself and supporting the development of the team around you
* Experience and curiosity in using GenAi tools to accelerate and improve your work, including effective prompting, iterative refinement and critical evaluation of AI outputs
* Professionally fluent in English
  

**What you’ll learn**

* There will be a strong investment in your development where you need it, with a variety of experiences and supportive coaching
* This could include:
  + Deepening your experience in the CPG / Retail sector
  + Refining your presentation skills, to communicate complex topics in a clear and effective way
  + Leading projects that are critical to our strategy success
  + Strengthening your stakeholder management skills in a complex, cross-functional, international organization
* This role will give exposure to senior leaders across business globally and equip you to be a transformation leader with extensive experience working alongside C-suite
* Our Strategy department, which brings together teams focused on strategy execution, consumer insights, business intelligence, data, and sustainability, will provide you with an opportunity to broaden your expertise across these disciplines too
  

**Working at STG & What to expect**

At Scandinavian Tobacco Group (STG), we are so much more than what meets the eye. We combine the strength of global brands with the entrepreneurial mindset that allows people to make a real impact. Here you'll have the opportunity to grow your career, collaborate across borders, and help shape what's next. At STG you'll find more than a role—you'll find opportunities to grow, collaborate across borders, and make a meaningful impact. Our Strategy team brings together over 15 nationalities and 20 languages, for a culturally rich and diverse environment.

We work flexibly and understand the importance of balancing work with your personal life. At the same time, collaboration is a key part of how we work, so you can expect to be in our office in Gentofte or Alcantra at least 3 days per week.

**Our recruitment process**

Before starting our hiring process, your application will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We assess each application against key competencies and requirements for the role. title: Regional People Partner - Europe Major Markets
description:

You might know us as the inventors of the bath bomb, but there’s more to this great-smelling, partly employee-owned, family-run company than pioneering cosmetics. We believe our business should put more back into the world than it takes and demonstrate that capitalism can be a force for good.
