**About Bask & Lather**

Bask & Lather is a rapidly growing beauty and haircare company dedicated to helping consumers achieve healthier hair and feel confident in their natural beauty. Rooted in a scalp-first philosophy, product efficacy and authentic storytelling, we serve customers across DTC, Amazon, TikTok Shop and national retail. Our mission is to help customers grow it and keep it too.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Director of Creative Performance to lead our paid acquisition creative function. You will turn customer insights and performance data into compelling ads, build a disciplined testing and learning process, and develop a reliable pipeline of creative that can sustain profitable spend.

Reporting to the Head of Growth, you will own creative strategy, briefs, production coordination, quality assurance, and creative performance analysis. This is a hands-on leadership role requiring analytical depth, creative judgment, and strong execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Creative strategy and testing:** Build a prioritized roadmap for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other active acquisition channels. Define customer audiences, objections, product benefits, hooks, formats, and hypotheses for each test.
* **Production and delivery:** Translate strategy into clear briefs, scripts, demonstrations, and channel-specific assets. Manage the production calendar, feedback, approvals, and delivery against agreed deadlines.
* **Creative learning and iteration:** Review results with Growth, identify why concepts perform, and turn findings into the next briefs. Expand winning concepts and diagnose weaker executions before deciding whether to revise or retire them.
* **Creators and partners:** Manage performance creative agencies, UGC partners, freelancers, and production vendors. Improve quality, turnaround time, and cost efficiency while building dependable production capacity.
* **Team and resources:** Lead assigned creative resources, establish clear ownership, and manage approved production budgets. Recommend staffing, partner, and capacity changes to the Head of Growth.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

You will own the paid acquisition creative roadmap and production priorities within approved resources. Growth owns media budgets, campaign execution, and spend allocation; you will jointly define testing conditions, evaluate results, and recommend which concepts merit additional investment.

Partner with Brand and Design to uphold brand standards, and with Product Development and the appropriate reviewers to ensure product education and claims are accurate. Coordinate with Integrated Marketing, Ecommerce, and Retention around launches, offers, customer insights, and reusable assets. Organic social, brand campaigns, and lifecycle creative are partner functions with separately agreed priorities.

**Creative Operations and Accountability**

* Maintain a searchable asset library with consistent naming, concept tagging, performance history, usage rights, and approval records.
* Plan production capacity against the testing roadmap and budget. Flag delivery risks early, resolve bottlenecks, and maintain backup partners for critical needs.
* Establish a consistent review process for product accuracy, demonstrations, brand alignment, platform specifications, and creator permissions before launch.
* Use AI and workflow automation where they improve research, ideation, briefing, reporting, or production efficiency, with human review for accuracy and quality.
* Run a weekly creative review covering results, lessons, fatigue, production status, budget, next tests, owners, and deadlines. Bring recommendations supported by evidence and clear hypotheses.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

During onboarding, you and the Head of Growth will establish baselines, consistent metric definitions, and numerical targets. The scorecard will track:

* **Creative effectiveness:** The share of original concepts that meet agreed acquisition or profitability targets at a defined spend threshold, the spend sustained by winners, and their useful lifespan.
* **Testing and learning:** Original concepts tested, meaningful hypotheses validated, and the speed at which learning becomes new creative. Track original concepts separately from asset variations.
* **Operating performance:** Brief-to-launch time, on-time delivery, cost per tested concept, budget adherence, and production capacity against the approved roadmap.
* **Diagnostic metrics:** Channel-appropriate hook and hold rates, CTR, conversion, CPA, ROAS, and fatigue indicators. Interpret these in the context of spend, audience, placement, attribution, and offer.

Acquisition and profitability outcomes are shared with Growth. Creative output volume alone will not define success.

**Required Experience and Capabilities**

* 8+ years of relevant experience in performance creative, creative strategy, or growth marketing, including leadership of creative teams or external production partners.
* A demonstrated record of developing ads that supported profitable acquisition for a consumer product brand. Beauty, personal care, or wellness experience is strongly preferred.
* Deep working knowledge of Meta and TikTok creative, with experience adapting concepts for YouTube and other acquisition channels.
* Strong analytical judgment and the ability to distinguish a creative insight from an attribution, media, audience, or offer issue.
* Hands-on skill in briefing, scripting, product demonstrations, UGC, editing feedback, and translating customer objections into effective creative.
* Experience managing production budgets, agencies, creators, timelines, and competing priorities. You set clear expectations, surface risks early, and follow through.

**Portfolio and Results Standard**

Be prepared to walk through examples showing the original hypothesis, your contribution, testing approach, spend supported, performance results, and subsequent iterations. We want to understand what you built, how you measured it, and what you learned. Share team and budget scope where possible, using anonymized information when needed.

**Compensation and Benefits**

Base salary of $170,000–$190,000, plus annual performance bonus tied to agreed role and organizational goals. Comprehensive benefits and paid time off.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

Bask & Lather is an equal opportunity employer. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities and for other legally protected needs. Applicants who need an accommodation during the hiring process may request assistance from our recruiting team.

title: Director of Design Execution
description:
### **About Switch**

At Switch, we don't just design, build and operate data centers—we are enabling the technology of the future. Led by Founder & CEO, Rob Roy, we believe in revolutionary innovation, operational excellence and the principle of karma. Switch is where talented people come together to EVOLVE the digital world.

We believe that innovation isn't just about technology—it's about the people, culture, and purpose that make it happen. Every Switch team member contributes to a mission greater than themselves: to create the world's most advanced digital infrastructure that powers the progress of humanity.

**The Role: Director of Design Execution**
------------------------------------------

The Director of Design Execution provides enterprise leadership for the practical execution, technical coordination, and field validation of data center designs across Switch's project portfolio. This role leads the team responsible for translating design intent into solutions that are safe, constructible, commissionable, operable, maintainable, and repeatable.

You will lead Design Execution from post-design handoff through construction, commissioning, turnover, and operational readiness while providing technical support throughout the infrastructure lifecycle. You will establish engineering governance, execution standards, decision and escalation processes, and feedback mechanisms that improve reliability and consistency across regions.

This role leads a team of technical subject matter experts and manages supporting third-party consultants and contractors. You will also partner closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, EHS, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders to improve project delivery and turn field experience into standards and lessons learned for future projects.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Lead and develop the Design Execution team, including technical subject matter experts and supporting third-party consultants and contractors.
* Set team priorities, allocate resources, establish performance expectations, and provide coaching and development.
* Lead Design Execution activities across the project lifecycle, including design handoff, construction, commissioning, turnover, operations support, infrastructure improvements, and end-of-life planning.
* Establish and maintain the engineering governance framework for post-IFC execution, including handoff requirements, engineering decision management, escalation pathways, design-change oversight, performance metrics, and continuous improvement.
* Translate design intent into practical field execution requirements that support constructability, commissioning, maintainability, and operational readiness.
* Oversee resolution of construction and field engineering issues, including complex procedure reviews, critical equipment concerns, and technical event support.
* Oversee engineering solutions for upgrades and retrofits that increase capacity, availability, efficiency, reliability, or operational capability across existing data centers.
* Provide technical leadership for electrical and mechanical infrastructure, including transformers, generators, UPS systems, power distribution, HVAC and cooling systems, controls, and related critical infrastructure.
* Review and interpret construction drawings, wiring diagrams, schematics, sequences of operation, specifications, submittals, and other engineering documentation.
* Partner with Design Engineering to translate field experience, operational feedback, commissioning results, and lessons learned into improved standards and future designs.
* Coordinate with Construction, Commissioning, Operations, EHS, and other stakeholders to maintain consistent technical and execution standards across projects.
* Manage engineering consultants, vendors, contractors, and other external technical resources supporting Design Execution.
* Establish processes, procedures, and tools that enable consistent execution and support customer and project requirements across data center campuses.
* Establish and monitor Design Execution performance metrics and provide project, risk, and program updates to senior leadership.
* Lead assigned engineering projects and programs and ensure delivery against schedule, budget, quality, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate maintenance windows and implementation activities with facility leadership to minimize operational disruption.
* Ensure Design Execution activities comply with applicable codes, regulations, Switch requirements, and safety standards, including NFPA 70E requirements where applicable.
* Support Operations during turnover, customer-impacting events, near misses, and other complex technical situations.
* Identify systemic issues, recurring field challenges, and opportunities to improve execution, reliability, efficiency, and cost.
* Build strong working relationships across Operations, Finance, Legal, Construction, Commissioning, Design Engineering, and other stakeholders.
* Maintain an active field presence to understand conditions firsthand and validate that solutions can be executed as intended.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* You lead technical teams with clear expectations, accountability, coaching, and consistent follow-through.
* You make sound engineering decisions while balancing safety, reliability, constructability, cost, schedule, and operational impact.
* You can make informed recommendations when technical information is incomplete or conditions are changing.
* You identify design and execution risks early and develop practical solutions before they affect project or operational outcomes.
* You communicate complex engineering issues clearly to technical teams, business partners, and senior leadership.
* You build alignment across Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Operations, and external partners.
* You establish standards and governance that improve consistency without creating unnecessary barriers to execution.
* You use field experience, data, root cause analysis, and lessons learned to drive continuous improvement.
* You develop internal talent while holding consultants, contractors, and other external resources accountable for quality and results.
* You are comfortable spending time in the field to understand problems firsthand and validate solutions.
* You demonstrate the judgment, accountability, collaboration, and leadership expected under Switch's Culture Codes.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive engineering experience supporting industrial, commercial, or mission-critical facilities such as data centers, power generation, or oil and gas facilities.
* 5+ years of experience leading engineering teams, technical professionals, consultants, or comparable resources.
* 4+ years of project management experience supporting data center engineering or comparable mission-critical infrastructure.
* Deep understanding of electrical and mechanical systems used in mission-critical environments, including power distribution, transformers, generators, switchgear, UPS systems, cooling systems, HVAC, controls, and fire protection.
* Experience leading or supporting construction, commissioning, turnover, operational readiness, retrofit, or infrastructure improvement activities.
* Experience managing engineering projects, consultants, contractors, and other external technical resources.
* Experience reading, interpreting, and reviewing construction drawings, specifications, submittals, wiring diagrams, schematics, sequences of operation, and MEP documentation.
* Experience with EPMS, SCADA, BMS, or comparable monitoring and controls systems.
* Strong knowledge of safety requirements and applicable OSHA standards for multi-megawatt or mission-critical facilities.
* Working knowledge of NFPA 70E and electrical safety requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute solutions for complex engineering and operational problems.
* Strong project and program management, prioritization, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Experience using engineering, project management, calculation, data analysis, and collaboration tools.
* Ability to support after-hours or weekend activities when required for critical projects, maintenance windows, commissioning, or operational events.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally as business needs require.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Professional Engineer registration or other relevant professional engineering certification.
* Experience leading enterprise or multi-region engineering programs within data centers or other mission-critical environments.
* Experience establishing engineering governance, technical standards, design-change processes, or post-IFC execution frameworks.
* Experience supporting root cause analysis, fleet optimization, lifecycle management, and infrastructure reliability programs.

We recognize that qualified candidates may not meet every preferred qualification. If your experience aligns with the core responsibilities of the role, we encourage you to apply.

### **Why Switch?**

* A Culture of Karma – We are self-motivated by karma, ensuring our actions contribute to a positive, supportive and forward-thinking environment.
* Industry Leading Designs – Work with the most advanced data center technology on the planet and be a part of emerging technology development.
* Flexibility & Remote Opportunities – Whether in-office, hybrid, or fully remote, we offer the technology and support to keep teams connected and productive.
* Career Stability & Growth – In this expanding industry, we invest in our people, providing opportunities & advancement in a stable, growing company.
* Generous Benefits Package - Switch provides comprehensive coverage for you and your family that can be tailored to fit your personal needs, and more!

### **Join Us & Make a Difference**

This is more than a job—it's a mission. If you're ready to be part of a culture that values innovation, karma, and limitless potential, we want to hear from you.

Apply Now and Let's Build the Future Together.

title: Director of Product Design
description:
Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology.

Beacon Biosignals is seeking a Director of Product Design to lead and grow our Product Design function. Product Design at Beacon is a shared function that serves the entire business: the hardware experience of our EEG headbands and other devices, the mobile apps that participants and patients use at home, the web applications that clinical teams and trial sponsors rely on, the printed materials that guide patients and site staff, and the design of internal business processes across logistics, support, and clinical operations. In this role you'll lead a team of three senior product designers, set the vision for how design works at Beacon, and plan the function's growth as the company scales. We expect this role to stay close to the craft. You'll model best practices directly alongside the team, not just direct it from above. This role reports directly to Beacon's VP of Platform.

Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first-class remote work experience, but we also have in-person office hubs located in Boston, New York City, and Paris. For this position, candidates based in the Boston or surrounding area are preferred

**What success looks like:**

As a successful Director of Product Design at Beacon, you'll...

* Lead and coach a team of three senior product designers, helping each of them grow their craft, expand their impact, and build a clear path forward in their careers.
* Craft, iterate, and execute on a vision for what product design should be at Beacon, and translate that vision into a concrete plan for how the function grows alongside the business.
* Operate as a player-coach, particularly in your first year: taking on design work yourself where it sets the standard, demonstrating the practices you want to see, and raising the bar by example rather than by directive.
* Own prioritization across the full breadth of Beacon's design surface, from device and mobile to web, print, and business process, making the tradeoffs that determine where a small, senior team spends its time and ensuring no single designer becomes a bottleneck for the company.
* Build the cross-functional connections that design depends on, partnering closely with Device Engineering, Platform, Clinical Operations, Logistics, Support, and Quality to bring design into decisions early rather than at the end.
* Establish the processes, standards, and shared systems that let design scale: a coherent design language across hardware and software, reusable patterns, and design reviews that improve quality without slowing delivery.
* Ensure design's contribution to Beacon's regulated products is rigorous and well-documented, partnering with Quality and Regulatory on usability and human factors work for our cleared devices.
* Own the headcount plan, budget, and vendor relationships for the function, and make the case for investment in design with the same rigor you'd bring to a design problem.
* Develop a deep understanding of everyone Beacon serves: patients using our devices unsupervised at home, the clinical staff and healthcare providers who care for them, the site teams running trials, and the sponsors who rely on the insights we deliver. Build the research practice that keeps that understanding current.
* Develop an equally deep understanding of how Beacon itself operates, so that design serves our internal teams as well as our external users, from device provisioning and logistics through support and scientific services.
* See around corners: anticipate where design debt, inconsistency, or unowned experience problems are accumulating, and address them before they become urgent.

**What you will bring:**

* 10+ years of product design experience, including 4+ years managing and developing designers.
* Experience building or substantially maturing a design function. You know what the first eighteen months of that work actually look like.
* A portfolio that spans both hardware and software experiences. You're comfortable moving between a physical device, a mobile app, a data-heavy web application, and the printed material that ties them together.
* You have experience and familiarity working in the medical device space, clinical diagnostics, real-world-data, pharma/biotech or other related fields.
* You've worked in a regulated industry before, and have successfully navigated the tension between fast-paced iterative design and strict design controls. Familiarity with usability engineering and human factors practice (e.g. IEC 62366, FDA human factors guidance) is a strong plus.
* You're genuinely energized by coaching senior individual contributors. You can give feedback that a strong, experienced designer will respect and act on.
* You're comfortable being hands-on without defaulting to it. You know the difference between modeling the work and doing the work because it's easier than delegating it.
* Experience designing service and business process experiences, not just product interfaces. You've improved how an organization operates, not only what it ships.
* You bring strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to align partners around decisions, tradeoffs, and evolving plans, including in regulated or quality-sensitive environments.
* You demonstrate a bias towards simplicity, avoid misallocating complexity, and try to impose structure at the right time - not too early or too late.
* You're comfortable working in a highly asynchronous remote work environment, and have demonstrated success doing so in the past.

The base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $215,000, depending on past experience, specific skills, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits.

At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self-service mindset, and - most of all - a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

title: Patient Experience Advisor
description:

As a member of the team, you will help us create value for our clients, you will make us better through your contribution to the work and your voice in the process. We empower organizations to deliver the best experiences. With industry expertise and technology, we turn data into insights that drive innovation and action.

Press Ganey is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities or disabled veterans in the hiring process. If you need assistance or an accommodation to apply for a position online or for your interviews or assessments, please contact us at acommodations@pressganey.com Please provide your contact information and the details of your request so we can best assist you.

title: Vice President Brand and Creative Remote
description:
From Aisle to Algorithm and for All Life’s Moments, at David’s Bridal, we empower our customers and our employees to stay true to their dreams and find the one, whether that means the event or the wedding dress that matches a personal style—or the career that is a perfect fit. Join a company that dominates the products in their category – 1 out of 3 being sold by them and taking care of them with one of the highest customer service scores in retail!
  
If you are passionately enthusiastic, endlessly curious, and customer obsessed, say “I do” and apply today!
  
#LI-Remote
  
  
Pearl | David's Bridal
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly creative, strategic, and hands-on Vice President of Brand & Creative to own and bring to life the Pearl and David's Bridal brands across every consumer, business, retail, digital, and media touchpoint.
  
  
This leader will be responsible for the day-to-day stewardship and evolution of both brands, including brand identity, positioning, tone of voice, creative direction, messaging, and storytelling. They will ensure that Pearl and David's Bridal each have a distinctive and compelling brand identity while working together as part of a connected ecosystem.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who is as comfortable creating the work as they are leading the people behind it. We are looking for a builder and a doer who brings strong creative instincts, exceptional storytelling abilities, and the ability to turn ideas into exceptional execution. This person will work shoulder-to-shoulder with internal creative teams, writers, producers, and agency partners to develop concepts, shape narratives, refine copy, solve creative challenges, and bring campaigns and content to life.
  
  
**The VP will lead three core functions:** Creative & Design, Copy & Editorial, and Media & Programming. This includes creative and editorial oversight of The Wink, blogs, Love Stories TV (e.g. podcasts, original programming, and the broader Pearl digital media network), in close partnership with leadership and existing production teams.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines the strategic thinking of a brand leader, the taste and executional ability of a creative director, the storytelling instincts of an editor, and the operational discipline to deliver exceptional work in a fast-moving organization
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Brand Ownership, Voice & Storytelling
  
  

* Serve as the day-to-day brand owner for both Pearl and David's Bridal, responsible for how each brand looks, sounds, communicates, and connects with its audiences.
* Own and evolve brand positioning, identity, personality, messaging frameworks, tone of voice, and storytelling across all channels.
* Build and maintain distinct brand narratives for Pearl and David's Bridal that reinforce their individual value propositions and complementary relationship.
* Translate enterprise strategy, business priorities, products, partnerships, and innovation into compelling brand stories that resonate with consumers, wedding professionals, and business audiences.
* Develop and maintain brand guidelines, voice and tone frameworks, visual identity systems, and editorial standards.
* Personally contribute to the development and refinement of brand narratives, campaign concepts, messaging, headlines, scripts, and other high-impact creative work.
* Ensure brand consistency across digital, retail, social, editorial, media, and corporate touchpoints.
* Act as a trusted brand steward and creative problem-solver across the organization, helping teams translate business needs into compelling communications and experiences.

2. Hands-On Creative Leadership & Execution
  
  

* Lead and actively work alongside the in-house creative team, including designers, art directors, copywriters, editors, and content creators.
* Participate directly in brainstorming, concept development, creative production, writing, editing, and execution.
* Drive the development of creative concepts and storytelling for brand campaigns, seasonal initiatives, product launches, and major business priorities.
* Work closely with external agency partners, providing direction while also actively collaborating on creative strategy, ideation, production, and problem-solving.
* Review, edit, and elevate creative work, providing specific, actionable feedback that improves both the quality of the output and the capabilities of the team.
* Step into the work when needed, whether refining a headline, rewriting a narrative, shaping a campaign, developing a brief, or helping the team meet a critical deadline.
* Balance strong creative instincts and high standards with a practical, solutions-oriented approach that drives work forward.
* Ensure creative teams and agency partners operate as an integrated extension of the business rather than separate production resources.

3. Creative & Design
  
  

* Oversee the creative and design function responsible for campaign creative, brand systems, visual storytelling, graphic design, photography, video creative, and asset production.
* Lead creative development across websites, ecommerce, advertising, organic social content, email, retail, editorial, and corporate initiatives.
* Maintain a cohesive and differentiated visual identity for both Pearl and David's Bridal.
* Own creative standards and brand presentation across David's Bridal retail environments, including signage, promotional materials, and guest-facing visual communications, in partnership with Retail Operations.
* Establish efficient creative processes, including briefs, workflows, production schedules, reviews, and approvals.

4. Copywriting, Editorial & Content
  
  

* Own brand voice, copywriting quality, editorial strategy, and storytelling standards across Pearl and David's Bridal.
* Lead and actively contribute to copy development across campaigns, websites, digital marketing, brand initiatives, product storytelling, and other communications.
* Oversee the editorial vision, content calendar, writing, editing, and production of The Wink.
* Lead the development of blogs, editorial articles, guides, interviews, features, and other written content across both brands.
* Ensure content is engaging, differentiated, audience-relevant, and aligned with brand voice and business objectives.
* Partner with SEO and digital marketing teams to align editorial content with organic discovery and engagement opportunities.
* Collaborate with Media Sales on sponsored editorial and branded content development, while advertising sales and commercial relationships remain with the media organization.

5. Digital Media, Love Stories TV & Original Programming
  
  

* Partner with Pearl media leadership to shape the creative and editorial direction of the Pearl Digital Media Network.
* Provide creative leadership for Love Stories TV, podcasts, original programming, video series, and other multimedia properties.
* Work directly with existing production leaders, writers, hosts, and producers on programming concepts, storytelling, formats, scripts, and creative quality.
* Help develop and refine original content franchises that extend Pearl's brand reach and strengthen its content ecosystem.
* Ensure each media property maintains its unique identity while reinforcing Pearl's broader brand strategy.
* Collaborate with media leadership on branded entertainment, sponsored content, and advertising integrations from a creative and editorial perspective.
* Support cross-platform content development and repurposing to maximize the value of existing creative assets.

6. Cross-Functional & Agency Collaboration
  
  

* Serve as a hands-on creative and brand partner to Marketing, Communications, Social, Ecommerce, Product, Retail, Media, and Partnerships.
* Collaborate closely with agency partners, contributing directly to strategy, concepts, messaging, and execution rather than solely overseeing agency deliverables.
* Own creative asset development and brand alignment for designer collaborations, licensing initiatives, wholesale programs, activations, and brand partnerships.
* Support corporate, executive, and investor communications through storytelling, presentation design, visual communications, and creative content development.
* Partner with Social Media on content concepts and production, while channel management, publishing, and distribution remain with the Social team.
* Champion consistency and creative excellence across internal and external teams

7. Team Leadership & Creative Operations
  
  

* Lead and develop three integrated pillars: Creative & Design, Copy & Editorial, and Media & Programming.
* Build a culture of collaboration, accountability, creative excellence, and hands-on problem-solving.
* Coach and mentor team members through direct collaboration, constructive feedback, and active participation in the creative process.
* Manage creative resources, workflow prioritization, project timelines, budgets, agencies, and external partners.
* Establish clear KPIs related to brand consistency, creative quality, content production, operational efficiency, and on-time delivery.
* Identify opportunities to improve team productivity and content scalability through emerging technology and AI-enabled creative tools.
* Maintain a willingness and ability to personally execute when needed, while developing a team capable of delivering consistently excellent work.

Qualifications
  
  

* 12+ years of experience in brand, creative direction, copywriting, editorial, content, or related disciplines, with demonstrated leadership experience.
* Proven experience owning and evolving consumer-facing brands, including visual identity, tone of voice, messaging, and storytelling.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating both strategic creative thinking and personally developed or directly executed work.
* Exceptional writing, editing, conceptual, and storytelling abilities.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams while remaining deeply involved in day-to-day creative development and production.
* Demonstrated success collaborating directly with creative agencies, production partners, and cross-functional business teams.
* Experience across integrated campaigns, digital content, editorial publishing, video, and multimedia storytelling.
* Strong creative judgment, attention to detail, and ability to deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.
* Ability to move fluidly between high-level brand strategy and detailed creative execution.
* Strong project management, prioritization, and operational skills.
* Experience in consumer lifestyle, fashion, retail, ecommerce, publishing, or media preferred.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
**Two strong, differentiated brands:** Pearl and David's Bridal each have a clear identity, voice, personality, and compelling story, consistently expressed across every touchpoint.
  
  
**Exceptional creative work:** Campaigns, content, and brand experiences reflect a high standard of creativity, storytelling, and execution.
  
  
**A true player-coach:** The VP actively elevates the work by creating, writing, editing, and solving problems alongside the team.
  
  
**A unified creative ecosystem:** Internal teams, media producers, and agency partners work collaboratively and efficiently.
  
  
**Strong editorial and content output:** The Wink, blogs, Love Stories TV, podcasts, and original programming demonstrate consistent quality and creative direction.
  
  
**An empowered, accountable team:** Creative, editorial, and media teams have the guidance, support, and structure to deliver great work at scale.
  
  
Now that we’ve popped the question, please say “I do”.
  
  
Full Time Opportunity – A comprehensive benefits package is available.
  

* Rewarding Environment and Competitive Pay
* Generous Dream Maker Discount After First Pay Period
* Referral Incentive Program
* Dayforce Wallet – Get Paid Early!
* Health/Dental/Vision Insurance
* 401K Program
* Paid Vacation, Wellness Days & Holidays, including your Birthday off!
* Pet Benefits

Love wins when love is for Everyone!
  
Our mission at David’s Bridal is to embrace the ideas of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. It is our goal to build a workforce that is as representative as the customers we serve. We vow to create a culture where all forms of diversity are celebrated and seen as valuable.
  
  
David’s Bridal encourages applications from all qualified candidates. David’s Bridal has a great record of accommodating persons with disabilities. Contact Human Resources at humanresources@dbi.com or 610.943.5048 if you need accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information on our accommodation policies.
  
  
**Policy:** Candidate Use of AI in Live Interviews
  
We conduct interviews to evaluate each candidate’s own knowledge, judgment, and communication. During any live interview (virtual or in-person), candidates must not use real-time generative AI tools to compose or feed their answers. Candidates may use assistive technologies (e.g., screen readers, live captions) and may request reasonable accommodation in advance.

It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive description of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. Actual duties and responsibilities will vary. The standard base pay range for this role is posted at a minimum and maximum rate.
  
  
The starting rate of pay offered will vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, training, and/or experience, and internal equity. This base pay range is specific to the state this role is posted in and may not be applicable to other locations.
  
At David’s Bridal, it is rare for an individual to be hired at the high end of the range in their role, but instead closer to the midpoint of the posted range, and compensation decisions are dependent upon the details and circumstances of each position and candidate.

title: General Manager
description:
**Job Title:** General Manager  
**Company:** Teletask  
**Location:** US, Remote  
**Employment Type :** Full-time

**About Teletask**

Teletask powers public sector communication. Government and public health agencies use our automated text, voice and email outreach, two-way texting and digital workflows (surveys, e-signature, scheduling) to reach the families they serve. Our largest footprint is WIC (Women, Infants & Children) nutrition programs, where Teletask messaging drives appointment attendance for over 6 million participants across 38 US states, with more than 100 million messages sent each year.

Teletask is part of Solen Software Group, which acquires and holds vertical market software businesses for the long term. The business is now at an inflection point and looking for a General Manager who will lead its next chapter of growth and build the commercial engine, team, and operating infrastructure to match the product.

**The Opportunity**

This is a general-manager role for someone who knows the industry from the inside. You will own the business's P&L, its growth, its product direction, its most important customer relationships, and its team, reporting to a Solen Portfolio Leader or Operating Partner and working within Solen's business systems and targets.

**What You Will Own**

**Business Performance**

* Own the full P&L: revenue, gross margin, EBITDA, net revenue retention and cash.
* Run a monthly operating cadence (KPIs, forecast vs. plan, actions) and report it to your Solen Portfolio Leader.
* Move the business up a Business Health Score (BHS) tier and improve its Rule of 40 through deliberate trade-offs between growth and profitability.
* Deliver the business's EBITDA growth as its contribution to Solen's Yearly Operations Goal (YOG), our portfolio-wide EBITDA growth target.
* Lead budgeting and forecasting with ROI discipline on every initiative and hire.

**Organic & Inorganic Growth**

* Grow ARR at a double-digit rate every year through new logos, expansion, pricing and retention.
* Own the pipeline from first contact to signed agreement across agency directors, state IT and operations leaders, and procurement officers.
* Build the sales playbook: ICP, outreach, discovery, proposal framework and RFP responses, with a repeatable path from local agency to statewide contract.
* Own pricing: re-evaluate customer usage, then set packaging, contract terms and price increases on the existing customer base.
* Cut churn by finding at-risk accounts early and running retention plays.
* Map the acquirable companies in the industry; source and qualify add-on targets and support integration.

**Industry Vision & Product Roadmap**

* Own a 1–3 year thesis on where the industry is heading: regulation, workflows, buyers and technology.
* Turn the thesis and customer needs into a roadmap ranked by ROI and by development effort vs. time-to-market.
* Partner with product and engineering leads on delivery; find adjacent workflows the business can serve.

**Customer & Market Leadership**

* Personally own executive relationships with the top accounts, including renewals, escalations and major expansions.
* Hold growth, NRR and logo-retention targets.
* Coordinate client services, onboarding and product so customers adopt more and expand.
* Represent the business at WIC, public health and government technology conferences and associations to build brand and pipeline; work with Solen Marketing on materials and web presence.

**Team, AI Leverage & Value Creation Plan**

* Lead a team of 5–10. Hire, develop and, where needed, replace people so that 90%+ of key seats are held by A players, and build the documentation and cross-training that keep the business running through any leadership change.
* Drive AI adoption across every function and build revenue-generating AI capabilities into the product.
* Own and deliver the multi-year value creation plan (VCP) that drives the business's contribution to the YOG.

**Who You Are**

* **Hands-on industry operator.** Real depth in the industry; equally comfortable in a strategy session, a customer escalation and a roadmap trade-off.
* **Player-coach.** Gets outsized output from a small team through systems, not headcount.
* **Commercially credible.** Sells, retains and expands accounts personally.
* **Numbers-driven owner.** Applies ROI discipline to every roadmap item, initiative and hire, and thinks in years, not quarters.
* **Principled.** Lives the Solen-isms and the Solen Principles of Transformation, and runs the business on Solen's business systems.

**Requires Qialifications**

* 8+ years in operations, sales, business development or general management, including 5+ years in the industry or selling into it.
* Fluent in how government health and human services programs operate, who buys, and how they are funded.
* Has owned a P&L or a functional budget and can speak to its figures and the monthly metrics they reported.
* Documented multi-year revenue growth that they personally owned, with before and after numbers.
* Has personally closed and expanded major accounts; can provide customer references in the vertical.
* Has hired and, where needed, replaced direct reports.

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience buying or selling B2B software to customers in the industry.
* Has led price increases, packaging changes, churn reduction or product repositioning.
* Has sourced, diligenced or integrated an acquisition.
* Visible in the industry through speaking, associations, analyst relationships or a recognized network.
* Has built and delivered a multi-year operating or value creation plan with stated targets.
* Has deployed AI in a business function or product.
* Understands how state and local health department procurement works: RFPs, statewide contracts and reseller channels.

**What Success Looks Like**

**First 90 days**

* Meet the top state and local agency accounts, take over founder-held relationships, and surface upsell opportunities and at-risk accounts.
* Map the customer base by program (statewide WIC, local WIC, public health, other), usage, price per participant, expansion potential and risk.
* Learn the P&L and set up the monthly operating cadence.
* Assess the team against key seats, name any gaps, and identify processes that depend on a single person.
* Build the first outbound sales playbook: ICP, outreach, discovery questions and proposal framework, starting with WIC states not yet served.
* Draft the first industry thesis and a shortlist of AI opportunities, building on the AI features already in the product.

**First 12 months**

* ARR growing at double digits, in line with the VCP target, with new states won and local agencies converted to statewide contracts.
* BHS tier improved and EBITDA contribution to the YOG on track.

description:
**About Us**
------------

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. **About Us**
------------

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles and Fanatics Live. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and shop live. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.

**About FES Marketing**
-----------------------

FES Marketing is the growth engine for the Fanatics ecosystem. We bring sports fans into the Fanatics App, activate them in their first days, and cross-sell them across Commerce, Collectibles and Live, so the app becomes each fan's front door to everything Fanatics. The team spans FanApp Growth (early life, referral, paid acquisition, growth investment and cross-sell), Brand Media + Partnerships, Marketing Investment + Effectiveness, and AI + Automation. Three standards apply to every role: we judge spend on blended customer acquisition cost (CAC) against the 12-month activated ecosystem margin it creates per logged-in install; we fund what we can show is incremental, not what platform attribution claims; and we work AI-native, using AI and agentic tools in how we plan, analyze and operate.

**Overview**
------------

The Director, Marketing Investment + Effectiveness is accountable for how much FES spends on marketing, and how that money is split between brand and performance. You will lead the FES marketing budget with Finance, own the annual and quarterly investment plan that goes to the SVP and executive team, and hand FanApp Growth and Brand Media + Partnerships clear budget envelopes with the return each is expected to deliver.

Once a team has its envelope, that team decides how to deploy it and drives its own paybacks. This role decides the envelopes: how big the total is, how it splits between brand and performance, and when to move money between them. It also owns the evidence behind those calls (a marketing mix model calibrated by experiments, and the FES test agenda) and the scorecard that shows whether the plan is working.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Lead the FES marketing budget with Finance: total envelope, annual plan, quarterly phasing and the reforecast cycle.
* Own the FES investment plan presented to the SVP and executive team: how much we spend, the brand versus performance split, the expected return on each, and the risks.
* Set the brand and performance envelopes, and the return guardrails each must meet (e.g. blended CAC and payback for performance; reach, awareness and demand for brand).
* Decide in-year moves between brand and performance, using portfolio-level response curves and marginal rather than average return.
* Own the marketing mix model (in-house or vendor): design, calibration with experiments and falsification checks, as the single source of truth for the incremental return of brand and performance spend.
* Own the FES test agenda and governance: incrementality tests prioritized by budget at stake, pre-registration, power and sample size, no early looks before the registered read, decision rules (scale, hold, cut) and a shared log of results. Test cells are designed with the teams that run the media.
* Set FES metric standards (blended versus paid CAC, value windows, denominators) so the investment plan, the scorecard and team reporting all use the same reconciled numbers.
* Build and lead the team, starting with hiring the Manager, Marketing Investment + Effectiveness.
* Partner with Data Science and Analytics on cohort value models and early value signals, and on what they can and cannot support.

**Experience & Skills**
-----------------------

* Significant experience leading marketing budgets, investment planning or marketing effectiveness at a consumer business, agency or consultancy.
* Track record of setting brand versus performance splits and defending them with Finance and senior leaders.
* Hands-on experience building or managing marketing mix models and incrementality experiments, including geo tests.
* Strong financial planning and modeling skills: budgets, reforecasts, unit economics and payback.
* Strong grounding in causal inference and statistics, and the judgment to know when a result is not strong enough to act on.
* SQL required; Python or R strongly preferred.
* Experience building and leading analytical or planning teams.
* Excellent executive communication, including explaining uncertainty plainly.
* Hands-on, everyday user of AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) to work faster and better, and curious about new ways to apply them.
* Background in marketing finance, marketing science or strategy; consumer app experience a plus.
* Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Statistics or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
* Passion for sports, fandom and building customer-first experiences.

Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi-day cultural immersion in New York City for full-time, non-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process.

For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/

At MPG, we value our people and their contributions; they are critical to building the MPG Brand. Our highly regarded, seasoned team of 600+ strategy and commercialization professionals brings strong operational experience and a collaborative approach. All team members are singularly focused on providing clients with pragmatic, real-world market approaches, built on the strong consumer, category and marketplace insights needed to create sustainable, profitable brand growth.

  

**Position Overview**

MMPG was built on the foundation of Consulting, and our Consulting team serves as the strategic and commercial engine of the company. We partner with leading CPG manufacturers and retailers to solve complex business challenges and unlock growth opportunities across brand strategy, commercialization, sales, retail execution, innovation, and go-to-market transformation.  
We are seeking a highly commercial, action-oriented consulting leader who can both shape strategic recommendations and personally build high-impact client deliverables. This role requires a combination of executive-level thinking, strong storytelling capabilities, deep CPG and retail expertise, and hands-on content creation.  
The ideal candidate is equally comfortable leading client conversations, synthesizing complex data into actionable insights, building compelling presentations independently, and leveraging AI-enabled tools to accelerate the quality, speed, and effectiveness of consulting outputs.  
We are looking for someone who is resourceful, intellectually curious, and willing to “do the work” alongside the team. Someone who can independently create high-quality content, drive strategic thinking, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial consulting environment. The Director, Consulting reports to the EVP, Consulting and plays a key role in shaping client impact, team capability, and MPG’s continued growth. **This is a 100% remote position.**

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Create High-Quality Client Deliverables**

* Synthesize large amounts of information into concise, actionable takeaways for executive audiences.
* Ensure final outputs are accurate, commercially relevant, visually compelling, and aligned to client objectives.
* Leverage AI-enabled tools to accelerate content development, insight generation, storytelling, and presentation creation while maintaining high standards of quality and strategic thinking.

**Operate with Agility in a Fast-Paced Environmen**t

* Manage multiple client engagements simultaneously while maintaining exceptional quality and responsiveness.
* Navigate ambiguity and shifting client priorities with strong judgment and adaptability.
* Proactively identify risks, roadblocks, and opportunities to improve project outcomes.
* Communicate clearly and consistently with both internal and external stakeholders

**Required Skills and Capabilities**

* Strong commercial acumen with deep understanding of CPG growth drivers, retailer dynamics, commercialization, and go-to-market strategy.
* Critical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to convert ambiguity into actionable recommendations.
* Proven ability to independently create executive-level presentations and client-ready deliverables.
* Outstanding storytelling and communication skills with strong executive presence.
* Ability to synthesize complex analyses into clear, concise, commercially relevant insights.
* Hands-on proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel with strong content creation capabilities.
* High level of proficiency leveraging AI platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity) to accelerate insight generation, develop content, and improve deliverable quality.
* Strong client relationship management and influence skills across multiple organizational levels.

* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Coaching and team development skills with the ability to elevate strategic thinking and execution across project teams.
* Strong communication skills to thrive in a virtual and matrixed team environment.
* Highly collaborative, resourceful, and accountable team player with a bias for action and continuous improvement.
Robust knowledge of CPG industry and category, brand, and retail strategies; sales strategy experience a plus.  

**Experience and Education**

* 10 to 15+ years in CPG industry in Consulting, Sales Strategy, Commercial Strategy, Marketing, and/or General Management within CPG and retail.
* Demonstrated success leading strategic client engagements and delivering measurable business impact.
* Experience developing executive-level presentations and strategic recommendations independently.
* Previous consulting experience preferred.
* 4-year college degree required; MBA preferred

  

**Compensation**

The expected base salary range for this position is $180,000 - $200,00 annually, depending on experience, skills, and qualifications. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based bonuses and other compensation programs.

**Benefits**

MPG offers a generous package of health benefits, including medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, paid maternity/paternity leave and life insurance. Our compensation program provides market industry base salary, bonuses, and 401K. In addition to paid holidays, we reward an employee’s extra efforts through unlimited paid time off.

Through DEI&B, we embrace the beauty in all of the unique qualities of our employees, communities and clients. MPG’s DEI&B efforts empower us to collectively reach our full potential. by fueling innovation, connection, and growth. We recognize the value of having a diverse and engaged team. description:
**Who we are:**

United We Dream (UWD) is the largest immigrant youth-led community in the country. We create welcoming spaces for young people – regardless of immigration status – to support, engage, and empower them to make their voices heard and win!

With an online reach of over 5 million every month, more than 1,000,000 members as well as 4 statewide branches and local groups across 28 states. UWD is made up of fearless young people fighting to improve the lives of our members and their families. Our vision is a society which celebrates our diversity and believes in a multi-ethnic, intersectional path to getting there. Over 60% of our members are womxn and 30% identify as LGBTQ.

We are driven by the priorities and needs of our members; have trained thousands of individuals; and have supported countless local organizing groups. Our grassroots-driven approach has a proven record of success and we’re looking for talented folks to join our team!

Learn more about United We Dream by visiting www.unitedwedream.org.

**Position Summary**

United We Dream is seeking a new senior leader and organization-builder to serve in the role of Managing Director. In partnership with the Executive Director, the Managing Director will develop and drive an organizational strategy to maximize UWD’s assets including its people power, brand, as well as financial and operational resources, to build the power necessary to change the lives of our members, leaders and communities.

We are looking for an experienced, strategic, insightful, and mission-driven leader who thrives on creating and managing systems and community in service to an organization’s mission. As the primary thought partner to the Executive Director (ED), the Managing Director translates the organization’s vision into seamless, cohesive execution across five core pillars: 1) long-term organizational strategic vision; 2) financial sustainability & growth strategy; 3) operations strategy responsive to the needs of a fast-paced community power building infrastructure; 4) organizational security and compliance strategy; and 5) organizational structure and culture that successfully drives organizational priorities.

This position works with all members of the internal leadership, including leading the Executive Team and the Senior Leadership Team, and will coordinate internal processes across departments to cultivate and maintain an effective team, a commitment to excellence, and healthy organizational culture.

A successful candidate will be passionate about UWD’s mission and be highly motivated to work in a fast-growing, front-line, history-making organization. They must be committed to leadership development, power building, and building collaborative structures which make the most of a highly talented staff team.

This is a full-time exempt position. Much day-to-day work will be handled remotely, but travel (local, nation-wide, international) is expected for approximately 30-40% of the time. Applicants working in the eastern time zone are preferred but not required. Multilingual communication skills are a plus though not required.

**Primary Responsibilities**

### **Long-Term Organizational Strategy & Leadership Alignment**

* Strategic Thought Partner: Serves as thought partner to the Executive Director on all aspects of organizational strategy including programs, internal operations and team management, growth, and brand.
* Strategic Planning: Lead the development, rollout, and regular evaluation of the multi-year organizational strategic vision in partnership with the Executive Director, Senior Leadership Team, and Board of Directors.
* Execution & Accountability: Lead the Executive Team, the Senior Leadership Team, and the Staff through annual goal setting, translating the organization’s long-term vision into ambitious but realizable organizational goals that build year after year
  + Works with the Senior Leadership Team to arrive at Department-Level goals that will implement the organizational goals
  + Leads periodic stepbacks with the SLT and the Staff to assess progress made on goals as well as any changes that need to be made
* Internal Leadership:

* Provides day-to-day management of the Executive Team and the Senior Leadership Team and ensures that the teams are high functioning, collaborative and effective leadership bodies.
  + Lead ET and SLT meetings and stepback spaces
* Oversees planning and execution of all-staff and all-leadership gatherings and retreats.
* Staffs the Executive Director in internal settings or speaks on their behalf in internal settings when required.
* Serves as the chief of internal communications, crafting and/or approving internal communications materials related to United We Dream’s organizational effectiveness.
* Supports the Executive Director to ensure the achievement of key internal culture and operations goals.
* Board Management:
  + Work with the Executive Director and Co-Chairs of the Board to lead board meetings and relevant board committee meetings
  + Prepare high-level briefings and strategic board materials
  + Facilitate alignment at Executive Committee meetings.
* Special Projects: Direct priority high-stakes or rapid-response projects and incubates initiatives from concept to handoff or implementation.

### **Financial Sustainability & Growth Strategy**

* Supervise the Senior Director of Finance and Development
* Revenue Strategy Collaboration: Partner with the Senior Director of Finance and Development to strategize around and execute long-term revenue diversification strategies, including major gifts, institutional funding, earn-income models, and rapid-response campaign fundraising.
* Resource Allocation: Partner with the Senior Director of Finance and Development to ensure strategic priorities are directly linked to annual budgeting and financial forecasting analysis, optimizing resource allocation for maximum programmatic impact.
* Capital & Reserve Management: Partner with the Senior Director of Finance and Development to oversee financial sustainability and growth metrics, long-term reserve and investments planning, and fiscal decision-making models to weather potential political or economic shifts.

### **Operational Strategy & Organizational Effectiveness**

* Supervise the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems.
* Oversee the contract relationship with our operations partner Seed the Dream, and create staff and consultant support systems as needed.
* Change Management:
  + Lead major organizational change initiatives or organizational redesigns
  + Partner with the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems to lead culture-building endeavors that promote courage, rigor, community, resilience, and high performance.
* Inter-Departmental Collaboration:
  + Serve as the central, high-level oversight ensuring effective coordination between all parts of the organization – the Membership and Campaigns Department, Narrative Department, Development Department, Finance Department, and the Data and Operations Department.
* Movement-Values Aligned & Effective Operations:
  + Oversees the Operations partner to ensure the complete, seamless, and values-aligned operational apparatus and set-up for programs, activities, tactics, etc.
  + Oversees the Operations partner to ensure the complete, seamless, and values-aligned planning and execution of in-person events or actions, including large scale ones with multiple external participants and partners.

### **Security, Risk Mitigation & Compliance**

* Holistic Organizational Strategy:
  + Anticipate and monitor changes in legal, regulatory and administrative environments
    - Partner with the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems to devise plans to implement changes in organizational policies/procedures as needed to maintain compliance.
    - Partner with the Adviser on Special Projects and the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems to strategize about legal risks to the organization and bring in necessary counsel
    - Partner with the Narrative Director to assess any additions to external communications strategy
  + Anticipate and monitor our organizational security needs across all aspects (physical, digital, data, reputational, etc.) and and partner with the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems to devise plans for improvements necessary to support the growth of specific programs and UWD overall;
* Legal Compliance: Ensure complete compliance across nonprofit regulatory frameworks (including 501(c)(3) / 501(c)(4) advocacy and lobbying rules, charitable registrations, etc.), maintaining proactive legal and reputational risk management policies and systems.
* Crisis Management: Develop and maintain rapid-response crisis plans, leading incident response teams during political retaliation, legal challenges, security breaches, or public relations crises.

**Organizational Leadership**

* Strengthen the culture: Partner with the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems to ensure a safe, welcoming, and inspiring organizational culture for staff to excel in. Role model and uphold UWD’s values of creating a courageous, rigorous, and community-oriented working environment.
  + Partner with the Director of Organizational Culture and Systems and with the Operations partner to develop, revise, and uphold organization policies and standards, ensuring that organizational policies are in line with the organization’s guiding principles as well as relevant compliance regulations and concerns.
* Support fundraising:Collaborate with the Executive Director and Development Department team in developing and executing a forward-thinking fundraising strategy for organizational priorities.
* Demonstrate embodied leadership:Prioritize taking care of your physical and emotional health as a key component of thriving in your role. Practice self-care behaviors in ways that work best for you and proactively encourage your staff to prioritize self-care as well. Project trust & confidence in your abilities and skills and recognize the achievements and abilities of others
* Manage organizational change:As the organization undergoes continued growth and innovation, the Managing Director will manage organizational change in a way that inspires and activates the Board, staff, members and community.

**Desired Qualifications and Skills**

* 8+ years of experience in the progressive, non-profit or movement space with a well rounded background across organizational departments.
* Well developed emotional intelligence and communication skills, is able to build trusting relationships with a wide array of individuals
* A critical thinker and a capable, flexible, curious generalist.
* Demonstrated experience in successfully developing and executing major, large-scale project plans involving many moving pieces and collaborators.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with an ability to understand a wide range of audiences and interests.
* Demonstrated experience in building staff teams, management, coaching and leadership development.
* The ability to build strong relationships internal to the organization and external for the organization
* Experience with seeing the long vision of an organization while understanding the importance of accomplishing short and medium term objectives.
* Experience with being able to conceptualize and approach problems and solutions in a proactive, constructive, and innovative manner that will result in improved performance across the organization.
* Strong follow through with principals and with organizers.
* A passion for the mission: We believe that those closest to the pain are the closest to the solutions, therefore a successful candidate must be “all in” on UWD being an immigrant youth-led organization

**Interpersonal Skills**

* An exceptional team player; exemplifies a work style that is committed to the excellence that our members and team deserve while being flexible, respectful, collaborative and nimble;
* Can build trust, confidence, and leadership among a diverse range of staff, fellow, partner organizations - across race, gender, and other identities

**Cultural Competency**

* Strong understanding of the immigrant experience, preferably with lived experience as an undocumented person, immigrant, or immigrant family
* Understanding of race, gender, sexuality and other aspects of identity, and their intersections, and how that plays out in the work. Experience building strong relationships and trust across race, gender, class, and other group identities, both internally and externally
* Brings an anti-racist lens to their work and understands the role that white-supremacy and anti-Blackness play in the environments in which we operate
* Demonstrates self-awareness of their own multiple group identities and their attendant dynamics, and can adapt the approach as needed
* Experience working in communities of color and/or building multiracial organizing efforts
* Knowledge of immigrants rights’ policy and organizing landscape is preferred

**Compensation**

Salary Range: $160,000.00- $180,000.00

**Benefits:**

  

* Employees who have completed less than 1 year of service with United We Dream:
  + 10 Vacation days per year
* Employees who have completed more than 1 year of service but less than 3 with United We Dream:
  + 12 Vacation days per year
* Employees who have completed more than 3 years of service but less than 5 with United We Dream:
  + 17 Vacation days per year

**To Apply**

Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. Please submit a cover letter, resume, at least one writing example, and salary requirement via email to **humanresources@unitedwedream.org** and include **Managing Director (LAST NAME, FIRST NAME)** in the subject line.
